chapters.title: Chapter 2251 Colossal Mammoth City
paragraphs: "That giant really wanted me dead, huh? But what's with that attitude?" Yuan found the encounter so puzzling that he couldn't even be angry at the fact that someone tried to take his life twice in a row.
However, when Yuan recalled what Tian Yang had experienced upon returning to the Desolate Continent after Kulas gained control, he was no longer confused.
After lingering for a few more moments, Yuan used his divine sense to survey the area around him until he found a city.
After a short while, Yuan set off toward the nearest city, the Southern Stronghold.
Along the way, he encountered several magical beasts, each ranging from the first to the third level of God Ascension. Yet their cultivation wasn't the most intimidating part, but their sheer size.
Upon reaching the city, he wandered through its streets, checking to see what had changed compared to Tian Yang's memories.
'It's all giants.' Yuan noticed very quickly that not a single human was present in the city.

He also noticed the strange gazes directed at him ever since he entered the city. Though many tried to conceal it, their killing intent was as plain as the sky. Yet, despite having such bloodlust, none of them tried to attack him like the giant he encountered before.
'If things are like this, then...'
Yuan had a good idea what the trial was about and heaved a deep sigh.
He left the city shortly after and began making his way toward the central region of the continent—toward Colossal Mammoth City, the capital of the continent.
However, halfway there, Yuan was forced to stop when his path was blocked by three giants at the first, second, and third levels of God Ascension.
Two of these giants had unfamiliar faces, but Yuan recognized one of them—the one at the third level of God Ascension.
"You couldn't kill me by yourself, so you brought two other people who are even weaker than you... What an odd way of thinking," Yuan remarked.
"Be careful, brothers. Do not be deceived by his cultivation, as he was able to block my strike with his bare hands," said the giant, ignoring Yuan's remarks.
"So you're done pretending you're not trying to kill me, huh?" Yuan said with a faint smile.
"Let's get him, brothers!"
Without another word, the three giants surrounded Yuan, forming a triangle formation around him.
"Sorry, but I'm not in the mood to play today," Yuan spoke in a low voice as his body suddenly surged with Eternal Essence.
"What?!"
While the giants were momentarily stunned by the immense pressure created from his explosive aura, Yuan used Void Manipulation to close his distance with the third-level giant.
"You'll go first.
Yuan threw a space-shattering punch straight at the giant's face.
The giant reacted quickly, raising both hands to block, but Yuan's fist tore through his palms and crashed into his face a heartbeat later.
The force was so overwhelming that the giant's head burst like an overfilled balloon, his blood splattering in all directions.

The remaining two giants widened their eyes in shock and disbelief, but Yuan didn't give them a chance to react. He activated Void Manipulation, and in the next instant, both giants plummeted from the sky—dead before they could even move.
Without even bothering to give them another glance, Yuan continued his way toward the Colossal Mammoth City.
As Yuan continued his journey, he encountered more giants, every group larger than the last. Yet no matter their numbers, all of them were helpless before his overwhelming strength.
Eventually, Yuan arrived at Colossal Mammoth City, and unlike his last visit during the previous trial, the atmosphere was completely different—suffocating, heavy, and simmering with anger.
Yuan ignored the atmosphere and flew directly to the massive castle located on the horizon.
"Halt!"
Of course, it didn't take long before someone stepped in to block his path. This time, it was a group of giants, each clad in full golden armor and wielding a massive halberd.
"Humans are prohibited from entering this city. Leave if you don't want any trouble," said the soldier in the front.
"Prohibited? Since when?" Yuan asked.
"Since last year!"
'So it's been a year since this started...' Yuan thought to himself.
"Well, I'm here to see your leader, Giant Emperor Kulas."
"Get lost! You're not even worthy to utter his name, let alone meet him!" "Just tell Kulas that his rival is here." Instead, the soldiers raised their weapons, pointing them at him.
Yuan sighed.
Then, he took a deep breath before releasing a powerful voice that echoed through the city.
"KULAS, IS THIS HOW YOU GREET AN OLD FRIEND?! GET YOUR ASS OUT HERE BEFORE I DRAG YOU OUT MYSELF!"
"T-This crazy bastard!" The soldiers exclaimed with shocked expressions.
"He's going to get us killed! We must hurry and kill him before—"
A powerful presence suddenly descended, interrupting the soldier.
Yuan raised an eyebrow at the presence. Although it was familiar, it didn't belong to Kulas.
Soon, a figure came into view.
Yuan narrowed his eyes slightly at the approaching beautiful woman with golden hair and emerald eyes and murmured, "Xie Mey."
It was Kulas' youngest daughter.
"Princess!" The soldiers greeted her.
"Please don't worry, we'll deal with him right—"
"No need," she interrupted. "Let him through. He's an acquaintance."
The soldiers stared at her with wide eyes, but they didn't dare to defy her order and acknowledged it.
Once the soldiers left, Xie Mey, with a nonchalant look on her face, said to Yuan, "Follow me."
"Where's Kulas?" Yuan asked as he followed.
"Father is... a bit busy right now."
"Why did you come here, Senior Tian?"
"Am I not allowed to visit an old friend?"
Xie Mey looked at him with a pondering gaze.
"Did you encounter other giants on your way here?" she then asked.
"I have."
"Did they do anything weird to you?" "If by weird you mean trying to kill me, then yes, they were acting quite weird."
"Sorry," she sighed.
"Care to tell me what had happened to this place?"
"In a bit," she said with a slight nod.

chapters.title: Chapter 2252 Unknown Sickness
paragraphs: Yuan followed Xie Mey back to the palace, but before he even stepped inside, he felt an ominous pressure hanging over the place, suffocating the air itself.
Sensing that strange pressure, Yuan silently confirmed his suspicions about the trial and mentally prepared himself.
A short while later, Xie Mey stopped before a room sealed behind a pair of grand doors.
"Before we proceed, I must warn you about something," Xie Mey turned to face Yuan with a solemn look on her face.
"The emperor, my father, he might—"
"Attack me?" Yuan interrupted.
Xie Mey's eyes widened at his words.
"How did you...?"
"Let's just say that I already have an idea about the situation."
Xie Mey didn't say anything, and after a moment of silence, quietly nodded her head.
"I'll let you meet my father now," she said as she opened the massive doors.

As the doors creaked open, a lethal aura burst from the room, so dense it was visible to the naked eye, like a physical wave of killing intent. But this sensation was far more dreadful; it felt like the presence of death itself.
Xie Mey's eyes tightened as she stared into the dark room. Yuan heard her murmur, barely louder than a mosquito, yet shaking with fear, "It's gotten even worse..."
While Xie Mey's movements were frozen with fear, Yuan strode forward without any hesitation.
"I'll be back."
"Wait—"
Xie Mey reached out to stop him, but Yuan didn't stop, stepping forward and vanishing into the darkness.
Inside, he narrowed his eyes toward the far end of the shadowy corridor, where a colossal silhouette sat upon a throne the size of a mountain.
However, despite its immense size, the silhouette wasn't robust. If anything, it looked unnervingly thin.
"Who goes there...?"
A coarse voice echoed through the room, sending chills down Yuan's spine—not out of fear, but because it stirred memories he would rather have forgotten.
"Hey, Kulas." Yuan calmly responded.
The massive silhouette could be seen visibly trembling upon hearing his voice. "You are... Tian Yang?"
"That's right."
"S-Scram!" Kulas suddenly roared.
"I just got here, though?"
"I don't care! Get lost!"
"Is this really how you treat an old friend who came to visit? I'm not leaving until I see your face."
"Please... just leave. I don't want you to see me in my current condition—No... I don't want to hurt my only friend," Kulas responded after a brief moment of silence.
"Hurt me?" Yuan suddenly laughed out loud. "Do you really think you're even capable of that?"
Yuan suddenly summoned some flames, lighting up the place just enough to see Kulas.
When Yuan finally saw Kulas clearly, his heart trembled, though the sight wasn't entirely unexpected.

Kulas, once a towering figure of strength whose muscles could make any body refiner envious, was now so emaciated that his bones protruded beneath his skin. He looked no different from someone who had been starved their entire life. Hell, he looked many times worse than when he was imprisoned in the dungeon.

When Kulas first took control of the Desolate Continent and established his own family, he had been in perfect health. But sometime later, he suddenly fell ill with an unknown sickness—at least, that was what Tian Yang had believed when he'd first seen Kulas in such a condition.

This illness caused Kulas to lose his rationality at times, turning him dangerously unstable. Worse yet, it didn't affect only him, but everyone who shared his bloodline suffered from it to some degree, spreading its influence across the entire Giant Race.
Although Kulas was not their true ancestor, the giants had inherited power from his blood, much like how cultivators absorb the blood essence of magical beasts to gain strength.
However, oddly enough, this sickness did not affect some females, primarily those with strong yin energy in their bodies, so Xie Mey wasn't affected by it.
"ARRRGH!"
Kulas suddenly released a beastly roar, one that did not sound human, and his aura skyrocketed.
BOOM!
His cultivation—at the fifth level of God Ascension—surged forth like a tidal wave, and his overwhelming pressure came crashing down upon Yuan.

Suddenly, Kulas' appearance began to change. His golden hair and emerald eyes darkened into pitch black, while his pale skin flushed a deep rosy shade, almost like an overripe tomato, skirting the edge of a demonic visage, though lacking the solid crimson hue true demons possessed.
"Senior Tian! Please be careful! He's going to attack!" Xie Mey warned him from outside.
Sure enough, Kulas suddenly sprang from his throne, shooting into the air before bringing his massive arms crashing down toward Yuan.
However, Yuan didn't even bother to dodge. Instead, he met Kulas head-on. With Eternal Essence surging through his body, he raised his hands and caught the giant's devastating strike bare-handed.
"You'll need to do more than this if you want to hurt me," Yuan muttered softly as he overpowered Kulas, hurling him back toward his throne with overwhelming force.
"Come. I'll keep you entertained until you regain your sanity."
Yuan beckoned toward Kulas, who was drooling uncontrollably and letting out animalistic noises, as though he had devolved into a wild beast.
Kulas released a powerful roar before lunging at Yuan again.
Despite his frail appearance, Kulas was anything but weak, and every strike he unleashed sent tremors rippling through the entire city.
Yet, Yuan met all of his attacks head-on, blocking them with ease.
Kulas rampaged without rest for three straight days, but eventually his body calmed, his appearance returned to normal, and he collapsed to his knees.

"What should I do, Tian Yang...?" Kulas spoke in a weak voice. "There's this voice inside my head constantly telling me to kill. I cannot contain this madness no matter how hard I try, and it gets worse every time I lose control." He lifted his head to look at Yuan with a pleading gaze, "Please, kill me before I turn into a monster. You're the only one I can count on."
Yuan didn't respond and merely stood there in silence.

chapters.title: Chapter 2253 Unknown Sickness(2)
paragraphs: "What are you waiting for? Hurry up and kill me," Kulas urged when Yuan remained silent.
Yuan closed his eyes and sighed out loud, "I wasn't able to save you in the past because of my lack of experience, but this time, for sure..."
"Save me...? Can I even be saved at this point?" Kulas gave a hollow, defeated chuckle.
In the past, Tian Yang did everything he could to find a cure for Kulas, but alas, even after traveling the entire world, he was unable to find a clue to his illness.

And while Tian Yang traveled the world, Kulas' condition continued to deteriorate. It eventually grew so severe that he—and the entire Giant Race—abandoned their continent and embarked on a murderous rampage, slaughtering countless innocent lives.

This ignited the first great war in history before the Heavenly War of Immortals and Gods. Although its scale and destruction were nowhere near that of the Heavenly War of Immortals and Gods, and almost nobody knows of its history today, it still devastated countless lives. In the end, Tian Yang was forced to do the unthinkable—ending Kulas' life with his own hands.
However, even after Tian Yang ended his life, Kulas' suffering did not come to an end.
"Get some rest, Kulas, and let me handle everything," Yuan said to him.
"If you say so..." Kulas mumbled before he closed his eyes and fell asleep where he knelt. "Good heavens... When were you this strong?" Xie Mey entered the room shortly after Kulas fell asleep.
"I'm not as strong as you think," Yuan said, shaking his head.
"Well, you defeated my father, and as far as I know, he has never lost to anyone."

Xie Mey glanced at Kulas, then asked, "Do you know what's wrong with him—or with the entire Giant Race, for that matter? It all began a little over a year ago, when Father started having sudden bursts of temper. At first, we thought he was simply in a bad mood... but by the time we realized something was truly wrong, it was already too late. Medicines and treasures... nothing we tried could cure him."
After a brief silence, Yuan replied, "I don't know the full extent of what he's afflicted with, but I do know its origin and possibly how to cure it."
"Really?! That's great news!" Xie Mey was so overjoyed to hear this news that she started jumping up and down like an excited child.
However, Yuan shook his head and said, "It's going to be risky, and I'll need some time to prepare.
"Take all the time you need!" she said. "And is there anything I can help with?"
"No."
"Is that so... Then when will you be ready?"
"Give me a week."
"Okay. If there's anything you need, let me know. I'll be right here." Xie Mey said as she approached Kulas and picked him up.
"I'll be back after I bring him to his room."
She left the next moment.
When Xie Mey returned a few minutes later, she found Yuan sitting on the ground in the lotus position, his eyes closed, seemingly in a state of cultivation.
'What is that weird energy surrounding him?' she wondered inwardly as she could somewhat sense the otherworldly aura around him.
A few days later, Yuan suddenly opened his eyes and asked, "Do you know what an Outer God or an Eternal is?" "Outer God? No, this is the first time I've heard of it," she said while shaking her head.
"Does it have anything to do with my father's condition?"

Yuan nodded and elaborated, "They're beings that exist beyond our world—powerful existences that consider themselves the true gods of this universe. I don't know why, but Kulas' condition was caused by one of them."
"How can you tell?" Xie Mey asked.
"I was told by one of these existences," he calmly replied.
"What...?" Xie Mey raised an eyebrow.
However, Yuan didn't elaborate further.

Although Tian Yang had failed to find a cure for Kulas in time, he never stopped researching the cause even after Kulas' death. Then, a few lifetimes later, he finally learned the truth from another Eternal.

"This 'illness' doesn't target the body—it targets the soul," he said suddenly. "It corrodes one's very essence, twisting them into a mindless killer who can only think of slaughtering everything around them. It's similar to how a cultivator might lose themselves if they fall to their heart demon. However, that's not even the cruelest part."
Xie Mey swallowed nervously as she wondered what else could be worse than corrupting one's soul.
"Those whose souls are corrupted cannot reincarnate; they can only suffer until their very soul is destroyed. That means they won't find rest even in death."
"How cruel... why would they do something like that to my father?" Xie Mey sighed.

"These beings don't normally target someone without a reason," Yuan said. "In their eyes, we're no different from ants, so they wouldn't go out of their way to do something like this for fun. Although I'm not entirely certain, I believe Kulas may have become involved with one of them and offended it. Of course, this is just speculation, and it's entirely possible that one of them just decided to mess with Kulas out of boredom."
Kulas' situation was very similar to Xiao Cangming's, who had once offended an Eternal and been cursed for it. However, Kulas' case was far more severe.

Although Kulas seemed perfectly healthy before the illness took hold, the reality was that he had long been broken within. Years of ceaseless torture in the Immortal Confinement Dungeon had left deep mental scars, making him especially vulnerable to mental attacks, particularly those targeting the soul.
Yuan closed his eyes and resumed his cultivation shortly after.
After a few more days of preparation, Yuan opened his eyes again and said, "Okay, I am ready."
Xie Mey nodded and led Yuan to Kulas' bedroom. Inside, Kulas was sleeping peacefully.

"I haven't seen him sleep since he became sick, much less this peacefully," Xie Mey remarked as she gazed at his sleeping face. She turned to Yuan and continued with a warm smile, "This is possible only because of you, Senior Tian. Just your presence gives Father peace."

"Take all the time you need!" she said.
"And is there anything I can help with?"
"No."
"Is that so...
Then when will you be ready?"
"Give me a week."
"Okay.
If there's anything you need, let me know.
I'll be right here." Xie Mey said as she approached Kulas and picked him up.
"I'll be back after I bring him to his room."
She left the next moment.
When Xie Mey returned a few minutes later, she found Yuan sitting on the ground in the lotus position, his eyes closed, seemingly in a state of cultivation.
'What is that weird energy surrounding him?' she wondered inwardly as she could somewhat sense the otherworldly aura around him.
A few days later, Yuan suddenly opened his eyes and asked, "Do you know what an Outer God or an Eternal is?" "Outer God?
No, this is the first time I've heard of it," she said while shaking her head.
"Does it have anything to do with my father's condition?"
Yuan nodded and elaborated, "They're beings that exist beyond our world—powerful existences that consider themselves the true gods of this universe.
I don't know why, but Kulas' condition was caused by one of them."
"How can you tell?" Xie Mey asked.
"I was told by one of these existences," he calmly replied.
"What...?" Xie Mey raised an eyebrow.
However, Yuan didn't elaborate further.
Although Tian Yang had failed to find a cure for Kulas in time, he never stopped researching the cause even after Kulas' death.
Then, a few lifetimes later, he finally learned the truth from another Eternal.
"This 'illness' doesn't target the body—it targets the soul," he said suddenly.
"It corrodes one's very essence, twisting them into a mindless killer who can only think of slaughtering everything around them.
It's similar to how a cultivator might lose themselves if they fall to their heart demon.
However, that's not even the cruelest part."
Xie Mey swallowed nervously as she wondered what else could be worse than corrupting one's soul.
"Those whose souls are corrupted cannot reincarnate; they can only suffer until their very soul is destroyed.
That means they won't find rest even in death."
"How cruel... why would they do something like that to my father?" Xie Mey sighed.
"These beings don't normally target someone without a reason," Yuan said.
"In their eyes, we're no different from ants, so they wouldn't go out of their way to do something like this for fun.
Although I'm not entirely certain, I believe Kulas may have become involved with one of them and offended it.
Of course, this is just speculation, and it's entirely possible that one of them just decided to mess with Kulas out of boredom."
Kulas' situation was very similar to Xiao Cangming's, who had once offended an Eternal and been cursed for it.
However, Kulas' case was far more severe.
Although Kulas seemed perfectly healthy before the illness took hold, the reality was that he had long been broken within.
Years of ceaseless torture in the Immortal Confinement Dungeon had left deep mental scars, making him especially vulnerable to mental attacks, particularly those targeting the soul.
Yuan closed his eyes and resumed his cultivation shortly after.
After a few more days of preparation, Yuan opened his eyes again and said, "Okay, I am ready."
Xie Mey nodded and led Yuan to Kulas' bedroom.
Inside, Kulas was sleeping peacefully.
"I haven't seen him sleep since he became sick, much less this peacefully," Xie Mey remarked as she gazed at his sleeping face.
She turned to Yuan and continued with a warm smile, "This is possible only because of you, Senior Tian.
Just your presence gives Father peace."

chapters.title: Chapter 2254 Curing Kulas
paragraphs: "I'm going to begin curing Kulas now. It might get a little dangerous, so you should leave us and wait outside," Yuan said to Xie Mey.
However, she frowned and said, "No, I am going to stay here."
"You don't trust that I will cure him?" Yuan asked with a raised eyebrow.
"That's not it. I just want to be here when he wakes up with a clear head," she replied as she slightly shook her head.
After a moment of silence, Yuan muttered as he approached Kulas, "Don't blame me if anything happens."
"I won't."
Upon reaching the bed, which was large enough to fit tens of thousands of people with ease, Yuan sat down and pressed his hands against Kulas' massive body.
"I should also warn you... This process will require me to destroy his body, leaving nothing but his soul."
"What?!" Xie Mey exclaimed. "You should've said that before we even entered this room!"
"So do you want me to stop?" Yuan asked without even looking at her.
"No..." Xie Mey responded after a moment of hesitation.
"As long as his soul is unharmed, we can just make another body for him," Yuan continued.

"Creating another body...?" Xie Mey echoed, looking utterly confused. The concept of crafting new vessels simply didn't exist in the early years of the Primordial Era. In fact, it wasn't known at all until much later—near the era's end—when more cultivators reached the God Ascension realm and realized they could survive without a physical body as long as their soul was unharmed.
"I'm starting now," Yuan spoke again before Xie Mey could ask him any questions, and as curious as she was, Xie Mey didn't dare to disturb him and silently watched from afar.
A few minutes later, an otherworldly aura started surging from Yuan's body, and the temperature in the room drastically dropped in the blink of an eye.

'W-What is this coldness?!' Xie Mey cried inwardly as she shivered nonstop. As a giant, her body was naturally more robust and resilient than ordinary cultivators, allowing them to endure harsh climates without training.
Xie Mey, who had never experienced such cold before, trembled uncontrollably, her teeth clattering together.
<Shiva's Eternal Frost>

Since whatever was affecting Kulas was weak to yin energy, Yuan enveloped Kulas' body with Shiva's Eternal Frost, the most extreme yin energy he knew. In the blink of an eye, the entire room froze over with every inch of it encased in ice.
Xie Mey enveloped herself with Celestial Qi, but it was useless against the power of an Eternal.
'Even my Celestial Qi cannot block the cold?! I'll freeze to death at this rate!' Xie Mey, despite her earlier words and boldness, left the room after realizing that she could not endure the cold.
Once Xie Mey left the room, Yuan's aura abruptly surged even more, almost as if he'd purposefully held back for Xie Mey.
Now that he didn't have to worry about her, Yuan focused entirely on curing Kulas.

Although Yuan had increased his Eternal Essence drastically after refining the essence of the void, he was still only able to maintain Shiva's Eternal Frost for a few minutes before becoming exhausted.
Once he was exhausted, Yuan immediately started absorbing the illness that clung to Kulas' soul, refining it into his own essence.
Time flew, and in an instant, a whole month had passed with Yuan focused solely on curing Kulas. Yet, to Yuan, who was constantly exhausting himself, the month felt like an eternity.
After a month, Yuan had managed to completely absorb whatever was affecting Kulas. However, as a result, Kulas' body was destroyed, leaving behind a weakened soul, just as Yuan had predicted.
Shiva's Eternal Frost had not only weakened the sickness but also caused irreparable damage to Kulas' body, and if Yuan hadn't extracted Kulas' soul, his soul would've likely shattered.
Yuan collapsed on the bed, his body soaked in sweat despite the freezing temperature in the room.
Although Xie Mey left the room, she never truly left and had waited outside for an entire month. When she noticed Yuan's otherworldly aura had disappeared, she immediately opened the door.
"Senior Tian! What happened with the treatment?!" she cried as she entered the room.
"Don't worry, he's fine. I have removed whatever was affecting him," he responded in a weak voice.
"Thank you... truly..." Xie Mey said, bawling her eyes out, but her tears froze instantly due to the cold.
Ding!
<You have cleared the first trial>
After clearing the trial, the scenery around Yuan dissolved, and he returned to the Stairway to Heaven. However, while everything from the trial should have vanished, something remained with him.
Yuan, still lying on the ground from exhaustion, stared at Kulas' soul that was hovering above him with a calm gaze.
"Sorry it took so long, but now, you're free..." Yuan muttered with a smile on his face. "You can finally reincarnate properly."

Since the unknown sickness prevented Kulas' soul from reincarnating, Tian Yang had kept Kulas' soul with him, waiting until he found a way to cure it. Although he had discovered a method long ago, he lacked one crucial component—a yin energy strong enough to weaken the sickness so it wouldn't destroy Kulas' soul when trying to remove it.
Then, after many reincarnations, Yuan acquired Shiva's Eternal Essence, the power that was needed to cure Kulas.
"What are you waiting for?" Yuan spoke again when Kulas' soul remained unmoving. "You're no longer bound, so go reincarnate and live a new life."
Kulas' soul, which had been slumbering since the Primordial Era, began to wake up, indicated by the faint aura it emitted.
Moments later, a familiar voice echoed softly, "Tian Yang, my friend... my sworn brother..."

"Though it may seem as if I've been slumbering ever since the day you killed me and sealed my soul, I was awake and fully conscious. The journeys you took, the hardships you lived through while carrying me... I was there with you, watching over you like some sort of spiritual guardian."
"Kulas...? What are you..."

"I don't want to reincarnate and forget everything," he quickly answered. "I want to continue going on adventures with you—not as a soul like some luggage, but by your side, just like when we journeyed through Han Zexian's Tomb together. Moreover, I still haven't properly thanked you for saving me."
Yuan's eyes widened, but before he could respond, Kulas suddenly bellowed, his tone resolute.
"Forge me a new body, Tian Yang!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2255 The Second Trial
paragraphs: "You want me to forge you a new vessel...?" Yuan stared at Kulas' soul with wide eyes.
"What? Don't tell me you're going to refuse and force me to reincarnate..." Kulas remarked with a somewhat worried voice.

Yuan shook his head with a smile and said, "Why would I do that? If you don't want to reincarnate, then so be it. However, if you want me to craft you a vessel that'll fit your taste... it might be a little difficult."
"Hahaha!" Kulas suddenly burst out laughing, "Did you think I was asking you to forge me a giant's body? I couldn't care less about the size. You can forge me an ordinary body if you want."
"In that case, it's doable. However, you'll still have to wait until I finish with the trials since I don't have any ingredients on me at this moment."
"Fine, but don't make me wait too long, or I might accidentally reincarnate from boredom," said Kulas.
"Seeing how you can already make such jokes despite everything that has happened, I think you'll be fine," Yuan remarked with a smile.

Kulas fell silent for a moment before speaking again, "Although I had my ups and downs in life, it's nothing compared to what you have experienced. I'm merely inspired and following what you're doing."
"Is that so..."

"Anyway, go ahead and continue what you were doing. I may sound fine, but I am actually exhausted, so I'll take a quick nap. Wake me up when my new vessel is ready," Kulas said. "We can continue this conversation at that time."
"Alright. Sleep well."
Kulas' soul disappeared into the void shortly after, but he didn't vanish. Instead, Tian'er had taken his soul and placed him somewhere safe.

Ever since Tian Qiyuan crafted the Stairway to Heaven, Kulas' soul had resided within the treasure, arguably the safest in the Nine Heavens. After all, the Stairway to Heaven was used to traverse the Nine Heavens by its residents. It was a treasure that even the Celestial Emperor considered extremely valuable, so nobody has tried to covet or damage it.
Moreover, the Stairway to Heaven was one of Tian Qiyuan's masterpieces, rivaling Number One Under Heaven.
After Kulas left, Yuan focused solely on recovering his energy.
Meanwhile, Feng Yuxiang and the others chatted about the situation.

"I can't believe that such an ancient figure is still alive," Feng Yuxiang remarked. "Giant Emperor Kulas was one of the most powerful figures of the Primordial Era, predating even the Asura Clan," Xiao Hua said. "It's no exaggeration to say he was one of the key reasons the Celestial Emperor was able to rise into existence."
"Huh? What do you mean?" Feng Yuxiang looked at her with a puzzled face.

"The Celestial Emperor wasn't even a concept during his time," she explained. "Back then, the Nine Heavens—known as Divine Heavens were controlled by the Immortal Clans. One day, Giant Emperor Kulas waged war against the human race. He and the giant race, which was under his command, wreaked havoc across the Divine Heavens and killed countless people. The war forced the Immortal Clans and many other powerful families to come together for the first time."

"However, Giant Emperor Kulas suddenly vanished into thin air one day. Without their leader, the giant race quickly crumbled, and the war ended shortly after. To this day, nobody knows what happened to Giant Emperor Kulas—well, except us."

"Anyway," Xiao Hua continued, "after the war, the Immortal Clans and the other families went their separate ways. But those families, having once tasted what it felt like to command the entire world, couldn't let go of that power and began seeking ways to rule the world once more."

"The Immortal Clans and many other powerful families began fighting among themselves, each seeking to rule the Divine Heavens. Although the Immortal Clans had once been the strongest, their influence had been greatly weakened by a madman who targeted them specifically, ultimately causing them to lose the war."

"Of course, the Immortal Clans weren't the only powerful families. Many hidden families stepped out from the shadows to join the war as well. After many years of conflict, one family emerged victorious and became the first Celestial Family in history."
"Unfortunately, that family abused their newfound power to hell and back... and, well, you already know what happened after that, so I'll spare you the details."
Feng Yuxiang listened to Xiao Hua's history lesson with a loosened jaw.
"I've never heard anything about a war between the Giant Race and humans, and I've read countless ancient scrolls," she remarked.

"Well, it was ages ago—back when this world had only just come into existence. In those days, a few thousand years felt unimaginably long, unlike now, where cultivators can survive for tens of thousands of years with ease. I only know of this history because the Asura Clan once served the first Celestial Family. Because of that, we had access to records hidden from the rest of the world," Xiao Hua said with a light shrug.
Lan Yingying looked at Xiao Hua and remarked with a smile, "To me, you're just as ancient as the Giant Emperor."
Xiao Hua shook her head.
"Although we both existed within the same era—the Primordial Era—it doesn't feel like it. The world before the Celestial Family came into existence was vastly different."
Some time later, Yuan ended his cultivation and said, "I'm ready to begin the next trial."
At his words, the void stirred once more.
When the shifting finally settled, Yuan found himself standing above the clouds, surrounded by an endless expanse of blue sky.
<You have started your second trial in the Stairway to Heaven!>
<A majestic palace stands before your presence...>
A colossal palace emerged on the horizon, suspended atop a platform of clouds. It exuded a boundless, divine aura, as though it were the dwelling place of a god.
When Yuan saw the familiar-looking palace before him, he sighed. Unlike the first trial, he immediately knew what he had to do in this trial.
"That's... the Celestial Palace!" Xiao Hua exclaimed, her eyes widening at the sight.

chapters.title: Chapter 2256 Storming the Celestial Palace
paragraphs: "The Celestial Palace... as in the Celestial Emperor's place?" Lan Yingying asked.
Xiao Hua nodded. There was no mistaking it, as she'd visited that place countless times in the past.

Shortly after the Celestial Palace appeared, Yuan began making his way toward it. But barely half a minute later, he noticed several tiny black dots emerging from the palace. As they drew closer, the dots expanded into the shapes of human silhouettes, and their powerful aura became clearer.

In the blink of an eye, ten fifth-level God Ascension cultivators surrounded him, their aura surging with Celestial Qi and killing intent. "Evil God! How bold of you to come here by yourself! You must have finally gotten tired of living!" One of the cultivators shouted.
"Don't worry, we'll kill you soon. However, if you're hoping it'd be a painless death, we'll have to disappoint you."
"You will pay for all of the atrocities you committed! Not only have you taken countless lives, but you also have no boundaries, killing children and the innocent without batting an eye!"
"We'll definitely avenge our fallen comrades today!"
Hearing such words made Yuan recall his final moments as Tian Xian, when he raided the Celestial Palace alone.
"Are you done barking? If so, come at me." Yuan beckoned them with a nonchalant expression on his face.
"Die! Tian Xian!"
The ten cultivators rushed at Yuan.
Yuan didn't utter a single word as he used Void Manipulation to not only dodge their attacks but also counterattack.
"Ah!"
With a single swing of his sword, Supreme Sword Aura, enhanced with Eternal Essence, erupted across the battlefield, instantly cutting down all ten of the cultivators.

The Supreme Sword Aura didn't merely kill them... it butchered them. In the blink of an eye, their bodies were sliced thousands of times, flesh and bone shredded away until nothing remained but blood. It was as if the cultivators had exploded into a scarlet mist.

After killing the cultivators, Yuan subconsciously lifted his arm to inspect it. At that moment, he realized the trial had done more than change the scenery—it had altered his appearance to that of Tian Xian as well.
"That appeance..." Xiao Hua swallowed nervously after seeing Tian Xian's appearance, her eyes flickering with deep admiration and reverence.
Feng Yuxiang and Lan Yingying couldn't help but make strange faces when they saw Xiao Hua's expression. It was one they had never seen on her before, and it was full of obsession.
Shortly after, more cultivators emerged from the Celestial Palace to stop Yuan.
Ten... twenty... fifty...
In the blink of an eye, the number of cultivators appearing to stop Yuan with each wave had grown into the hundreds.
"Hahaha!" Yuan laughed madly as he danced in and out of existence with Void Manipulation. Each time he reappeared, dozens of cultivators exploded into bloody mist, staining the sky crimson.
Thud.
Xiao Hua, watching from the spectators' room, suddenly fell to her knees as tears streamed down her face. Yet despite her trembling shoulders, a satisfied smile bloomed on her lips.

"I have always regretted not being able to witness this moment..." Xiao Hua spoke in a low voice. "If he hadn't secretly stormed the Celestial Palace alone, I—my family would've surely fought alongside him. But alas, by the time we realized, everything was already over."
In the past, Tian Xian had secretly gone to confront the Celestial Emperor alone. Although he succeeded in defeating him, it came at the cost of his own life.
Meanwhile, Yuan continued carving his way forward, inching closer to the Celestial Palace.

Those who blocked his path ranged from armored soldiers to ordinary-looking cultivators in simple robes. Unlike the present era—where the Celestial Emperor's fighters are almost exclusively Heaven's Mandate—the first Celestial Emperor commanded people from all manner of backgrounds.
Eventually, after slaughtering tens of thousands of enemies, Yuan reached the Celestial Palace's very doorstep.
Without a word, Yuan lifted his leg high and delivered a ruthless kick to the majestic doors, shattering them instantly.
"I'm here to take your life for a second time, Celestial Emperor!" Yuan laughed out loud as he strolled inside the Celestial Palace, where even more enemies awaited him.
"Evil God, you won't get to meet the Celestial Emperor, as you will be dying where you stand!"

They immediately bombarded Yuan with powerful martial techniques that shook the entire palace. Yuan responded to their aggression with his own, and within moments, the entire place was submerged in Supreme Sword Aura and Eternal Essence.
Minutes later, Yuan walked down the blood-soaked hallway until he reached the next area—where, once again, many people stood blocking his path.
"S-Stop him! We mustn't let him reach the Celestial Emperor at all costs!"
Yuan didn't even bat an eye as he moved forward, slaughtering everyone in the area without leaving a single soul alive.
Some time later, Yuan arrived before another majestic door. However, this one was different from the others. It was much more lavish and detailed.
As Yuan raised his leg and prepared to kick it down like he did with the others, the doors suddenly flung open by themselves.
"Come in."
A calm voice echoed, beckoning Yuan.

Without hesitation, Yuan stepped through the doors and entered what appeared to be an indoor garden. His eyes narrowed at the tall figure standing among crystal flowers, back turned to him—a posture that made the figure seem unexpectedly vulnerable.
"Just like back then, you're tending your flowers while your subordinates are being slaughtered by me," Yuan said.

The Celestial Emperor replied, "Unlike that useless bunch who can't even stop a single intruder, these Celestial Dahlias are pleasing to the eye. Moreover, even a single petal from them can turn trash into treasure."
He then turned to face Yuan, his eyes calm yet carrying a faint glimmer of madness beneath the surface.

"Tell me, Tian Xian... why reject my invitation? Had you accepted my offer, the war would have been over ages ago, and you could have enjoyed a peaceful, fulfilling life with your family until the end of time."

sentences.text: "The Celestial Palace... as in the Celestial Emperor's place?" Lan Yingying asked.
Xiao Hua nodded.
There was no mistaking it, as she'd visited that place countless times in the past.

But barely half a minute later, he noticed several tiny black dots emerging from the palace.
As they drew closer, the dots expanded into the shapes of human silhouettes, and their powerful aura became clearer.

"Evil God!
How bold of you to come here by yourself!
You must have finally gotten tired of living!" One of the cultivators shouted.
"Don't worry, we'll kill you soon.
However, if you're hoping it'd be a painless death, we'll have to disappoint you."
"You will pay for all of the atrocities you committed!
Not only have you taken countless lives, but you also have no boundaries, killing children and the innocent without batting an eye!"
"We'll definitely avenge our fallen comrades today!"
Hearing such words made Yuan recall his final moments as Tian Xian, when he raided the Celestial Palace alone.
"Are you done barking?
If so, come at me." Yuan beckoned them with a nonchalant expression on his face.
"Die!
Tian Xian!"
The ten cultivators rushed at Yuan.

"Ah!"
With a single swing of his sword, Supreme Sword Aura, enhanced with Eternal Essence, erupted across the battlefield, instantly cutting down all ten of the cultivators.
The Supreme Sword Aura didn't merely kill them... it butchered them.

It was as if the cultivators had exploded into a scarlet mist.

At that moment, he realized the trial had done more than change the scenery—it had altered his appearance to that of Tian Xian as well.
"That appeance..." Xiao Hua swallowed nervously after seeing Tian Xian's appearance, her eyes flickering with deep admiration and reverence.

chapters.title: Chapter 2257 Fighting the First Celestial Emperor
paragraphs: When Yuan heard the Celestial Emperor's words, he fell silent for a moment before responding in a cold voice, "I would've lived a fulfilling life with Xiu Mei if you didn't assassinate them."

"I did not assassinate your family. It was General Mo who stained his hands with their blood," the Celestial Emperor said in a calm, steady voice—one that carried the tone of someone who truly believed his own words.
"Are you saying that General Mo assassinated my family on his own accord? That you didn't give him the command?" Yuan narrowed his eyes at him.
"Does it really matter?" the Celestial Emperor said with a slight shrug. "It doesn't change the fact that General Mo was the one who carried out the deed."
"Hahah!" Yuan suddenly tilted his head and burst out laughing. "You want to know why I refused to join you? Alright, I'll tell you."
He stared at the Celestial Emperor in the eyes and continued in a serious voice, "It's because you're a coward."

"What... did you just say?" The Celestial Emperor frowned. "You're a pathetic coward who hides behind others," Yuan spat with disdain. "What did you do during the Heavenly War of Immortals and Gods besides cower in this palace like a rat? From the beginning to the very end, you never showed yourself... You never made a difference."
"How dare you..." The Celestial Emperor trembled in anger.

"However, I don't blame you," Yuan continued with a cold smile. "After all, you were pathetically weak—far weaker than the people you sent to die for you. Even with limitless resources and countless techniques at your fingertips, you couldn't break through to the God Ascension realm and remained bottlenecked at True Immortal."
"What?!" Xiao Hua's eyes widened with shock at Yuan's remarks, looking completely baffled by the revelation.
"No way... was the first Celestial Emperor really that weak? Or is the Young Master simply taunting him?" Feng Yuxiang questioned out loud.

Xiao Hua spoke in a dazed voice, "Now that I think about it, we never actually witnessed the Celestial Emperor's prowess in all the years we served him. His cultivation was always concealed, and everything we heard about his strength came from rumors... or from his own people."

No one had ever been bold enough to challenge the Celestial Emperor, so no one truly knew his real strength—no one except Tian Xian, who stormed the Celestial Palace after slaughtering everyone who could have protected him.
"If the Celestial Emperor was truly that weak, then how did the Young Master die...?" Feng Yuxiang mumbled.

"Shut up!" The Celestial Emperor roared after hearing Yuan's remarks. "So what if my cultivation is a little slow? I am still the Celestial Emperor! I stand above every being under heaven! My status and influence are the strongest!" "Who are you trying to convince? Me or you?" Yuan spoke with a mocking smile.
"Courting death!
Without warning, an explosive aura erupted from the Celestial Emperor before he lunged at Yuan, his gaze burning with killing intent.
Unlike the real one, this Celestial Emperor had the cultivation of seventh-level God Ascension.
"Hmph." Yuan let out a dismissive sneer before clashing with him.
With every exchange, their energies blasted out in all directions, destroying everything in sight and tearing through the Celestial Palace, reducing it to ruins within minutes.
"You're lasting much longer than before, but still, you're far from being able to defeat me," said Yuan.

"Shut up! You're just an orphan raised by bandits!" "You act high and mighty, but you're no different than a dog who only knows how to bark. I'm really curious how you even managed to become the Celestial Emperor."
"You don't deserve to know anything!" The Celestial Emperor exclaimed.
"And you think you deserve the position of Celestial Emperor?"
Their battle raged on for several hours, and throughout the entire clash, the two hurled mockery and insults at each other without pause.
Although the two appeared evenly matched, the truth was that Yuan hadn't been fighting seriously at all.
"I'm sick of seeing your face, so I'll end it here," Yuan suddenly said.
"What?" The Celestial Emperor frowned.
Then, without warning, Yuan's aura skyrocketed as he increased the intensity of his Eternal Essence.
"Let's end this like before, shall we?"

Yuan suddenly began pummeling the Celestial Emperor with nothing but his fists. The Celestial Emperor tried desperately to retaliate, but he was utterly powerless before Yuan's overwhelming might. After beating the Celestial Emperor until his face was unrecognizable—swollen like a crushed blueberry—Yuan shattered his Dantian and tore his arms from his body with brutal force.
The Celestial Emperor collapsed to his knees, staring up at Yuan through the narrow slits of his swollen eyes.
"If you think... that you've won... by killing me—"
Yuan didn't even let the Celestial Emperor finish his sentence. He seized him by the jaw, gripped his head, and tore it from his shoulders with a violent yank.
"A puppet shouldn't talk," he mumbled.
Although Yuan had defeated the Celestial Emperor, the notification confirming he had cleared the trial still didn't appear, even after several moments had passed.
Suddenly, an unfathomable presence descended, engulfing the entire area in a suffocating pressure.
Yuan calmly turned around and lifted his head, gazing up at the sky—where a massive red eye stared down at him like a god.
"I remember now..." he spoke with a slight smile on his face.
"After I stormed the Celestial Palace and dealt with the Celestial Emperor with ease, the true ruler of the Divine Heavens revealed itself to me."
"Let's see... what was your name again? Ah... Ahruk, or some dumbass name like that," Yuan said as he glared fearlessly up at the eye in the sky.
"How dare a mere ant mock a God—much less destroy my property!"
A soul-rending voice exploded within Yuan's mind.
"Upset that I killed your little puppet?" Yuan raised his arm and extended his middle finger toward the eye. "Why don't you do something about it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2258 Evil God's True Ending
paragraphs: Seeing Yuan giving it the middle finger, the eye in the sky narrowed with contempt, but there was also a hint of intrigue hidden deep within. After all, this was the first time a human had ever mocked it so openly.

"Although you're a disrespectful little ant, I will give your boldness some credit," Ahruk spoke a moment later. "I'll give you an opportunity—the opportunity of many lifetimes. Since you killed the Celestial Emperor, I'll give his position to you."
Yuan burst out laughing, "You want me to take that bastard's place? What's the catch?"
He didn't immediately refuse, hoping to continue the conversation and recover more memories.
"You will wield authority over the entire world, and you will gain power beyond imagination—the power of a true God. All I require of you is... to find something," Ahruk said.
Yuan narrowed his eyes and spoke, "This something... is it the Absolute Power?" Ahruk's eyes widened slightly, clearly surprised that a human was aware of its existence.
"I won't ask how you came to acquire such information, but yes, as long as you find it and offer it to me, I will make you the most powerful being in the world, even surpassing some Gods."
"I see..." Yuan mumbled as he closed his eyes.
He'd just recalled all of Tian Xian's memories from the beginning to the very end, as well as the reason the Celestial Emperor served the Eternals.

To obtain power that transcended human limits, the first Celestial Emperor offered everything he had to the Eternals. For someone like him, the promise of unfathomable strength was simply impossible to resist.

In fact, it was likely that the Eternals had played a role in the Celestial Emperor obtaining his position in the first place. After all, it was hard to believe that someone so lacking in talent could rise to such power on his own.
As for the Eternals, since they cannot enter the Nine Heavens with their true bodies or use their powers, they are forced to rely on humans to carry out their deeds.
"What is your answer? My patience is limited." Ahruk spoke again, sounding a bit irritated.
Yuan opened his eyes to look at Ahruk.
"What if I refuse?"
"Then I will obliterate your soul, ensuring you will be erased from existence for eternity.
After taking a deep breath, Yuan spoke, "In that case, I have made up my mind. My answer is... go fuck yourself!"
At the end of his sentence, Yuan quickly swung his arm toward the sky, releasing an arc of Eternal Essence that shot straight at the eye.
The Eternal Essence scattered the moment it touched Ahruk's eye, almost like throwing glass at a rock. "The audacity!" Ahruk angrily roared.
"Since you do not wish to live, I shall obliterate your soul!"
Ahruk's eye suddenly started glowing intensely, clearly preparing for an attack.
Yuan could tell from the sheer amount of Eternal Essence gathering that the attack would rival about 3 percent of Saaruk's prowess.
Since he'd already survived Saaruk using 10 percent prowess, he wasn't worried about it in the slightest and immediately prepared to confront it.
"Perish, you insolent bug!"
In the next moment, Ahruk unleashed a massive crimson beam of condensed Eternal Essence from its eye, shining down on Yuan like divine judgment.

Yuan made no attempt to dodge or block it. Instead, he coated his entire body in Eternal Essence, forming a sword-shaped aura that resembled the tip of a blade. When the crimson beam crashed down on him, it was split apart instantly, its power scattering outward and obliterating everything around him.
"Is that all?" Yuan asked afterward with an unfazed look on his face. "You talk big, but you're hardly any stronger than the Celestial Emperor."
Enraged by his remarks, bloody veins began appearing in Ahruk's eye as he prepared to launch another attack.
This time, he unleashed a beam that was about 6 percent of Saaruk's prowess.
Naturally, Yuan blocked the attack without any difficulty, and he continued to mock the entity.

"No wonder the Celestial Emperor stayed weak despite your promises of unfathomable power. Did you even give him anything? I'm sure he already received your help, but given how pathetically weak you are, he was only able to reach True Immortal."
"HOW DARE AN ANT LIKE YOU MOCK ME! DIE!!!

Suddenly, blood welled at the corner of Ahruk's eye. A moment later, a single drop fell, but despite being only one drop, it was enormous, large enough to fill an entire lake as it plummeted toward Yuan.
Yuan didn't dare to underestimate this drop of blood, as it contained enough Eternal Essence to rival Saaruk at 10 percent of his prowess.
Yuan unleashed as much Eternal Essence as he could muster before shooting it at the drop of blood in the sky.

When the two forces collided, they hung motionless in the sky for a brief moment—then Yuan's Eternal Essence pierced through the blood drop, scattering it in all directions before shooting straight into Ahruk's eye.
"Argh!" Ahruk screamed in pain, snapping its eye shut.
"You will regret this! I swear I will rip your soul apart! Just you wait!" Ahruk shouted before disappearing from the sky.
<You have cleared the second trial>
The notification finally appeared, signaling the end of the trial, and moments later, Yuan was returned to the platform within the Stairway to Heaven.
"Haa..." Yuan released a deep sigh as he stared at the empty void.

Although he had survived Ahruk's attack within the trial, Tian Xian had not. In reality, Tian Xian was ultimately killed by Ahruk, mainly because he had been unable to wield Eternal Essence at the time. Fortunately, his soul was not destroyed, allowing him to reincarnate.
"To think that was how he died in the past..." Xiao Hua muttered in a dazed voice after witnessing everything.
"Just how much have the Eternals influenced our world... and for how long?" Feng Yuxiang wondered aloud.
Shortly after clearing the second trial, Yuan noticed something materializing from the void, slowly drifting toward him.
Seeing the item caused his eyebrows to rise in puzzlement.

chapters.title: Chapter 2259 The Third Trial
paragraphs: As the palm-sized item reached him, Yuan caught it.
It was a golden medallion—one side engraved with a dragon, the other bearing the word 'Heaven'.
"This is..." Yuan's eyes widened with surprise when he realized what he was holding.
"T-That's!" Xiao Hua also expressed great shock after seeing the medallion.
"What is that medallion?" Feng Yuxiang asked, her face full of curiosity.

"The Crest of Heaven!" Xiao Hua explained, revealing its significance. "It's proof of the Celestial Emperor's identity! If anyone not approved by the heavens so much as touches it, their soul will be obliterated! Basically, whoever possesses it is the Celestial Emperor!" Lan Yingying raised her eyebrows and remarked, "But Yuan is holding it just fine. Does that mean he's the Celestial Emperor now?"

"No." Xiao Hua shook her head. "Yuan is probably fine because we're inside the Stairway to Heaven, where that very Heaven cannot reach or influence. Things might be very different once we leave this place, though."

"If it only serves to identify the Celestial Emperor, isn't it basically a useless artifact?" Feng Yuxiang asked. Xiao Hua's expression turned solemn as she responded, "It's more than just an identifier. The Crest of Heaven... can be used to create Heavenly Laws, something only the Celestial Emperor is capable of."
"What?!" Feng Yuxiang exclaimed in shock at her words.
"Heavenly Laws... aren't those the rules every living being in the Nine Heavens must obey? And anyone who defies them is punished by Heavenly Judgment, right?" Lan Yingying asked for clarification.

"Yes, but not every Heavenly Law has the same function," Xiao Hua nodded. "Let's say the Celestial Emperor creates a Heavenly Law that prohibits everyone from eating meat. Anyone who defies this law will be punished accordingly. Then there are the ones that change nature itself, such as the one that made everyone in the lower heavens ignore the existence of 'Players'."
"Can the Celestial Emperor create Heavenly Laws without restriction?" Feng Yuxiang asked.

"No. Even the Celestial Emperor's authority has limits. If a Heavenly Law disrupts the world's balance too much or goes too far against the natural order, it will be rejected. For instance, a law that forbids cultivators from refining spiritual energy wouldn't be permitted. Another example would be a law that prohibits cultivators from killing one another."
"Does that mean the Young Master can create Heavenly Laws as long as he's within the Stairway to Heaven?" Feng Yuxiang then inquired.
Xiao Hua shook her head.
"The creation of Heavenly Laws can only be done at the Heavenly Jade Tablet, which is located in the Celestial Palace."
"In the end, it's still a useless piece of junk." Feng Yuxiang shrugged.

Meanwhile, Yuan tried to recall when or how he had obtained the Crest of Heaven. Since he died shortly after defeating the first Celestial Emperor, he never had the chance to take it from the emperor's corpse.

"It's no use. I can't remember." He sighed in a defeated tone as he stowed the item away. It was likely obtained by one of his other reincarnations, but he had no way of knowing until he regained all of his memories.
Afterward, Yuan rested for a bit to recover his Soul Strength before starting the next trial.
<You have started your third trial in the Stairway to Heaven!>
The scenery changed once again, but not by much, as he was transported to the Starry Sky.
<Survive>
A single word appeared as a notification before Yuan.

The next moment, Yuan sensed multiple powerful presences appearing out of thin air, surrounding him. Yuan calmly surveyed the figures surrounding him. Five in total—each one a towering silhouette shrouded in a black veil. Their features were hidden, but Yuan didn't need to see their appearance to know exactly what he was facing.
"So this is the insect who dared to defy us, huh? He's even more insignificant than I imagined," one of them remarked with open disdain.
"A mere mortal who has only recently learned to use Eternal Essence... Do you really think you have the power to defy us?"
"How should we destroy him? It'd be too boring to kill him normally."
"Killing him would be far too lenient. We should make an example of him—for anyone who might dare defy us in the future."
"I agree. Let's cripple him and torture him until the end of time."
"That's a great idea.
"Are you bastards done yapping?" Yuan suddenly said aloud. "Don't be so quick to decide my fate."
The Eternals fell silent, as though in disbelief that such an audacious mortal could exist.
After a brief moment of silence, the five Eternals erupted with Eternal Essence and launched their attacks at Yuan simultaneously.
Yuan was taken aback for a split second, but the moment he sensed the strength of their Eternal Essence, he immediately counterattacked.
Even with all five of them striking together, their combined might was only comparable to Saaruk at ten percent of his power, if not slightly higher. "Impossible! He actually blocked our attacks!"
The Eternals expressed shock when Yuan's Eternal Essence perfectly canceled out theirs.
"If this is all you've got, then forget crippling me—I'll be the one crippling all of you!" Yuan shouted as he charged at the nearest Eternal.
In response, the Eternal created a blade entirely of Eternal Essence before swinging it at Yuan.
The blade, massive enough to cleave several planets with a single motion, descended upon Yuan, who immediately activated God of War's Astral Arts and created his own sword using Eternal Essence.
When their weapons clashed, the space around the impact point shattered, revealing a deeper, darker void beneath—one that seemed to devour the surrounding space.
However, the hole in the void quickly repaired itself. Meanwhile, their weapons strained against each other for a few seconds, until Yuan's strength overwhelmed it and the Eternal's blade shattered.
Then, with another swift swing, Yuan cleaved the Eternal's silhouette cleanly in half.
After the Eternal fell, its Eternal Essence was immediately absorbed by the remaining four, causing their strength to surge.

chapters.title: Chapter 2260 The Third Trial(2)
paragraphs: Upon absorbing the fallen Eternal's essence, the other four's prowess strengthened drastically, even gaining slightly more than what they'd absorbed. Although the four of them together were slightly stronger than Saaruk at 10 percent of his prowess, individually, they were still relatively weak.

"To think a mere mortal would be able to defy us!" The remaining four Eternals were struck with unimaginable shock as they watched one of their own fall to Yuan. None of them had ever considered such a thing possible, so in their eyes, it was like watching a pig learning math.
"One down, four more to go!" Yuan laughed wildly as he immediately charged at their next Eternal.
"You merely got lucky because he underestimated you! Don't think it will happen again!"
The four Eternals fought in unison, each one covering the others' weaknesses as they pressed Yuan from all sides.

Sure enough, facing all four Eternals at once proved difficult. Yuan wasn't being overwhelmed, nor was he struggling, but he also couldn't instantly kill them the way he had the first. As a result, the battle dragged on.
Days turned into weeks, and after a full month of relentless clashes, Yuan finally found an opening.

Upon defeating one of the Eternals, its Eternal Essence was immediately drawn toward the remaining three. This time, however, Yuan didn't stand by and watch. Noticing that the absorption process was taking much longer than before, he seized the moment and absorbed a portion of the essence for himself.
"How dare a mortal covet our power!"
The remaining three Eternals erupted in fury as they watched Yuan absorb the Eternal Essence. To them, it was like witnessing a pig feast at a banquet reserved for gods.
"You mad? Then do something about it!" Yuan laughed in their faces as he continued to absorb the Eternal Essence.
"Kill him!"
Without pausing their absorption, the Eternals attacked Yuan, desperate to disrupt him. However, just like them, Yuan was fully capable of fighting and refining at the same time.
"How is it possible for a mortal to have such capabilities?!"
"He must've received help from another Eternal! That would explain everything!"
"Who! Which bastard is backing you?!"
"I don't know what you're talking about," Yuan calmly responded to their speculation.
"Bullshit! There is definitely an Eternal or two helping you! Otherwise, you wouldn't be able to use our powers!" "To think an Eternal would stoop as low as helping a human! Shame on them!"
Yuan raised his eyebrows in a puzzled manner before speaking, "Aren't you lot also helping the Celestial Emperor?"
"Hahaha! We're not helping him! We're using him!"
"The Celestial Emperor is nothing more than a slave—merely a tool for realizing our ambitions!" the Eternal declared.

"Although the second Celestial Emperor is still lacking, he's much better than the first one. That ant was utterly useless. He tried to take advantage of the power we gave him to achieve his own ambitions, which led to his own death, even exposing our existence!"
"Hah!" Yuan let out a mocking snort. "Power? What power? The reason he was still weak even after receiving your so-called 'power' is because you barely have any to give."
Suddenly, the void shuddered violently as the Eternals completed their absorption, their auras erupting upward like a storm unleashed.

Although Yuan had taken a portion of the Eternal Essence, the remaining Eternals grew even stronger than before. It was as if absorbing one of their own didn't simply transfer power, but magnified it beyond its original limit.

Now, the three Eternals possessed a combined strength that surpassed Saaruk at ten percent of his power, reaching roughly fifteen percent—only five percent short of the point where Yuan had once been completely powerless.

However, Yuan's own strength had also risen sharply after absorbing the Eternal Essence. He would likely still lose to Saaruk at twenty percent of his true power, but he would no longer be as utterly helpless as before.
"You will die now!" The remaining three Eternals made their arrogant declaration as they bombarded Yuan with overwhelming Eternal Essence.
At this point, Yuan could still match their combined might, but only barely.
Because of the Eternals' massive size, it looked as though they were clashing at close range, but in reality, they were tens of thousands of miles apart.

Their attacks were fairly simple as well. They either condensed Eternal Essence into weapons and struck with those, or they directly fired their Eternal Essence like a cultivator attacking with spiritual energy.
Their strength was so absolute that the Eternals had no need for things like martial techniques. Such methods existed only for mortals, who relied on them to overcome their own shortcomings.

Of course, some Eternals specialized in certain elements, such as Shiva. However, in truth, any Eternal could do the same if they were willing to invest the time and effort. Yet most of them consider such things pointless—mere showmanship—and instead devote themselves to strengthening their raw power.

After all, every element or power in the universe was, at its core, Eternal Essence. Fire, water, lightning, poison... even basic Qi, Immortal Qi, and Celestial Qi—all of them, when broken down to their purest form, were simply essence.

Time flowed on as Yuan clashed with the Eternals, and in the blink of an eye, three more months passed. While the Eternals' strength remained unchanged, Yuan's own prowess continued to rise steadily as he familiarized himself with Eternal Essence.
After all, the Eternals he was fighting were, in the end, nothing more than creations of the Stairway to Heaven.
After another two months, Yuan finally managed to defeat another Eternal.
Now, there were just two remaining, and they wasted no time absorbing what the previous Eternal left behind.
"What's wrong? Now that there are only two of you left, you've become awfully quiet." Yuan suddenly remarked.
The Eternals did not respond, but their auras continued to swell. By the time they finished absorbing the essence, each one possessed nearly ten percent of Saaruk's prowess.

chapters.title: Chapter 2261 The Third Trial(3)
paragraphs: Even though Yuan was essentially fighting the equivalent of two Saaruk at ten percent of his true power, he didn't feel particularly pressured or overwhelmed. It was surprising, especially considering that not long ago, he had struggled just to face one.
'To think I've grown this much just from absorbing the Eternal Essence in this trial...'

Yuan himself was astonished by his progress. Unlike spiritual energy or his cultivation realm, gauging his growth with Eternal Essence was far more difficult; after all, the only benchmark he had to measure it against was Saaruk, who was generous enough to reveal his own prowess.
'If I have grown this much just by absorbing so little Eternal Essence, how much stronger would I get if I absorbed all of it?'
Yuan's heart surged with excitement and anticipation. He couldn't wait to defeat the remaining two Eternals and claim their power for himself.

He also wondered where the Eternal Essence was coming from in the first place. After all, the Stairway was essentially a spatial ring that stored treasures his previous incarnations had gathered; it didn't possess the ability to create treasures—or essence—out of thin air.
Time flowed on as Yuan clashed with the two Eternals, the shockwaves from their exchanges rippling through the void and shattering nearby stars.
As the battle dragged on, Yuan's mastery over Eternal Essence reached unprecedented heights, wielding it as naturally as he could wield Sword Aura.
In the beginning, he could only fire it outward without much control or use it to reinforce his body and treasures. But now, Yuan could mold Eternal Essence freely, shaping it however he pleased.
As his control over Eternal Essence deepened, its power naturally grew more intense.
Now, his attacks no longer merely canceled out the Eternals' strikes. Instead, he was beginning to overpower them.
After another three months of relentless battle, Yuan defeated another Eternal, leaving only one remaining.
The moment the Eternal fell, Yuan and the remaining one immediately started absorbing their Eternal Essence.
"And now, there's only one left," Yuan said as he gazed at the massive silhouette in the distance.
"Do you truly believe you have defeated us?" the Eternal replied in a calm, almost serene voice. "We Eternals are indestructible—unkillable. All you've done is delay the inevitable.
"Perhaps I cannot kill you now. But eventually, I will find a way," said Yuan.
"Hahaha!" The Eternal burst out laughing. "Good luck with that!"
Once it finished absorbing the Eternal Essence, the remaining Eternal's strength surpassed even Saaruk at twenty percent of his true power. Meanwhile, Yuan's own growth left him only slightly behind.
"This is where you perish, mortal!" the Eternal roared, its voice shaking the void as it pressed its Eternal Essence down upon Yuan like a crushing mountain.

A vicious light flashed in Yuan's eyes as he unleashed all of his Eternal Essence to counter the attack. Although his essence was weaker, it was still strong enough to halt the Eternal's advance for a moment.
However, once that brief moment passed, the Eternal's essence resumed its descent, pressing down on Yuan with enough force to threaten his very existence.
Yuan gritted his teeth and forced himself to the limit. If his Eternal Essence wasn't strong enough, then he needed to find a way to strengthen it.
"I know you're not mature yet, but I need your help here!" Yuan suddenly muttered, almost as if he was talking to himself.
Suddenly, Yuan could feel his Dantian heating up, as if it were responding to him.
<The Spirit Tree senses ???'s essence>
<The Spirit Tree trembles with excitement>
<The Spirit Tree spreads its roots throughout your body>
Yuan felt a strange sensation stir within him, spreading rapidly through every inch of his body.
<Eternal Constitution(Incomplete) activated>

In the very next moment, the Eternal's essence pressing down on Yuan suddenly began to weaken, but it wasn't fading into nothing, and it was flowing directly into Yuan's body, almost as if it were being absorbed.
"What is going on?!" The Eternal exclaimed, puzzled, as it witnessed its essence being absorbed by Yuan at a rapid rate.
"He's absorbing my active essence?! That's impossible!"
Absorbing an Eternal's active attack was completely different from absorbing something inactive—like Shiva's essence or the remnant essence Saaruk had left in Xiao Cangming long ago.
Active essence was simply too volatile—too pure—for even most Eternals to take in.
Attempting to absorb it too hastily would be like trying to gather molten lava in the midst of an eruption rather than waiting for it to cool. If attempted, they would only injure themselves.
Although the vast majority of Eternals lacked such an ability, the strongest Eternals were capable of it, and this was one of the traits that set them above the rest.
And yet, Yuan absorbed active essence as naturally as he would absorb a cultivator's strike with spiritual energy.
"How can a mere mortal do something even I cannot?! This cannot be possible!"
Even though its eyes were hollow—mere empty outlines in the shadowy silhouette—Yuan could still discern the fear trembling within them.
Absorbing the Eternal's strike caused a tremendous surge of power within Yuan, but he knew it was only a temporary effect, and his actual Eternal Essence had hardly grown at all.

Seizing the moment, Yuan launched a swift counterattack. The Eternal immediately faltered, too afraid to unleash another attack, as it was fearful that Yuan would absorb it again and weaponize its own power against it.
"Damn it! Damn it all! How am I struggling against a mere mortal?!" the Eternal roared, its voice trembling with rage and frustration as it desperately focused on defense.

Ultimately, it took only a few days for the last Eternal to fall. Driven into desperation, it subconsciously launched another attack, but Yuan absorbed it just as easily as before, and that single mistake ended it.
<You have cleared the third trial>
The notification appeared moments later, and Yuan was brought back to the platform shortly after, where Tian'er was waiting.
