<The Spirit Tree senses ???'s essence>
<The Spirit Tree trembles with excitement>
<The Spirit Tree spreads its roots throughout your body>
Yuan felt a strange sensation stir within him, spreading rapidly through every inch of his body.
<Eternal Constitution(Incomplete) activated>

In the very next moment, the Eternal's essence pressing down on Yuan suddenly began to weaken, but it wasn't fading into nothing, and it was flowing directly into Yuan's body, almost as if it were being absorbed.
"What is going on?!" The Eternal exclaimed, puzzled, as it witnessed its essence being absorbed by Yuan at a rapid rate.
"He's absorbing my active essence?!
That's impossible!"
Absorbing an Eternal's active attack was completely different from absorbing something inactive—like Shiva's essence or the remnant essence Saaruk had left in Xiao Cangming long ago.
Active essence was simply too volatile—too pure—for even most Eternals to take in.
Attempting to absorb it too hastily would be like trying to gather molten lava in the midst of an eruption rather than waiting for it to cool.
If attempted, they would only injure themselves.
Although the vast majority of Eternals lacked such an ability, the strongest Eternals were capable of it, and this was one of the traits that set them above the rest.
And yet, Yuan absorbed active essence as naturally as he would absorb a cultivator's strike with spiritual energy.
"How can a mere mortal do something even I cannot?!
This cannot be possible!"
Even though its eyes were hollow—mere empty outlines in the shadowy silhouette—Yuan could still discern the fear trembling within them.
Absorbing the Eternal's strike caused a tremendous surge of power within Yuan, but he knew it was only a temporary effect, and his actual Eternal Essence had hardly grown at all.
Seizing the moment, Yuan launched a swift counterattack.
The Eternal immediately faltered, too afraid to unleash another attack, as it was fearful that Yuan would absorb it again and weaponize its own power against it.
"Damn it!
Damn it all!
How am I struggling against a mere mortal?!" the Eternal roared, its voice trembling with rage and frustration as it desperately focused on defense.
Ultimately, it took only a few days for the last Eternal to fall.
Driven into desperation, it subconsciously launched another attack, but Yuan absorbed it just as easily as before, and that single mistake ended it.
<You have cleared the third trial>
The notification appeared moments later, and Yuan was brought back to the platform shortly after, where Tian'er was waiting.

chapters.title: Chapter 2262 Unique Trial
paragraphs: "Great job clearing the trials, Master." Tian'er congratulated him upon his return to the platform.
"Was that the last trial?" Yuan asked.
He was sure there would be more since it would've been called the 'final' trial if it were the last one.
Tian'er shook her head and calmly responded, "No, there is one more trial."
"I figured. Then you must be here to give me my reward for clearing the previous trial."
However, Tian'er shook her head again and said, "Master, I am here to warn you about the final trial."
"Warn me...?" Yuan swallowed nervously, as this had never happened before.

Tian'er continued, "Although you haven't cleared all of the trials, you have already received the qualifications to enter the Ninth Heaven. The next trial will be the last one, and it'll be unlike any trial you've experienced before."
"If I can enter the Ninth Heaven without clearing the final trial... what's the point of the trial?"
"I don't know."
"What?" "Not only is the trial unique, but it has never been challenged before, so you'll be the first one to challenge it."

"I don't understand... why didn't my previous incarnations challenge it?" "Because the trial is time-restricted and cannot be accessed until a certain amount of time has passed. However, that restriction ended while you were still in the third trial."
"In other words, it was prepared specifically for this life..." Yuan muttered.
"Anyway," Tian'er continued, "If you wish, you may head to the Ninth Heaven right now and return to challenge the trial at a later date, but you may also choose to do the trial now."
"Does it matter if I do the trial now or later? What changes?" Yuan asked.
"Nothing changes. The reward... the difficulty... everything will remain the same regardless of when you challenge it."
"The difficulty will remain the same? Even if I were to challenge it after I become a Cultivation God?" Yuan inquired with a puzzled face.
Tian'er quietly nodded.
"In that case, I might as well do it now."
"I understand. Here is your reward for clearing the third trial."
With a gentle gesture toward the void, Tian'er drew forth a radiant crystal orb. Inside it, a strange liquid churned and sparkled, its motion reminiscent of glitter drifting through oil.
Yuan knew at a glance what this item was, as it radiated with immense Eternal Essence. It was the essence of the final Eternal he defeated.
"Since you've technically cleared the Stairway to Heaven, you can start the next trial whenever you want," Tian'er said.
Yuan nodded as he accepted the item.
"Then I'll start once I finish absorbing this."
He seated himself and wasted no time drawing the Eternal Essence out of the crystal orb.
Several days passed before he refined every last drop, and when he did, the orb crumbled into nothingness.
Yuan inspected his new prowess with a smile on his face.
"At my current level, even Saaruk at 20 percent of his prowess would be powerless before me."
Some time later, Yuan spoke out loud, "Tian'er, I should've asked this earlier, but how long will the final trial take? An estimate is fine."

"It's impossible to estimate," Tian'er's voice resounded the next moment. "It could take days... weeks... even years. It all depends on how you proceed with the trial. That said, time will feel and flow differently in the final trial, and it will be much faster than reality."
"How much faster?"
"A year in the trial will only be a minute in reality."
"That much?" Yuan swallowed nervously. The implication was clear. He would likely spend many years in the final trial.
"Whenever you are ready, Master."
Yuan closed his eyes and took a deep breath.
"Let me speak with the others first."
"Okay."
Before Yuan could even blink, he was teleported to the spectators' room, where Xiao Hua and the others were waiting.
"I wouldn't be surprised if I spend a few years in this trial, so I won't blame any of you if you wish to head to the Ninth Heaven ahead of me," Yuan said.
"Why would we do that?" Feng Yuxiang shook her head. "We've spent much longer watching you do nothing—like when you spent 20 years cultivating in White Hell."
Yuan chuckled, "You're right, but I also want you to do something for me."
"What do you need our help with?" Xiao Hua asked, seemingly eager to be of help.
"I want all of you to get stronger," he said.
"Stronger...?" Lan Yingying mumbled.

"From this point on, everything will only become more chaotic. We'll be facing experts who stand at the peak of the cultivation world... and beyond. That's why I want all of you to grow strong—strong enough to protect yourselves, should there ever come a time when I can't be there for you," he said gently.
"At the moment, the two of you are far too lacking when compared to Xiao Hua," Yuan continued, his gaze settling on Lan Yingying and Feng Yuxiang.
Lan Yingying and Feng Yuxiang had no response and could only lower their heads, feeling somewhat ashamed. They already knew this truth, even without Yuan pointing it out.
"Therefore, instead of wasting your time waiting for me, you should do something that will actually benefit you." Yuan continued.
"With your talents, I'm sure you'll be able to show significant progress by the time I finish my trial."
Lan Yingying and Feng Yuxiang exchanged defeated looks with each other.

"I get it, Young Master." Feng Yuxiang turned to face him and sighed with a bitter smile on her face, "Even though we're supposed to be the new generation of Divine Supremes, we're nothing but useless luggage at this moment."
"I possess the strongest phoenix bloodline in existence, but I am still at the Immortal Realm. If I am going to be your number one servant, I will need more than just a powerful bloodline."

Feng Yuxiang stared at Yuan in the eyes with a resolute face and declared, "I promise I'll be more useful the next time you see me, Young Master!" Yuan shook his head and said, "It's not about your usefulness. I just want you to be able to protect yourself whenever you're away from me. After all, I don't expect you to stay by my side all the time, and I don't want what happened with Bai Xutao to repeat itself."

chapters.title: Chapter 2263 Stairway to Heaven's Final Trial
paragraphs: Feng Yuxiang shuddered just from recalling her unfortunate encounter with Bai Xutao.

"You should know that I don't value my companions for their usefulness," Yuan continued. "But if you want to keep walking this dangerous path with me—one still full of unknowns—you'll need the strength to do so. Of course, I won't abandon you for being too weak or having trouble catching up, but if it comes down to your safety... I will leave you behind in a secure place until everything is over."

"After all, as your master, your companion, and your friend, it's my responsibility to ensure your safety. There's a reason I'm not traveling with Meixiu and the others right now, no matter how much I want to and how much I miss them. I can't put their lives at risk just to satisfy my own selfish desires."
"You don't have to say any more, Yuan. We'll do our best not to disappoint you," said Lan Yingying. "Unfortunately, I don't know where to start."
"I cultivate mostly through devouring other beasts, but I have never been to the Ninth Heaven..."
Yuan smiled and said, "Don't worry, I never intended to let you do this alone."

He turned to face Xiao Hua and said, "Xiao Hua, I would like you to take care of Yingying just as you had taken care of me when I first came to the Nine Heavens. Since her cultivation is the weakest, I'll feel more at ease with you by her side."
Xiao Hua calmly nodded, "I'll do my best."
"What about me?" Feng Yuxiang asked, pointing at herself. "Honestly, I don't mind traveling alone. I'm used to it, after all."
"That may be the case, but I think it'd be better to have someone with you," Yuan said to her before turning to look at Yingzi.
"What do you think, Yingzi? Can you go with her for some time? It'll be much more entertaining than being here."
While Yingzi wasn't any stronger than Feng Yuxiang, it was still better than traveling alone.

"I don't mind, but I won't be able to protect her if anything she cannot handle happens," she calmly replied. "If we were in the Primal Expanse, it would be a different story, but in this world, my options are limited."
"I am aware, but you're not much weaker than her."
Some time later, Lingyue spoke up.
"Um... what about me, Brother Yuan?
"You..." Yuan paused for a moment before answering. "Honestly, I'm not sure."

"You're only my servant because of Xiao Hua. I never intended to pull you into my problems. So tell me—what do you want? Whatever it is, I'll try my best to grant it, even if you want to walk your own path."

Lingyue shook her head and said, "As I already said, I won't know what to do if I am not by your side, so I will continue to follow you. No matter where you go or how dangerous it may be, I still wish to follow you... at least until I have my own purpose."
Yuan silently rubbed his eyes for a brief moment before sighing, "If that's what you want."
"It is!" she confirmed.
Yuan nodded before continuing, "With that being said, I am not going to treat you differently because of your circumstances. If you want to follow me, you're also going to need sufficient strength."
"I understand."
"Now the question is, which group should you follow..." Yuan pondered out loud.
"She can follow us," Xiao Hua suddenly spoke out loud. "If the dumb pigeon gets into any trouble, she won't be able to handle more than herself, so she'll be safer with us—with me."
"What?! How dare you look down on me!" Feng Yuxiang clenched her hands into fists and angrily stared at Xiao Hua.
Xiao Hua shrugged. "I'm only stating the truth."

"At your current level, you can handle ordinary third-level God Ascension cultivators at best—maybe fourth-level if we factor in your Supreme Seal. The Ninth Heaven is no playground. Countless powerhouses roam this realm, some even capable of matching my father. In this era, even I, a ninth-level God Ascension cultivator, cannot move freely without restraint."
Unable to rebuke, Feng Yuxiang could only grit her teeth in frustration.
"Then it's decided. Lingyue and Yingying will go with Xiao Hua, and the two of you will be together."
Some time later, Xiao Hua and the others prepared to leave the Stairway to Heaven.
"I promise I'll at least enter God Ascension by the time you finish your trial, Young Master!" Feng Yuxiang declared with teary eyes, looking like she was about to be separated from her lover.
"I'll aim to reach the Immortal Realm!" Lan Yingying spoke with determination.
"And I'll become a Cultivation God," Xiao Hua confidently declared.
Yuan responded with a smile, "You're making it sound like we won't see each other for decades. It'll only be a few years."
After saying their goodbyes, Xiao Hua and the others left the Stairway to Heaven and entered the Ninth Heaven.
Meanwhile, Yuan returned to the platform and prepared for the final trial.
"I am ready to begin the final trial," he declared with a resolute face.
<You have begun the final trial>
In the very next moment, Yuan felt his consciousness rapidly slipping away into the void.
When he opened his eyes again, Yuan found himself in a familiar scene, and standing before him was a familiar face.

"Tian Yang, the cultivation world isn't all fun and games. It's a vicious path that could easily lead to your death even when you're not at fault, and it's a world that we'll be stepping into soon," said the young girl.
'Meng Lili...?'
Yuan immediately recognized her.
Not only did he recognize her, but he also recognized the words she'd just spoken, as it was part of Tian Yang's memories that he'd already recovered.
'This trial must be related to Tian Yang... but...'

Yuan quickly realized that he couldn't move his body or speak out loud, almost as if he were only a spectator, watching everything from Tian Yang's body, just like when he first regained this piece of memory.

chapters.title: Chapter 2264 Stairway to Heaven's Final Trial(2)
paragraphs: "If you're afraid, then why did you agree to join the sect? You could have stayed here in the village with the others."
Just like Tian Yang's memories, Yuan repeated his words to Meng Lili.
"Although I am afraid of the cultivation world, there is something I am even more afraid of— the feeling of being powerless," she responded with a solemn look on her face.
Yuan watched everything unfold as usual, silently wondering when he would finally be allowed to begin the last trial.
However, he quickly realized that, unlike regaining his memories, which occurred in the blink of an eye, he was now reliving them second by second.
Every movement, every breath, every word that was uttered—Yuan felt himself living through it all, as though the past had become reality.
Time continued to pass, and the events unfolded just as they had before, from entering the Immortal Monastery to performing chores in the Bamboo Garden.
Then he began his life as an Outer Court disciple, constantly pushing himself to the limit in the hunting grounds, where he met Elder Sun.

After many years, he finally became an Inner Court disciple, and before he knew it, he was already preparing for the upcoming Core Disciple examination. To ready himself, he chose to train in the Desolate Continent, a land infamous for its brutal environment and fearsome beasts.
On his way to the Desolate Continent, he encountered a particular young lady and her family.
"I am Inner Disciple Huang Xiao Li! It's an honor to meet you, Senior Brother!"
After their fateful meeting, Tian Yang and the Huang Family boarded a ship bound for the Desolate Continent.
Unfortunately, during their journey, they encountered a Flying Leviathan—an infamous, rare sea beast that had dragged countless ships to their doom and devoured innumerable lives.
Although they had managed to escape the ship with a flying treasure before the Flying Leviathan destroyed it, they were unable to escape its attention, and it quickly chased after them.
During the chase, they encountered a second sea beast, an entity of incomprehensible might, far beyond anything they understood.
While Tian Yang and Huang Xiao Li managed to escape using a life-saving treasure Tian Yang hadn't even known he possessed at the time, the rest of the Huang Family was not so fortunate.
Unaware that her family had already perished, Huang Xiao Li traversed the Desolate Continent with Tian Yang, hoping to find them.
Tian Yang's relationship with Huang Xiao Li deepened over the course of their journey, and the two eventually became lovers.

But their blissful days were short-lived. The Gold and Money Bandits appeared, forcing them into a desperate escape. And as if fate itself were against them, a barrier suddenly rose around the entire continent, sealing it off entirely and preventing anyone from entering or leaving.
Huang Xiao Li was killed by the bandits during the chase, and Tian Yang would have lost his life as well if not for Kulas' intervention.
"I'm Kulas, what about you?"
After learning the situation from Kulas, Tian Yang agreed to enter Han Zexian's Tomb with him.
Right before the tomb opened, Tian Yang encountered Elder Sun and learned about the life-saving treasure she had secretly given him.

However, instead of feeling grateful, Tian Yang was furious. He blamed Elder Sun for Huang Xiao Li's death, because if he had known about the treasure beforehand, they would never have attracted the bandits' attention, and he might have even been able to save her family.
Elder Sun was so shocked by Tian Yang's outburst that she couldn't even say anything before he left, ending their relationship there.

Once the tomb opened, Tian Yang and Kulas entered and undertook its trials, obtaining numerous valuable treasures and learning powerful techniques that greatly increased their strength. Their bond strengthened through it all, evolving from friendship into something akin to brotherhood, especially after they clashed with Gu Lim.
Tian Yang also met a unique woman named Ren Xia, who was Kulas' fiancée at the time.
"Not only are you not fearful of the Immortal Clans, but you even dare to go against them... What an interesting man..."
However, Kulas and Ren Xia showed obvious disdain for one another, largely because their engagement had been arranged by their families, and the two didn't like each other.
Ren Xia joined their journey briefly before going her own way, and Kulas had achieved his goal at Han Zexian's Tomb with Tian Yang's help, obtaining the Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique.
Eventually, they discovered the location of Han Zexian's legacy and made their way to it. However, the Immortal Clans had arrived first and already seized the entire site.
Tian Yang had no intention of getting anywhere near the place, especially since he had killed Gu Lim and was being hunted by the Gu Family.
However, Han Zexian's legacy had other plans for him and forcefully dragged him to the entrance.

Since he was powerless against the Immortal Clans, Tian Yang had no choice but to enter the mountain that housed Han Zexian's legacy—a place only he could access, having received the legacy's approval.
Inside, he discovered the existence of beings far beyond their comprehension and even learned the method to communicate with one of them.
While Tian Yang spent many years secluded within the mountain, Kulas was captured by the Immortal Clans and subjected to relentless interrogation and years of torture.
When Tian Yang finally left Han Zexian's tomb after many long years, he immediately sought out Ren Xia, hoping to learn what had become of Kulas.
That was when he discovered the truth of Kulas' fate.
At this point, Yuan wondered if the final trial was just going to show him all of Tian Yang's experiences.
And since he was still missing many of Tian Yang's memories, he hoped that would be the case.
Some years later, Tian Yang and Ren Xia worked together to free Kulas from the Immortal Confinement Dungeon.
After that, Tian Yang and Ren Xia continued messing with the Immortal Clans until a particular rumor of a certain individual began to spread.

sentences.text: "If you're afraid, then why did you agree to join the sect?
You could have stayed here in the village with the others."
Just like Tian Yang's memories, Yuan repeated his words to Meng Lili.
"Although I am afraid of the cultivation world, there is something I am even more afraid of— the feeling of being powerless," she responded with a solemn look on her face.
Yuan watched everything unfold as usual, silently wondering when he would finally be allowed to begin the last trial.
However, he quickly realized that, unlike regaining his memories, which occurred in the blink of an eye, he was now reliving them second by second.
Every movement, every breath, every word that was uttered—Yuan felt himself living through it all, as though the past had become reality.
Time continued to pass, and the events unfolded just as they had before, from entering the Immortal Monastery to performing chores in the Bamboo Garden.
Then he began his life as an Outer Court disciple, constantly pushing himself to the limit in the hunting grounds, where he met Elder Sun.
After many years, he finally became an Inner Court disciple, and before he knew it, he was already preparing for the upcoming Core Disciple examination.
To ready himself, he chose to train in the Desolate Continent, a land infamous for its brutal environment and fearsome beasts.
On his way to the Desolate Continent, he encountered a particular young lady and her family.
"I am Inner Disciple Huang Xiao Li!
It's an honor to meet you, Senior Brother!"
After their fateful meeting, Tian Yang and the Huang Family boarded a ship bound for the Desolate Continent.
Unfortunately, during their journey, they encountered a Flying Leviathan—an infamous, rare sea beast that had dragged countless ships to their doom and devoured innumerable lives.
Although they had managed to escape the ship with a flying treasure before the Flying Leviathan destroyed it, they were unable to escape its attention, and it quickly chased after them.
During the chase, they encountered a second sea beast, an entity of incomprehensible might, far beyond anything they understood.
While Tian Yang and Huang Xiao Li managed to escape using a life-saving treasure Tian Yang hadn't even known he possessed at the time, the rest of the Huang Family was not so fortunate.
Unaware that her family had already perished, Huang Xiao Li traversed the Desolate Continent with Tian Yang, hoping to find them.
Tian Yang's relationship with Huang Xiao Li deepened over the course of their journey, and the two eventually became lovers.
But their blissful days were short-lived.
The Gold and Money Bandits appeared, forcing them into a desperate escape.
And as if fate itself were against them, a barrier suddenly rose around the entire continent, sealing it off entirely and preventing anyone from entering or leaving.
Huang Xiao Li was killed by the bandits during the chase, and Tian Yang would have lost his life as well if not for Kulas' intervention.
"I'm Kulas, what about you?"
After learning the situation from Kulas, Tian Yang agreed to enter Han Zexian's Tomb with him.
Right before the tomb opened, Tian Yang encountered Elder Sun and learned about the life-saving treasure she had secretly given him.
However, instead of feeling grateful, Tian Yang was furious.

He blamed Elder Sun for Huang Xiao Li's death, because if he had known about the treasure beforehand, they would never have attracted the bandits' attention, and he might have even been able to save her family.
Elder Sun was so shocked by Tian Yang's outburst that she couldn't even say anything before he left, ending their relationship there.
Once the tomb opened, Tian Yang and Kulas entered and undertook its trials, obtaining numerous valuable treasures and learning powerful techniques that greatly increased their strength.
Their bond strengthened through it all, evolving from friendship into something akin to brotherhood, especially after they clashed with Gu Lim.
Tian Yang also met a unique woman named Ren Xia, who was Kulas' fiancée at the time.
"Not only are you not fearful of the Immortal Clans, but you even dare to go against them...
What an interesting man..."
However, Kulas and Ren Xia showed obvious disdain for one another, largely because their engagement had been arranged by their families, and the two didn't like each other.
Ren Xia joined their journey briefly before going her own way, and Kulas had achieved his goal at Han Zexian's Tomb with Tian Yang's help, obtaining the Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique.
Eventually, they discovered the location of Han Zexian's legacy and made their way to it.
However, the Immortal Clans had arrived first and already seized the entire site.
Tian Yang had no intention of getting anywhere near the place, especially since he had killed Gu Lim and was being hunted by the Gu Family.
However, Han Zexian's legacy had other plans for him and forcefully dragged him to the entrance.

Since he was powerless against the Immortal Clans, Tian Yang had no choice but to enter the mountain that housed Han Zexian's legacy—a place only he could access, having received the legacy's approval.
Inside, he discovered the existence of beings far beyond their comprehension and even learned the method to communicate with one of them.
While Tian Yang spent many years secluded within the mountain, Kulas was captured by the Immortal Clans and subjected to relentless interrogation and years of torture.
When Tian Yang finally left Han Zexian's tomb after many long years, he immediately sought out Ren Xia, hoping to learn what had become of Kulas.
That was when he discovered the truth of Kulas' fate.
At this point, Yuan wondered if the final trial was just going to show him all of Tian Yang's experiences.
And since he was still missing many of Tian Yang's memories, he hoped that would be the case.
Some years later, Tian Yang and Ren Xia worked together to free Kulas from the Immortal Confinement Dungeon.
After that, Tian Yang and Ren Xia continued messing with the Immortal Clans until a particular rumor of a certain individual began to spread.

chapters.title: Chapter 2265 Fated to Suffer
paragraphs: Over a hundred years had passed since Tian Yang rescued Kulas from the Immortal Confinement Dungeon.
In all that time, he hadn't heard a single word about Kulas's whereabouts, and devoted himself entirely to destroying the Immortal Clans.
As Ren Xia had wished, they began with the Immortal Sword Clan.

The Immortal Sword Clan had been struggling even before Ren Xia's betrayal, leaving them already weakened. After she turned on them and ruined their plans to sell her off through a political marriage, the clan was essentially half-destroyed even without any further interference.

Although they still carried the title of an Immortal Clan in the eyes of the public, in reality, the other Immortal Clans had already severed all ties with the Immortal Sword Clan and no longer considered them one of their own.

Although Ren Xia didn't go as far as killing her own parents or relatives, she struck directly at the Ren Family's businesses, weakening their already fragile position to the point where they had no choice but to relinquish their status as an Immortal Clan and revert to simply being the Ren Family.
Under normal circumstances, another family would have risen to take their place, but due to the ongoing chaos, the Immortal Clans were forced to postpone the selection.
"Now that the Ren Family is no longer an Immortal Clan, they'll definitely be targeted by all the people they've offended in the past," Tian Yang said.
"So what? They deserve whatever comes their way," Ren Xia replied, her tone casual as she gazed out the window of their hotel room.

"What about you? Now that you've brought down your family and achieved your goal, what are you going to do next? Walk your own path?" Ren Xia shifted her gaze from the outside view to glare at Tian Yang in the face before responding, "One goal. I have two goals in mind when I decided to follow you, and I have only achieved one of them so far."
"What is your second goal, then?" Tian Yang asked.
Ren Xia narrowed her eyes at him, silently staring at him.
A moment later, she stood up and walked over with a mischievous smile. Tian Yang quietly observed her movements as he sat by the table.

"Are you asking that because you genuinely don't know, or because you're pretending not to notice?" she whispered while slipping onto his lap, her soft hips molding against him. One slender arm curled around his neck, guiding his face toward hers.
Tian Yang met her gaze calmly and sighed. "How can you act like this when you just brought about your own family's downfall?"
"And why are you trying to change the subject?" Ren Xia shot back almost immediately. "I may not look it, but my heart is anything but calm right now. In such a state, I might do something rash..."
Ren Xia suddenly reached for his chest with her other arm.
Tian Yang shut his eyes, a quiet sigh escaping him. "You should reconsider. Anyone who gets too close to me is fated to suffer."
"That... doesn't sound like a rejection? How surprising."

By this point, Tian Yang had known Ren Xia far longer than he had known Huang Xiao Li, and the two had survived multiple life-and-death ordeals together. Although he had tried his best not to develop feelings for her, such restraint was nearly impossible, especially considering Ren Xia's overwhelming charm and his own lack of experience in such emotions.
When Tian Yang didn't respond, Ren Xia repeated, this time in a softer voice, "I said... it doesn't sound like a rejection..."
"If you don't give me a clear rejection, I won't be able to help myself." She continued, slowly reaching into his robes and caressing his bare chest.
Tian Yang opened his eyes at this moment and stared into her eyes.
"Don't say I didn't warn you later," he said in a clear voice.
Ren Xia froze, eyes widening in shock. She had only been teasing and never thought he'd actually accept her. But her feelings were genuine, and since he didn't refuse her—
Without hesitation, Ren Xia closed the remaining distance between them and pressed her lips to his in a deep, passionate kiss.
After a long moment, it was only when she finally ran out of breath that Ren Xia parted their lips. Her gaze, filled with longing and desire, remained locked on him.
"I..." Tian Yang tried to speak but was immediately interrupted.
"I don't care." She pressed a finger against his lips. "Even if you've changed your mind, it's too late now. If you want to regret it, do it afterward."

Not wanting to waste another second, she rose to her feet and pulled him toward the bed, where she stripped him of his clothes, as well as her own, before savoring every inch of his body from top to bottom.
At this point, there was truly no going back.
Not even half a day after the Immortal Sword Clan had surrendered their title, Ren Xia surrendered her first time to Tian Yang, allowing his sword to penetrate deep within her body.
While the other Immortal Clans hunted them without sleep or rest, the two of them drowned themselves in each other's embrace for days—weeks, even—ignoring the world outside.
As Tian Yang lay on the bed, his body drenched in sweat and other lingering traces of their passion, he muttered softly, "Try not to die before I do."
With her head resting on his arm, Ren Xia smiled contentedly.
"If everyone close to you suffers, then I'm probably going to die soon."
She brushed her cheek against him and added playfully, "In that case, we might as well do this as often as possible, so you'll have more memories to reminisce about when I am gone."
"You truly are something else..." Tian Yang sighed with a defeated smile.
After only a brief rest, Ren Xia wasted no time. True to her earlier words, she initiated another session, her movements full of energy and intent, almost as if it were their first time.

chapters.title: Chapter 2266 The Great Mammoth
paragraphs: "There's a peculiar rumor going around," Ren Xia started a conversation as she rested beside Tian Yang on the bed.
"Is the rumor related to the Immortal Clans?" Tian Yang asked.
"No, not exactly."
"Then it doesn't concern me," he said in a blunt, indifferent tone.
"Are you sure you're not interested? You might regret it."
Tian Yang narrowed his eyes slightly. Knowing Ren Xia's character, she wouldn't be so persistent in a subject if it wasn't serious or if it was related to him.
"If there's something you want to tell me, just tell me. No need to beat around the bush," he sighed.

Ren Xia suddenly lifted herself and positioned herself on top of Tian Yang, sitting on his body. Then, with an entertained smile, she spoke, "According to this rumor, someone claiming to be the 'Great Mammoth' recently declared himself as the ruler of the Desolate Continent."
"Great Mammoth?" Tian Yang raised his eyebrows at this familiar name.
Ren Xia gave a calm nod and continued, "And from what witnesses say, he's a complete monster, standing almost four meters tall with an unprecedented physique."
Tian Yang shot up from the bed after hearing the details, his eyes wide with shock.
"Oh!" Ren Xia, who was sitting on top of him, fell backwards but gracefully caught herself.
"Doesn't that sound like someone we know?" she chuckled.
"It has to be Kulas!" Tian Yang exclaimed.
He finally realized why the name Great Mammoth was familiar. It was the name of the technique he'd given Kulas—Great Mammoth Body Refinement!
"What are the Immortal Clan's reaction? Have they done anything yet?" he then asked.
Ren Xia curled her arms around his neck, letting out a soft sigh.
"I wish you'd show me even a little of the passion you always have for Kulas."

"Are you saying that you'd rather be in Kulas' situation rather than what you currently have right now?" Ren Xia fell silent for a moment before speaking again, "I don't think the Immortal Clan is aware of his identity."
She completely changed the topic. Clearly, she was satisfied with her situation after giving it some thought
"What makes you think so?" Tian Yang asked.

"Well, this rumor has been floating around for two weeks already. There's no way the Immortal Clans haven't heard it, but they haven't shown the slightest response. They've been behaving as if nothing happened."

"Moreover, unless they learned about the Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique from Kulas, they won't immediately make the connections just by his size. With that said, even if they realize his identity, I doubt they'll do anything to him now, especially how much we've weakened them."

It had been over three hundred years since the fall of the Immortal Sword Clan, and throughout that time, the two of them relentlessly chipped away at the Immortal Clans' strength. Once untouchable, those clans were now mere shadows of their former power.
Even if they were aware of Kulas' return, he would be at the very bottom of the priority list with Tian Yang and Ren Xia at the very top.

Naturally, Tian Yang and Ren Xia's infamy wasn't confined to the Immortal Clans alone. Across the whole Divine Heaven, their names resounded with fear and awe alike—Tian Yang, the Immortal Slayer, and Ren Xia, the Sword Goddess.

While their names struck fear into the hearts of many, even becoming a warning used to discipline unruly children, just as many revered them. After all, they had done the unthinkable by defying the Immortal Clans and driving them to near ruin.
Even if they were to die tomorrow at the hands of the Immortal Clans, the clans' reputation would never recover, and the shadow of Tian Yang and Ren Xia would forever loom over them.
In fact, after so many years of failure, it wasn't just the ordinary people—even the Immortal Clans themselves no longer believed they could defeat Tian Yang and Ren Xia.
"I guess so..." Tian Yang muttered with a pondering look on his face.
"Are you going to see him?" Ren Xia suddenly asked.
Tian Yang closed his eyes and remained silent for a moment.
"No," he replied in a clear voice.
"Really?" Ren Xia's eyes widened with surprise, as she had already prepared to travel to the Desolate Continent with him.
"Why not?" she inquired.

"He essentially vanished the day we rescued him. Now that I know he's alive and well, I won't endanger him by dragging him into our mess. If I'm going to meet him again, it'll be after we've completely erased the Immortal Clans from existence," he said, his voice filled with resolve.
If they were to meet Kulas right now, the Immortal Clan would definitely go after Kulas, too. "That said, I should still keep an eye on him just in case anything happens," he added a moment later.
"How are you going to do that without getting close to him?"
"I'll hire somebody to watch over him."
"You're acting like a stalker." Ren Xia chuckled.
"If that's how it seems, then so be it. As long as I can protect him properly this time, nothing else matters."
With that resolve, Tian Yang and Ren Xia intensified their assaults on the Immortal Clans, moving with a slightly greater urgency than before, as though something had spurred them forward.

Time continued to pass, and as the Immortal Clans grew weaker and lost influence, Kulas—now known as the Great Mammoth—rose in the opposite direction. He became a powerhouse and an authoritative figure within the Desolate Continent, eventually establishing himself as its undisputed ruler.

Although Tian Yang sought the downfall of the Immortal Clans, he never confronted them through outright slaughter. He wasn't looking for massacres. If he had truly wanted to destroy them, he could have easily wiped out every member of their clans besides the Patriarchs.
Instead, he chose a different approach and targeted their businesses and allies, undermining their influence and shattering their reputation, only killing when absolutely necessary.
In this way, the Immortal Clans were forced to watch their influence and power decay year after year—slowly and painfully—much like the torture they had once inflicted on Kulas.

chapters.title: Chapter 2267 The Immortal Clans' Downfall
paragraphs: Ten years... fifty years... two hundred years...
Two hundred more years went by, and the Immortal Clans had been reduced to a state nearly unrecognizable.

They were no longer the haughty, untouchable powerhouses they had once been. Now, they were no different from ordinary families—shunned by the rest of the world, largely because people feared the consequences of siding with them. After all, Tian Yang targeted anyone who remained close to the Immortal Clans.

With their power reduced to this pitiful state, Tian Yang could eradicate them whenever he wished. Yet he chose to let them linger, allowing the remnants of the Immortal Clans to spend their final days drowning in regret for ever offending him. As for Patriarch Gu and those directly responsible for torturing Kulas, Tian Yang showed no such mercy, and he crippled every one of them, stripping away not only their cultivation but their limbs as well.
By now, Tian Yang had ascended to the Golden Immortal realm, with Ren Xia trailing just a step behind at Silver Immortal.

Though his time within Han Zexian's tomb had greatly accelerated his cultivation, Tian Yang's growth had slowed sharply afterward. Even after consuming countless treasures to refine his aptitude, his talent was still merely above average.
Ren Xia, on the other hand, continued to advance at a remarkable pace. Her natural talent allowed her to steadily close the gap between them.

The only reason Tian Yang even managed to reach the Golden Immortal realm was mainly due to plundering the Immortal Confinement Dungeon after learning about its vault and finding its new location, or he would still be a Silver Immortal right now.

That said, Tian Yang's cultivation was slightly deceiving, as he also possessed numerous powerful martial techniques that gave him a massive advantage over other cultivators, allowing him to defeat most around his cultivation with ease.
"Did you hear about the Desolate Continent? It's no longer sealed off." Ren suddenly started the conversation as they sipped tea in a private room inside a high-end restaurant.
Tian Yang slowly placed down his teacup and responded, "Of course."

Over the years, Kulas established his own family and empire within the Desolate Continent. Then, without warning, he sealed off the entire continent, forcing out all who were not part of the Giant Race—a race he had personally created. Those who dared to resist were killed on sight.

Because of this, Tian Yang could no longer watch over him. However, since only Kulas and his family would exist on the continent, he wasn't too worried. That said, he was curious about the reason behind the sudden seclusion.
It had been over a hundred years since then, and just as abruptly as the Desolate Continent had been sealed, it was now being reopened to the public for reasons unknown.
"Now that the Immortal Clans are no longer an issue, do you plan on visiting him?" Ren Xia asked.
Tian Yang took a moment to respond.
"I'm... not sure. It's been almost half a millennium since we last met. I wouldn't be surprised if he has forgotten about me."
"Are you really saying that after all this time? But if you're truly curious whether he's forgotten you or not, go see him."
Tian Yang raised his teacup and sipped on it before responding, "I guess so. It's not like we have anything else to do at this moment."

Since achieving their goal of bringing down the Immortal Clans, the pair embraced a tranquil, almost retired existence together, roaming the Divine Heavens at leisure while steadily refining their cultivation in peace.
With their next journey decided, they set off for the Desolate Continent, now called the Giant's Continent.
Although the couple could easily fly to their destination, they decided to take the ship instead, as neither of them was in a rush to see Kulas.

The journey to the Giant's Continent stirred the bitter memories Tian Yang had long buried, from his first encounter with the Huang Family, the true beginning of his path as a cultivator, to Han Zexian's Tomb, where he had first met Huang Xiao Li, Kulas, and Ren Xia.

"I never told you about my first journey to the Desolate Continent... did I?" Tian Yang muttered, his voice tinged with distant nostalgia.
"You've told me many things about yourself, but you have always avoided talking about the Desolate Continent."
Tian Yang looked at her with a warm smile.
"Are you willing to hear about it now?"
She quietly nodded.
Without further ado, Tian Yang began recalling his story to Ren Xia, from his first meeting with Huang Xiao Li, his first love, to their meeting.
After listening to Tian Yang's story, Ren Xia finally understood the depth of his hatred toward the Immortal Clans, something he had never spoken of outright.
His story not only revealed the reason behind his relentless pursuit of them, but also the exact moment Tian Yang had become the man he was today—the man she loved.

It was a tragic story, yet Ren Xia couldn't help feeling grateful for the path it had carved. Had even a single detail of the past shifted, she might never have crossed paths with Tian Yang, condemned to remain nothing more than a tool of her family.

"Perhaps the real reason why I refused to visit Kulas before wasn't because I didn't want to disturb Kulas' peace, but because I was simply not ready to return to the Desolate Continent," Tian Yang sighed.
"Well, how are you feeling now?" Ren Xia asked.
Tian Yang looked at her with a gentle smile. "If it weren't for you, I wouldn't be here right now."
Ren Xia's eyes widened, delight shimmering within them.
Saying nothing, she took his hand and pulled him to the bed, where they passionately embraced until the ship arrived at its destination.

They were no longer the haughty, untouchable powerhouses they had once been.
Now, they were no different from ordinary families—shunned by the rest of the world, largely because people feared the consequences of siding with them.
After all, Tian Yang targeted anyone who remained close to the Immortal Clans.
With their power reduced to this pitiful state, Tian Yang could eradicate them whenever he wished.
Yet he chose to let them linger, allowing the remnants of the Immortal Clans to spend their final days drowning in regret for ever offending him.

As for Patriarch Gu and those directly responsible for torturing Kulas, Tian Yang showed no such mercy, and he crippled every one of them, stripping away not only their cultivation but their limbs as well.
By now, Tian Yang had ascended to the Golden Immortal realm, with Ren Xia trailing just a step behind at Silver Immortal.
Though his time within Han Zexian's tomb had greatly accelerated his cultivation, Tian Yang's growth had slowed sharply afterward.
Even after consuming countless treasures to refine his aptitude, his talent was still merely above average.
Ren Xia, on the other hand, continued to advance at a remarkable pace.
Her natural talent allowed her to steadily close the gap between them.

The only reason Tian Yang even managed to reach the Golden Immortal realm was mainly due to plundering the Immortal Confinement Dungeon after learning about its vault and finding its new location, or he would still be a Silver Immortal right now.

That said, Tian Yang's cultivation was slightly deceiving, as he also possessed numerous powerful martial techniques that gave him a massive advantage over other cultivators, allowing him to defeat most around his cultivation with ease.

chapters.title: Chapter 2268 The Real Giant's Continent
paragraphs: "Attention, esteemed passengers. We will be arriving at our destination, the Desolate Continent, now known as the Giant's Continent, shortly. Please prepare to deboard!" The captain's voice resounded through the speakers.

'Looks like we didn't get attacked by sea beasts this time...' Tian Yang thought as he calmly gazed toward the horizon, where a vast stretch of land slowly came into view, growing clearer and larger with every passing moment.
Half an hour later, the captain's voice returned.
"We've arrived at our destination. Thank you all for boarding with the Purple Lion today! If you wish to return home, there will be another ship arriving in two weeks."
After disembarking the ship, Tian Yang and Ren Xia immediately began wandering the continent to see if anything had changed.
"Wow, they really remodeled this entire place, didn't they?" Ren Xia remarked after scattering her divine sense and seeing the changes.
When they had last visited during the exploration of Han Zexian's Tomb, the only paths on this continent were the ones carved naturally over countless years of wear.
But now, proper roads stretched before them—broad, structured, and astonishingly massive in width, almost as if they were made for large beasts rather than humans.

The cities had changed just as dramatically as the roads, completely transformed and expanded severalfold. Even the smallest buildings now stood tall and imposing, while the largest structures soared so high they seemed to pierce the clouds.

And it wasn't only the roads and buildings that had changed. The entire continent itself had grown to an immense scale, so vast that humans wandering upon it were reduced to the size of ants in comparison.

As for the dwellers on this continent, everyone from the Giant's Race was at least three times larger than an adult human. Setting aside their brief encounter with Kulas in the Immortal Confinement Dungeon, this was Tian Yang and Ren Xia's first true sighting of the Giant Race, despite the race having existed for over a century.
The giants never stepped beyond the borders of their continent, so seeing one was only possible here.
"Just how did they grow so massive? Did Kulas teach everyone the Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique?" Ren Xia wondered out loud after seeing the giants.

Tian Yang replied, "The Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique isn't something anyone can learn. Even if Kulas passed the technique to everyone in the Giant's Race, only a few of them would be able to achieve such a level of mastery, not to mention the extreme cultivation method it demanded."
"Then how do you explain the Giant's Race? Don't tell me they're all Kulas' children?"
"We'll find out if we ask him."
The two entered the nearest city to ask for directions.
"Hey, do you know where I can meet the Great Mammoth?" Tian Yang approached a passing giant and asked.
"Great Mammoth? You mean His Majesty, Giant Emperor Kulas?" The giant replied.
"What?" Tian Yang's eyes widened at Kulas' name being spoken.
Since when did Kulas stop hiding his identity?
Seeing Tian Yang's puzzled face, the giant explained, "Great Mammoth was the Giant Emperor's warrior name. He now goes by his true name."

'Did he stop hiding because he's aware of the Immortal Clans' downfall?' Ren Xia spoke to Tian Yang using voice transmission. 'Or he's now powerful enough that the Immortal Clans no longer scare him,' he said.
"Anyway, why are you looking for the Giant Emperor? He's not someone you can meet just because you want to." The giant suddenly asked.
"We're his acquaintances," said Tian Yang.
Although he could've claimed to be friends with Kulas, nobody would believe him, so he went for the most believable choice.
The giant narrowed his eyes and gave them a suspicious look.
"What's your name?" he then asked.
Tian Yang didn't hesitate to give his real name.
"Tian Yang."
The giant's eyes widened with surprise.
"Y-You're Tian Yang?! Really?!" he exclaimed.
Tian Yang raised his eyebrows and asked, "You know me?"
"Of course!" he nodded. "There is nobody among the Giant's Race who doesn't know your name since Giant Emperor Kulas told us to be on the lookout for you!
"So he's expecting me?" Tian Yang muttered.
"Sure is! The Giant Emperor said to send you his way the moment we see you."

The giant wasted no time pointing in a specific direction and said, "You can find the Giant Emperor at the Colossal Mammoth City. When you meet him, please tell him that it was I, Karan, who sent you his way!" "Alright..." Tian Yang nodded, looking somewhat speechless.
"By the way, are you Kulas' children?" Ren Xia suddenly asked.
"Huh? Who are you?"
She pointed at Tian Yang and said, "His wife."
"Ah, then you must be Ren Xia."
"You also know me?" It was Ren Xia's turn to be surprised.

"Yes." Karan nodded before continuing, "And to answer your question, every giant is the Giant Emperor's children in a way, since we have all received his family's blood. However, only those who possess the Mammoth Bloodline are considered his true descendants."
"So he didn't teach you the Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique?" Ren Xia continued to ask.

"What? There's no way that would happen!" Karan responded with a surprised expression. "Only his true descendants would have such a privilege! However, we've all been blessed with a body refinement technique by the Giant Emperor. Why are you asking these questions?"
"Just curious."
"Well, if you want to know more, please meet the Giant Emperor. He's been waiting for your arrival for many years now. Now, if you'll excuse me."
Karan gave them a polite bow before resuming his day.
Tian Yang and Ren Xia didn't linger in the city and left shortly after.

"So they never learned the Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique from Kulas, but they did receive his blood. Does this mean his blood is the secret behind the Giant's Race? This is getting more and more interesting." Ren Xia wondered out loud as they made their way to the Colossal Mammoth City.

chapters.title: Chapter 2269 Verifying His Identity
paragraphs: As Tian Yang and Ren Xia made their way to the Colossal Mammoth City, they encountered several magical beasts that only existed within Giant's Continent. Not only were they as massive as giants, but they also possessed overwhelming strength that far exceeded their cultivation level.
For instance, a magical beast at the first level of Divine Emperor displayed combat prowess comparable to a Divine Ancestor, which was an entire realm higher.
Moreover, magical beasts were naturally stronger than cultivators of the same realm, and when compared to humans, the gap became even more immense.
"Good heavens, I have never seen beasts this massive before." Ren Xia remarked after slaying a giant bird that was nearly 300 meters long.
"You think they also absorbed some of Kulas' blood?" she looked at Tian Yang and asked.
"I cannot fathom why Kulas would feed his blood to these beasts," he said while shaking his head.
Ren Xia thought for a moment before speaking.

"I've heard the Giant Race possesses immense strength—far beyond that of humans. Even an ordinary giant who has never trained could give a seasoned body refiner a difficult fight. Perhaps the beasts on this continent were too weak before, so Kulas strengthened them."
"That's...actually very logical." Tian Yang agreed with her reasoning.
"However, can his blood even do something like this?" he then questioned. "Isn't that what the Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique does? It turns him into a giant?" Ren Xia asked.

"No, it doesn't automatically make them big, but it allows the person who learned it the ability to transform their size at will. I also learned the Great Mammoth Body Refinement, you know? While I am nowhere near Kulas' level, I am able to make myself bigger if I want to."

"What?! This is the first time I am hearing about this!" Ren Xia exclaimed, her eyes shimmering with excitement. "If you can adjust your body size at will, does that mean you can also adjust the size of your...'that'?" Ren Xia asked, her gaze lowering to the sword between his legs. "What kind of question is that?" Tian Yang frowned, looking slightly offended.
Ren Xia chuckled, "Ah, I'm not trying to say that I am not satisfied with your current size—if that's what you're worried about. I am just curious."
Tian Yang sighed, "How the hell am I supposed to know? I never tried."
He lowered his head to look at his manhood and silently tried using the Great Mammoth Body Refinement on it.
"Did it work?" Ren Xia asked with a slight smile.
"Who knows?" Without answering her, Tian Yang continued flying to the Colossal Mammoth City.
"Wait! You can't leave me hanging like this!" Ren Xia cried out loud as she chased after him.
Over the next several days, Ren Xia continued to pester Tian Yang for an answer. However, he ignored her. Eventually, they reached their destination.
"So this is the Colossal Mammoth City. It's even larger than I imagined, and I was being quite generous with my guesses," Ren Xia remarked as they hovered before the magnificent city.

Although the city was far larger and more extravagant than the others, what truly set it apart was the majestic castle dominating half its area. The structure was so immense that not even a row of a dozen towering mountains could cover its length from end to end.
"I guess we should head straight for the castle," Tian Yang said.
However, right as they got close to the castle, several giants appeared before them, blocking their path.
"Humans are not allowed beyond this point," said one of them.
"My name is Tian Yang, and I am here to meet Giant Emperor Kulas."
"Tian Yang? Are you sure?" "Yes, I am sure."
After a moment of silence, one of them spoke, "Follow us."
Tian Yang and Ren Xia followed these giants, but they were not led into the castle. Instead, they were brought to a building outside the castle.
"Where is this?"
"The interrogation room. Someone will be here shortly to verify your identity."
"Is that so?"
Tian Yang and Ren Xia sat calmly in the same chair, which was massive enough to seat several people with ease.

Some time later, a beautiful woman with golden hair and emerald eyes stepped into the building. Though her aura unmistakably belonged to a giant, her body was no larger than that of an ordinary human.
Taking a seat across from them, she asked, "Are you the one who claims to be Tian Yang?"
"Indeed."
"Then I'll be asking you several questions now. If you fail even a single one, you'll be executed for daring to trick us," she said.
Without giving them a chance to respond, the woman began asking her questions, "How did you first meet the Giant Emperor?"
Tian Yang calmly responded, "I was on the verge of death when he showed up and saved me with some medicine."
The woman immediately wrote down his answer on a large piece of paper.
"What were the treasures the Giant Emperor gave you within the Han Zexian's Tomb?"
Tian Yang raised an eyebrow and said, "That happened several hundred years ago, so give me a moment to think."
He closed his eyes and recalled all of the treasures he'd received from Kulas, who acquired them from the trials he completed.
"How many exchanges did the Giant Emperor have with a certain individual surnamed Gu?"
"The hell? How am I supposed to know that when I was busy dealing with the other guy? I doubt even Kulas himself knows the answer."
The woman didn't say anything and only wrote down his answer.
"When was the last time you met the Giant Emperor?" she then asked.
"At the Immortal Confinement Dungeon. I am still waiting for a thank you from him, by the way."
Several more questions later, the woman stood up and said, "I am done here. I'll return once I verify your identity."
Without elaborating, she left the building.

chapters.title: Chapter 2270 Tian Yang's Reunion With Kulas
paragraphs: After she left, the blonde woman entered the palace.
Some time later, she stood before a lone colossal silhouette sitting on a grand throne at the end of the room.
"I have returned, Father." The woman bowed to him.
"How did that man who claims to be Tian Yang look to you?" The silhouette asked.
"Well, I've never met him before, so I can't really say whether he's real or not. However, he answered the questions quite calmly," she said.
The silhouette extended his massive arm—thick enough to carry mountains—toward her and silently beckoned.
The woman nodded and offered the piece of paper on which she had written Tian Yang's answers to him.
The entire room fell dead silent as the silhouette read the answers.
A moment later, the entire palace trembled as the silhouette burst out laughing.
"F-Father?!" The woman exclaimed, looking baffled.
"Bring him to me!" he spoke in a demanding and urgent voice, refusing to elaborate further.
"Yes!" The woman said before hastily leaving.
Meanwhile, as Tian Yang and Ren Xia waited for the woman's return, the ground suddenly trembled beneath them, followed by the unmistakable sound of someone laughing.
"What a powerful presence," Ren Xia remarked, feeling the energy that rippled through the air with that laughter.
"It must be Kulas. I guess he'd just received my answers," said Tian Yang.
Minutes later, the woman returned.
"Come with me. The Giant Emperor has summoned you," she said.
Tian Yang and Ren Xia followed her, while a group of giant guards trailed behind them, watching their every move to ensure they didn't attempt anything suspicious.
They entered the palace shortly later and continued following the woman through the massive halls.
As they walked, one of the guards suddenly spoke, a hint of hesitation in his voice, "Your highness, that voice just now... was that..."
"Yes, it was my father. Surprising, wasn't it?" she responded without stopping or looking back.
"Yes... I have never heard His Majesty laugh in such a manner before."

"Me neither." The woman turned to look at Tian Yang and continued, "Whether he's laughing because he's angry that another imposter showed up or he's the real deal... I guess we'll find out soon enough."
Tian Yang raised an eyebrow. "Do impostors show up often, claiming to be me? And how would they even know about my relationship with Kulas?"

She replied, "Plenty of humans come seeking an audience with the Giant Emperor. Sometimes, one of us accidentally mentions your name since we were all instructed to remember it, and those humans seize the chance, claiming to be you just to meet the Giant Emperor."
"How did it end?" Ren Xia asked, curiosity in her voice.

"Not well," the woman replied. "And not just for the humans who lied. The Giant Emperor was furious the first time it happened, and many suffered that day, giant or not. Since then, we've started requiring verification before we let anyone claiming to be Tian Yang meet the Giant Emperor."
Eventually, they arrived at their destination.
The woman knocked on the colossal doors and called out, "Father, it's me. I've brought them."
For a brief moment, everything fell silent. Then, the doors burst open with such force that a violent gust of wind surged outward, threatening to pull everyone into the room.
A voice, overbearing and regal, resounded the next moment. "Enter."
Yet, it couldn't fully conceal the excitement simmering beneath it.
Tian Yang and Ren Xia calmly moved forward, entering the dimmed room.
But the moment the others tried to follow, the voice boomed with overwhelming force,
"I will not allow anyone to interfere with our reunion!
His overbearing voice surged past Tian Yang and Ren Xia, shoving the others back. The doors slammed shut an instant later without producing the slightest noise.
Within the chamber, Tian Yang's eyes were immediately drawn to the colossal figure seated upon a grand throne. The shadows hid his face, but the sunlight illuminated the rest of him clearly.
His body was titanic beyond reason—a fortress of muscle, with veins as wide as rivers coursing across his frame.
After a moment of stillness, Tian Yang broke the silence first.
"It doesn't feel like I am meeting with a friend, much less a sworn brother."
The colossal silhouette, which appeared as rigid and immovable as a mountain, suddenly trembled at the sound of his voice.
"Oh my—how unbecoming of me. The excitement of seeing you again must have clouded my senses for a moment," the silhouette said, slowly rising from the throne.

Once he stepped off the platform and into the light, Tian Yang could finally see Kulas' face again after hundreds of years. Although he had grown more mature and now sported a short beard, Tian Yang still recognized Kulas instantly.
Before either of them could speak, Kulas' massive body began to shrink, rapidly condensing until he stood at the size of an ordinary adult human.
"I appreciate it. I don't think my neck could handle looking up at you for too long," Tian Yang said with a smile.
"How could I share words with my sworn brother while looking down on him?" Kulas answered, his smile matching Tian Yang's.
"You seem to be doing well—at least much better than when I last saw you," said Tian Yang.
Kulas awkwardly scratched his head and said, "Before I can even thank you for getting me out of that place, I must apologize to you for not recognizing you. I even attacked you."
He lowered his head and apologized in a sincere tone, "I'm sorry for failing to recognize you."
Tian Yang calmly shook his head.
"There's really no need to apologize. I don't even blame you. Hell, if I had been in your shoes, I would've likely not recognized me, either."
Kulas lifted his head and chuckled, "I bet. You have no idea how many times they drugged me or used illusions, trying to extract information on you."
A guilty expression appeared on Tian Yang's face as he replied, "Honestly, I should be the one apologizing. If I had gone to save you sooner..."

chapters.title: Chapter 2271 Childish Feud
paragraphs: "Saving me sooner, huh?" Kulas muttered before shaking his head. "Although it was quite painful and felt like an eternity at first, I quickly got used to it—the physical pain, that is. Due to the Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique you gave me, I was not only able to grow temper by physique to an extreme level, but it stopped being painful after a couple of months."

"As for the mental torture... that took far longer to overcome. It took me years to realize that all I had to do was stop believing in what I saw; once I did, it became much easier to endure. That said, I wasn't close to many people—if any at all—so they usually used you to torment me."

"If I have to be honest, I am sort of glad that it happened. After all, if not, I wouldn't be in my current position right now. Not only have I surpassed my entire family during their peak, but I also gained a real family who wouldn't betray me over some pressure."
Kulas spoke with barely a pause, hardly stopping to breathe.

"Speaking of my family... I've heard what you've accomplished. The downfall of the Immortal Clans. You've finally achieved your goal. What was once mocked as foolish and impossible, you brought to reality. I wanted to help you, but doing so would have lessened your achievement, so I held back and watched from here."

"Hey, I have been trying my best to keep quiet so the two of you can have a moment, but you're acting like I am not even here. I also had a hand in the Immortal Clans' downfall, you know?" Ren Xia finally spoke up.
Kulas shifted his gaze to her, and the instant he did, it grew noticeably colder, faint but impossible to miss. He was clearly displeased by Ren Xia's presence.
"Why did you have to come here, too?" he sighed, not even bothering to hide his displeasure.
Ren Xia narrowed her eyes at him.
"I don't recall doing anything to deserve that reaction—especially since we haven't spoken since Han Zexian's Tomb. Tell me, did you not mature even a little over all these years?"

"You didn't do anything?" Kulas sneered. "You touched my brother with your foul hands even though I warned you not to! What are you scheming, you damn fox? Are you trying to steal his techniques? Or do you have other ulterior motives? How many men have you snared so far?"
"This son of a bitch... Can I beat some sense into him?" Ren Xia asked Tian Yang as she pulled up her sleeves.
"Oh? You want to fight? Bring it on! I have always wanted to punch that annoying face of yours at least once!" Kulas said, raising his thick arms like a boxer.
Tian Yang pinched the bridge of his nose and sighed, "I can't believe the two of you are still stuck in this childish feud."

"I was ready to be nice," Ren Xia protested, "but he insulted my character, implying that I am a slut even though you are the only one I've ever been with! Dear, you can vouch for me! That during our first connection, I gushed with blood after you penetrated me with your sword!" Tian Yang's jaw dropped at Ren Xia's description. "I wouldn't say it 'gushed with blood', but it was definitely there..." he responded in an awkward tone.
"Wait, what the hell are you making me say?" "That doesn't prove anything!" Kulas then said. "There are plenty of ways to fake something like that! I bet you do that to everyone you meet!"
"Fuck! I've had it with this rude bastard! I'm going to beat him to death! Don't try to stop me!" Ren Xia's aura soared the next moment.
"Haha! Beat me to death? A mere Silver Immortal like you?! I'd love to see you try!" Kulas also released his aura, revealing his cultivation to be at the True Immortal level.
"Enough!" Tian Yang suddenly roared, his voice shaking the entire room.
Both Ren Xia and Kulas retrieved their aura after a brief moment of stillness.

"Kulas, you can trust her." Tian Yang continued as he stared Kulas in the eyes. "She's been by my side ever since we rescued you, and we've fought with our lives on the line multiple times. Hell, she even saved my butt many times. If it weren't for her, neither of us would be where we are right now."
After a moment of silence, Kulas burst out laughing, "I guess I went out of line with my jokes. My apologies."
"Jokes? You really expect me to believe that you were just joking around?" Ren Xia frowned.

Kulas shrugged and replied calmly, "I'm fully aware of your relationship with Tian Yang. Every time someone mentions his name, yours follows right after. Even a blind man could see your devotion to him. I just wanted to tease you a little. Consider it repayment for all the times you annoyed me in the past. Whether you believe me or not is up to you."
"Let's leave it at that." Tian Yang then said. Ren Xia didn't say anything, quietly nodding her head.
"Let's continue our conversation elsewhere. Somewhere more comfortable and accommodating," Kulas said.
"Alright."
The three of them left the room shortly after.
"Prepare a feast, and bring our finest tea to my private dwelling," Kulas said to the guards waiting outside.
"A-As your Majesty commands!" The guards immediately scurried away.
"Does this mean...?" The blonde woman muttered as she stared at Tian Yang.
"Yes, he's the real deal." Kulas nodded.
"Let me introduce you to each other. Tian Yang, this is my youngest daughter, Xie Mey."
"Xie Mey, this is my sworn brother, Tian Yang. There's nobody I trust more than him in this world."
"It's an honor to meet you, Senior..." Xie Mey bowed hurriedly, caught off guard by Kulas's shocking remark.
"I figured she was your daughter when the guards addressed her as 'Highness', but the youngest? How many children do you have?" Tian Yang looked at him with wide eyes.
"You curious? Then I'll introduce all of them to you later." Kulas chuckled.

chapters.title: Chapter 2272 Heavenly Unrestricted Longevity Pill
paragraphs: Once they arrived at their destination, Kulas turned to look at Xie Mey and commanded her, "I want you to gather your siblings at the throne room and wait for my return there." "All of them?" she asked for clarification.
"All of them."
"As you wish, Father."
After giving them a bow, she turned around and disappeared into the halls.
Once they were seated, Kulas said, "While we wait for the tea to arrive, why don't we start with what you were doing inside Han Zexian's Legacy, shall we?"
However, Tian Yang shook his head and calmly refused, "It's not that I don't want to tell you. I simply can't. It's for your safety."
"For my safety?" Kulas raised an eyebrow. "I am the Giant Emperor, you know? I appreciate the concern, but I can handle anything you throw at me."
"It's useless." Ren Xia interjected. "I have asked many times, but he would always refuse to tell me, saying the same thing."
"What's so dangerous about it, anyway? You're only telling us something. How could that possibly be a problem?" Kulas said, looking genuinely confused.
Tian Yang shook his head.
"Unfortunately, even I don't fully understand it. Just know this—there are still things out there far beyond our comprehension."
After a brief silence, Tian Yang continued, "With that being said, I can tell you some things I did inside, such as what Han Zexian left behind."
"Just say that from the beginning..."

Tian Yang smiled and began telling them about the interior layout of the cavern and the priceless stash Han Zexian left behind. "Strange as it sounds, there was a tiny waterfall in that cavern, and the water wasn't water at all. It was an elixir that sharpened focus to an incredible degree. With its help, my cultivation efficiency soared. That was what truly accelerated my progress."

"Then there were shelves of spatial rings filled entirely with longevity pills—thousands upon thousands of them. And they were the priceless kind without a consumption limit, meaning I could take as many as I wanted and extend my lifespan endlessly."
Both Ren Xia and Kulas stared at him with wide eyes filled with disbelief.

"I must interrupt you. Longevity pills without consumption limits—and in the thousands?" Kulas said, brows furrowing with doubt. "That borders on impossible. Such pills are exceptionally rare and priceless. How could Han Zexian have amassed such a quantity?"
Tian Yang shrugged, "What's the point of lying about such things?"
"Did you consume all of them?" Ren Xia asked.
"I consumed most of them, but I kept a few of them as a memento." Tian Yang proceeded to retrieve two pills and placed them on the table.
"May I?" Kulas asked as his hands hovered over one, his eyes sparkling with curiosity.
"Go ahead. I kept them so I could give one to you two, anyway."
Ren Xia and Kulas grabbed the pill and brought it close to their eyes, inspecting it with great interest.

"Wow... this really is the Heavenly Unrestricted Longevity Pill," Ren Xia murmured in a daze. "I've only ever seen one in my entire life, and that was back when I was still with my family, from a distance. Someone like me wasn't even allowed to touch it."

"They're even rarer now, since they stopped appearing on the market hundreds of years ago," Kulas said. "For Han Zexian to have so many... perhaps he was the creator. No one ever learned who made them in the first place."

Kulas shifted his gaze to Tian Yang and spoke with a stiff smile, "And you consumed thousands of them? What were you thinking? Are you not satisfied with your already near-limitless longevity as an Immortal?"
"It's related to the forbidden information," he shrugged.

"Anyway, besides the pills and the waterfall, there was also a cultivation bed inside. I don't know what it was made of, but it sped up my cultivation several-fold when I sat on it. I wish I could've taken it out of the cavern, but it was stuck there."

"That sounds like another priceless treasure—the Heavenly Ascension Platform, to be exact," Ren Xia remarked. "There are many varieties with different effects, but even the weakest ones are worth a fortune.
"My family had one, but it was reserved only for the Patriarch," Kulas said. "Forget about seeing it, I have never even gotten close to it."

"Just who the hell is this Han Zexian, anyway?" Ren Xia wondered out loud. "We know pretty much nothing about him besides that he was the first one to reach the Immortal Realm. Knowing his vast fortune now, I'm not the slightest surprised."
"And here is another thing Han Zexian left behind..."

Tian Yang produced several herbs from his spatial ring—the very same ones that were growing under the waterfall. Since he wasn't an alchemist, he wasn't able to use them, so he simply decided to keep them.
"Heavens!" Ren Xia stood up in shock. "Do you have any idea what these are?!"
"The ingredients to concoct the Heavenly Unrestricted Longevity Pill, right?" he said.
"Not just that! They're priceless treasures used in a variety of high-end pills! They're near extinct nowadays! But that's not why I am surprised!"
"You know..." Kulas suddenly spoke, "Normally, you store them in containers specifically used for such treasures so they don't lose their effects..."
"What?" Tian Yang raised his eyebrows in surprise. "I just tossed them inside my spatial ring. Are they useless now?"
"Of course not. It just means their effects will be weakened."
Kulas stood up and walked to his drawers, where he retrieved a large wooden box.
"Here, put them in here. This will seal their aroma and keep them fresh for as long as they're contained."
"Thanks..." Tian Yang followed his instructions.
"But I still have no use for them now. I don't need any more longevity pills, either. What should I do with them?"
Kulas pondered for a moment before responding, "I know an Alchemist. If you want, I can have him concoct a pill using those materials. It'll greatly benefit your cultivation."
"Really? That'll be great." Tian Yang immediately agreed.
