"Just who the hell is this Han Zexian, anyway?" Ren Xia wondered out loud.
"We know pretty much nothing about him besides that he was the first one to reach the Immortal Realm.
Knowing his vast fortune now, I'm not the slightest surprised."
"And here is another thing Han Zexian left behind..."
Tian Yang produced several herbs from his spatial ring—the very same ones that were growing under the waterfall.
Since he wasn't an alchemist, he wasn't able to use them, so he simply decided to keep them.
"Heavens!" Ren Xia stood up in shock.
"Do you have any idea what these are?!"
"The ingredients to concoct the Heavenly Unrestricted Longevity Pill, right?" he said.
"Not just that!
They're priceless treasures used in a variety of high-end pills!
They're near extinct nowadays!
But that's not why I am surprised!"
"You know..." Kulas suddenly spoke, "Normally, you store them in containers specifically used for such treasures so they don't lose their effects..."
"What?" Tian Yang raised his eyebrows in surprise.
"I just tossed them inside my spatial ring.
Are they useless now?"
"Of course not.
It just means their effects will be weakened."
Kulas stood up and walked to his drawers, where he retrieved a large wooden box.
"Here, put them in here.
This will seal their aroma and keep them fresh for as long as they're contained."
"Thanks..." Tian Yang followed his instructions.
"But I still have no use for them now.
I don't need any more longevity pills, either.
What should I do with them?"
Kulas pondered for a moment before responding, "I know an Alchemist.
If you want, I can have him concoct a pill using those materials.
It'll greatly benefit your cultivation."
"Really?
That'll be great." Tian Yang immediately agreed.

chapters.title: Chapter 2273 The Method to Becoming a Giant
paragraphs: By the time Tian Yang finished recounting his experience inside Han Zexian's cavern, the tea had arrived.
"These tea leaves are exclusive to this continent—I cultivated them myself," Kulas said as he poured each of them a cup.
When Tian Yang took a sip, he immediately sensed a change within his body. His physique had been refined, as though he had just undergone an intense body-tempering session.
"My body's getting a little sore... Aren't teas supposed to help you relax? I feel the exact opposite right now," Tian Yang said with a stiff smile.
Kulas burst into laughter at his remark.
"Relax? That word doesn't even exist in the Giant Race's dictionary!"
"This isn't going to give me a body as grotesque as yours, right...?" Ren Xia muttered as she hurriedly set her cup down, fearing that her body might become too muscular for Tian Yang's taste.
"Hey, hey—who are you calling grotesque? You have no idea how much effort it took to achieve this physique!" Kulas protested, flexing his muscles proudly.

"This isn't something you can get just by drinking tea, so there's no need to worry. The tea only strengthens your foundation and repairs most of the damage in your body—even the kind of restoration pills can't heal. The reason you're feeling sore is because your muscles were just restored."
Kulas shot Ren Xia a look and sighed.
"I don't understand your taste. What's so appealing about that bony physique of yours? There's nothing to feel besides skin and bone."
"I don't expect someone built like a walking mountain to get it. Your brain is likely made entirely of muscle, too," Ren Xia retorted.
Kulas laughed and turned to Tian Yang.
"Why don't I introduce you to a few women here? Once you experience their muscles, you'll never go back to that skeleton beside you!
"You looking for a fight?!" Ren Xia snapped. "How dare you suggest my darling sleep with another woman right in front of me!"
"What's wrong with that? It's not uncommon for a man to have several wives, especially if they're powerful. I have over twenty wives right now. Or do you intend on keeping him to yourself?"

"I know," Ren Xia replied, folding her arms, a hint of defensiveness in her posture. "I'm not fond of the idea of sharing him. But if he genuinely fell in love with someone else, I'd rather accept it than let jealousy destroy what we have."
Tian Yang shook his head and said, "I doubt I'll ever love someone else, especially since I am no longer going on adventures alone, so you don't have to worry about that."
"Never say never," Kulas said.
"Alright, let's put this topic behind us. Why don't you tell me what you've been doing? Especially after we rescued you from the Immortal Confinement Dungeon."
Kulas leaned back, closed his eyes, and crossed his arms, sinking into a wordless silence.
He broke the silence a moment later.
"Truthfully, I barely remember anything after I was freed. My mind wasn't stable, so I must have wandered for some time. By the time I came to my senses, I had already ended up on this continent."
"Then you remember declaring yourself the ruler of this continent? Why did you do something that would only bring attention to yourself?" Tian Yang asked.
"I acted on instincts... probably," he replied.

"Probably?" "Even after I regained my senses, I wasn't fully healed," Kulas said with a sigh. "My personality was nothing like it is now, and it took hundreds of years to recover. In fact, I didn't fully return to my original self until shortly before I reopened the continent."

"Then let's forget the reason behind your actions. How did you create the Giant's Race? I heard from a giant that you bestowed your blood upon them. Ah, that giant was named Karan." Tian Yang didn't forget his promise to give the giant's name to Kulas. "That's not entirely correct," Kulas said.

"My blood is exceptionally potent, to the point where even my children have difficulty refining it, let alone ordinary people. What they carry isn't my direct blood, but my children's—derived from my lineage, yet far weaker in comparison. The only time I gave my blood was in the beginning, when I hadn't fully realized the power of my bloodline."
"And how does that work? Surely, they weren't born as giants."
He shook his head.
"No. Anyone not born of my direct lineage began as an ordinary human. It was only after they absorbed and refined my bloodline that they became giants."
"Your bloodline... then it wasn't a result of the Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique?"
Tian Yang muttered. "Our understanding of bloodlines is still limited. How did you come to possess yours?"
"Through trial and error, I suppose. And I'd never share the Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique with ordinary people. Even within my own family, I only teach them half of the full method."

"Are the massive beasts your doing, as well?" Ren Xia asked. "Yes. We giants possess extraordinary strength, and ordinary beasts no longer pose any threat to us, which is a problem, since we rely on them for training. So we strengthened them by giving them our blood."
He continued, "Of course, training isn't the only reason. They're also our source of nutrients. Tiny beasts wouldn't even fill the gaps between our teeth."
"Can anybody receive your bloodline and turn into giants?" Tian Yang then asked.
Kulas hesitated for a moment before shaking his head.

"Of course not. Many have died attempting to become giants. But we don't force anyone onto our path. It's no different from the sects in the outside world—except that instead of teaching cultivation techniques, we offer the chance to undergo the transformation into a giant. Anyone who desires strength may choose it."
"How would one even go about requesting such a thing? I didn't notice any form of recruitment."

"You'd be surprised by how many seek us out," Kulas replied with a smile. "Most ask about our methods out of simple curiosity, but some truly wish to become giants themselves, even if it'll bind them to this continent for the rest of their lives."

chapters.title: Chapter 2274 Giant Emperor Kulas' Family
paragraphs: Hearing Kulas' words, Tian Yang finally voiced the question that had lingered in his mind ever since learning about the Giant Race.

"I've wondered about this for a long time, but why don't any of you venture beyond the continent? At first, I assumed it was simply a preference, that giants chose to remain here. But from what you're saying... it sounds like you don't have a choice. Is something binding your people to this land?"
Kulas shook his head.

"No, nothing is binding us," he explained. "It's just that the outside world isn't ready to face our race. When we first established ourselves, a few giants did leave the continent. Every one of them faced scrutiny and harassment—constant provocation, suspicion, and hostility. Not a single one returned without injuries. That's why we decided to remain on this continent. Those who come here are already aware of our existence, and even if they try to harass us, we're surrounded by our fellow people."
"Of course, we won't remain secluded on this continent forever. Once our Giant's Race is known far and wide, we'll leave. Give it a few thousand years."

Even though the Giant Race had existed for hundreds of years, the Divine Heavens were so vast that most of the world remained unaware of them, particularly those living in rural regions. Not to mention, the Giant's Continent had sealed itself off for some time. "With that said, we're not in a hurry to leave this place. We're quite satisfied with our current lives, after all," said Kulas.
"Anyway, what are your plans now that you've defeated the Immortal Clans?" he then asked the couple.
Tian Yang and Ren Xia exchanged glances with each other.
"We've been living a quiet and peaceful life ever since then, and we don't have any plans on changing that lifestyle anytime soon," Tian Yang said.

"So you're not particularly doing anything? In that case, what do you think about staying here with me? I've been looking for a new sparring partner, but it's not easy to find a decent one since there is nobody on this continent who can even give me a challenge these days."
"You want us to live in the Giant's Continent...?" Tian Yang muttered.
"Of course, you can live here in the palace with me. We have plenty of spare rooms. We'll also take care of all of your amenities."
"Are you sure? I don't want to intrude on your family..."
"It's the least I can do for my sworn brother who saved my life." Tian Yang looked at Ren Xia and asked, "What do you think? Want to stay here for a little?"
Ren Xia shrugged, "I don't care where we stay as long as I am with you."
Tian Yang smiled, "Then it's decided."
He turned to face Kulas and said, "Please take care of us, my new sparring partner.
"Hahaha! I should be saying that!" Kulas laughed out loud.
They continued chatting for another day.
"Alright, how about we meet the rest of my family now? They should have gathered by now," Kulas suddenly suggested.
"Sounds good."
Tian Yang and Ren Xia followed Kulas back to the throne room where they first met.
When they arrived and entered the room, they were immediately met by over a hundred gazes.
Inside, a hundred and thirty-three giants lined up in an orderly fashion. Tian Yang's eyes widened with surprise when he saw the scene.
"All of them are your children?" he asked.
"Not all. Some of them are my wives," he responded with a prideful smile.
"Looks like you've been doing more than just play emperor for the last few hundred years..." Ren Xia remarked.
Rather than being offended, Kulas chuckled at her words.

He approached his family and loudly declared, "These two will be staying with us for some time. The one to my left is my sworn brother and best friend, Tian Yang. The one to my right is his wife. Now, I want you all to introduce yourselves, starting from the oldest."
At his command, the man standing on the far left took a step forward and loudly introduced himself, "I am the oldest. My name is Du Shaoweng."
Then, the woman standing right next to him stepped forward and spoke, "I am his mother and the first wife, Du Xianyun."
One by one, his family introduced themselves without any pauses, almost as if they'd practiced for this moment.
Finally, the youngest stepped forward.
"I am the youngest, Xie Mey. Unfortunately, my mother died right after my birth."

Kulas then said to Tian Yang, "As you can probably tell from their introduction, the children take after their mother's surname. The reason is simply that I have abandoned my surname—the same way my family abandoned me."

Tian Yang then stepped forward and said, "Kulas already introduced me, but I'm Tian Yang, and I will be staying here for some time to be his sparring partner. If you have any questions or just want to talk, don't hesitate to approach me. Let's all get along."

Although no one spoke, Tian Yang could feel their intense gazes fixed on him. Some held simple curiosity, but most carried motives that were far less innocent. However, that didn't necessarily mean their intentions were malicious.
"Are you not going to introduce yourself, too?" Kulas asked Ren Xia.
"Why? You already introduced me, and I don't really have anything else to add."
"If you say so."
He turned to his family and said, "You're all dismissed."
They bowed immediately before leaving the room. A few of them looked as though they wanted to speak with Tian Yang, but in the end, they held their tongues and left without saying anything.
At the very end, Xie Mey stopped before Tian Yang briefly and said, "Let's have a chat later. I'm quite interested in the outside world."
"Sure thing." Tian Yang nodded.
"I'll contact you later, then." Xie Mey gave a slight bow before leaving the room.

chapters.title: Chapter 2275 Kulas' Personal World
paragraphs: Once they were alone again, Kulas said, "Your room is already being prepared as we speak, so let's check out the training area, shall we?"
"Let's." Tian Yang nodded.

Kulas then led them to the back of the palace, where a flower garden of massive, unknown plants was growing. As they walked through the garden path, Kulas explained, "This is where I grow my tea leaves."
"How do you grow them?" Ren Xia asked.
Kulas showed a mysterious smile on his face, "Are you sure you want to know?"
Ren Xia frowned at his ominous words and quickly said, "You'd better tell us, especially since you fed it to us."
Kulas let out a laugh. "I grow them in special soil—soil that's been infused with my blood."
"Your blood, again? Do you consider it some kind of universal treasure that improves everything it touches?"
"If you're worried about side effects, worry not. We've done extensive testing until we're certain of their safety for consumption. Of course, this goes for the magical beasts outside, as well."
"And how many people have died during those tests?" Ren Xia asked with a quick sneer.
"Nobody died. At worst, a few had upset stomachs for several weeks."
Once they left the garden, they arrived at an empty courtyard with a single guard protecting a circular platform with Array Symbols etched all over it.
"This lowly subject greets His Majesty." The guard bowed the moment he saw them.
Kulas gave a slight nod of acknowledgement before speaking to Tian Yang, "We're almost there."
A moment later, they stood on the platform before being teleported to a new location.
"Where are we?" Tian Yang muttered as he found himself standing on a massive platform while surrounded by water.
"We're inside a separate dimension—one completely isolated from the outside world," he explained calmly.
"What?" Tian Yang raised his eyebrows, clearly puzzled.
At this point in history, the concept of creating one's own world was still in its infancy, and very few people were even aware that such a feat was possible.
"How does it work?" Tian Yang asked.

"It's similar to how a spatial ring or storage pouch works. In simpler words, we're currently inside a massive spatial ring. Not only is it much more massive, but it can also contain living beings. In here, no matter how much damage we do during our training, it won't affect the outside world."
"How does one create their own world?" Ren Xia inquired.

"It's not easy or cheap. Not only does it require a tremendous amount of resources, but you will also need to maintain the world after its creation. As for how they're created... you'll need to ask the expert who created the world in the first place. I am only supplying the necessary spirit stones to operate it."
"And how expensive is it to maintain the world?" Ren Xia continued to ask.

"This world is relatively small, but even a world of this size costs around a hundred million spirit stones to create and thousands of spirit stones a day to maintain it. If you train in here and damage the place, it could easily consume over a hundred thousand spirit stones for repairs."

"Heavens. It is that expensive? You're literally throwing away money at this point. Why don't you just create a normal training ground? That will definitely be much cheaper to create and maintain—even if you destroy it and have to remake it every day."
"Well, I have no other uses for spirit stones. We earn more than we ever need just from selling our materials to the merchants who visit our continent."
After a slight pause, he continued, "Keep this between us, but we also have several large Spirit Veins on the continent, earning us hundreds of thousands of spirit stones a day."
"Spirit Veins, huh? If word of it were to spread, there'd definitely be trouble." Tian Yang remarked.

Spirit Veins were the only reliable source of spirit stones and the origin of most that circulated in the world. Nearly all of them were controlled by large and powerful backgrounds, and whenever a new vein was discovered, it often sparked fierce wars as countless powers fought for ownership.

If several Spirit Veins existed on the Giant's Continent, they would undoubtedly attract countless greedy and ambitious individuals. And while the Giant Race was exceptionally powerful—and their territory difficult to reach—that alone would not be enough to deter those kinds of people from stirring up trouble.

Given their immeasurable value, knowledge of such Spirit Veins was typically guarded from everyone, including one's own closest allies. Yet Kulas shared it openly with Tian Yang and Ren Xia, demonstrating the extent of his trust.
"I get that you're rich, but it still feels a bit wasteful," Ren Xia said, shaking her head.
Kulas smiled. "If we used this place only as a training ground, then yes. But it also serves as a safehouse and a vault."
"A vault? I don't see one." Tian Yang said as he looked around, seeing nothing but water for as far as the horizon goes.
"A single world can have multiple layers. This world has two layers, and we're currently in the first layer."
"I see... how intriguing," Tian Yang murmured, the thought of forging a world of his own stirring within him.

Throughout his battles with the Immortal Clans, he had plundered their valuables whenever he could, amassing a mountain of treasures and spirit stones. But until this moment, he'd had no idea how any of it could be used.
"Are you thinking about what I currently am?" Ren Xia suddenly spoke to him.
"About making our own world?"
"A paradise for just the two of us... It'd be very romantic," she chuckled.
"We'll have to learn the method for creating it first, though."
Kulas then said, "I'll introduce you to the expert later... if you can defeat me in a match."
Tian Yang looked at him with a raised eyebrow.
"Right now?"
"Right now," Kulas confirmed.

"We're inside a separate dimension—one completely isolated from the outside world," he explained calmly.
"What?" Tian Yang raised his eyebrows, clearly puzzled.
At this point in history, the concept of creating one's own world was still in its infancy, and very few people were even aware that such a feat was possible.
"How does it work?" Tian Yang asked.
"It's similar to how a spatial ring or storage pouch works.
In simpler words, we're currently inside a massive spatial ring.
Not only is it much more massive, but it can also contain living beings.
In here, no matter how much damage we do during our training, it won't affect the outside world."
"How does one create their own world?" Ren Xia inquired.
"It's not easy or cheap.
Not only does it require a tremendous amount of resources, but you will also need to maintain the world after its creation.
As for how they're created... you'll need to ask the expert who created the world in the first place.
I am only supplying the necessary spirit stones to operate it."
"And how expensive is it to maintain the world?" Ren Xia continued to ask.
"This world is relatively small, but even a world of this size costs around a hundred million spirit stones to create and thousands of spirit stones a day to maintain it.
If you train in here and damage the place, it could easily consume over a hundred thousand spirit stones for repairs."
"Heavens.
It is that expensive?
You're literally throwing away money at this point.
Why don't you just create a normal training ground?
That will definitely be much cheaper to create and maintain—even if you destroy it and have to remake it every day."
"Well, I have no other uses for spirit stones.
We earn more than we ever need just from selling our materials to the merchants who visit our continent."
After a slight pause, he continued, "Keep this between us, but we also have several large Spirit Veins on the continent, earning us hundreds of thousands of spirit stones a day."
"Spirit Veins, huh?
If word of it were to spread, there'd definitely be trouble." Tian Yang remarked.
Spirit Veins were the only reliable source of spirit stones and the origin of most that circulated in the world.
Nearly all of them were controlled by large and powerful backgrounds, and whenever a new vein was discovered, it often sparked fierce wars as countless powers fought for ownership.
If several Spirit Veins existed on the Giant's Continent, they would undoubtedly attract countless greedy and ambitious individuals.
And while the Giant Race was exceptionally powerful—and their territory difficult to reach—that alone would not be enough to deter those kinds of people from stirring up trouble.
Given their immeasurable value, knowledge of such Spirit Veins was typically guarded from everyone, including one's own closest allies.
Yet Kulas shared it openly with Tian Yang and Ren Xia, demonstrating the extent of his trust.
"I get that you're rich, but it still feels a bit wasteful," Ren Xia said, shaking her head.
Kulas smiled.
"If we used this place only as a training ground, then yes.
But it also serves as a safehouse and a vault."
"A vault?
I don't see one." Tian Yang said as he looked around, seeing nothing but water for as far as the horizon goes.
"A single world can have multiple layers.
This world has two layers, and we're currently in the first layer."
"I see... how intriguing," Tian Yang murmured, the thought of forging a world of his own stirring within him.
Throughout his battles with the Immortal Clans, he had plundered their valuables whenever he could, amassing a mountain of treasures and spirit stones.
But until this moment, he'd had no idea how any of it could be used.
"Are you thinking about what I currently am?" Ren Xia suddenly spoke to him.
"About making our own world?"
"A paradise for just the two of us...
It'd be very romantic," she chuckled.
"We'll have to learn the method for creating it first, though."
Kulas then said, "I'll introduce you to the expert later... if you can defeat me in a match."
Tian Yang looked at him with a raised eyebrow.
"Right now?"
"Right now," Kulas confirmed.

chapters.title: Chapter 2276 Sparring With Kulas
paragraphs: Kulas jumped to the center of the platform and beckoned Tian Yang, "Don't tell me you're afraid of losing?"
Tian Yang smiled at his provocation and also flew to the center of the platform.
"Don't cry when I beat you," he said.

"Hahaha! Not only is my physique superior, but so is my cultivation!" Kulas released his aura, and his True Immortal cultivation base surged outward like a massive tidal wave. Yet, the water around them remained still, almost as if they were simply an illusion.
"I'd be very surprised if you could hurt me, much less defeat me!" "We'll find out soon enough."
The atmosphere grew heavy as both of them fell silent.
In the next instant, their figures vanished, only to collide a heartbeat later, unleashing a powerful ripple that swept across the entire world.
"Oh? Not bad," remarked Kulas when Tian Yang wasn't immediately flung away. "Most can't even handle this."
"Well, I'm not like most," Tian Yang calmly responded with a smile.
"Of course not. Would you be here if you weren't special?" Kulas laughed out loud as they continued to exchange blows with each other, using nothing but their physiques.
The two gradually increased their strength with each blow, and although Tian Yang managed to endure for a while, Kulas inevitably overpowered him.

"I'm impressed—shocked, even," Kulas said suddenly. "You forced me to use sixty percent of my full strength. Out of my one hundred and one children, only five can manage that. And you're just a human with an ordinary physique."

"Have you forgotten who taught you the Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique? Although I am nowhere near your level, I have trained this technique quite extensively over the years since it's the only worthy body refining technique that I know."
"That makes sense. But are you sure you didn't do it to satisfy your partner?" Kulas chuckled.
Ren Xia's ears twitched at Kulas' words.
"So you can use it to enhance that!" she exclaimed.
Kulas looked at her with raised eyebrows.
"What? Don't tell me you've never used it on her? You have no idea what you're missing out on."
Tian Yang sighed, "Do you want to fight, or would you rather talk about nonsense? I don't have the energy to do both."
"Alright, alright." Kulas chuckled a little before putting on a serious face again.
"Do you need more time to warm up?" he then asked.
"No, do you?"
"Then let's fight seriously!"
Their subsequent collision was no longer a contest of physique alone, and they began drawing upon their martial techniques.
Tian Yang shifted fluidly between countless styles while Kulas remained steadfast, using only his fist techniques.

Kulas hadn't always been a fist-fighter. Once, he wielded a sword. But every technique he'd learned with it had come from the family he now despised. For that reason, he vowed never to draw a blade again.

Another reason was simple pride. He could not bring himself to rely on a weapon that was not his own flesh. Among Body Refiners, this was common; they took immense pride in their physiques and used their bodies as their primary weapons. It demonstrated both their hard work and their confidence.

As the fight dragged on, Kulas, who'd been so confident in his abilities, began to feel pressure mounting against him. The sensation baffled him. He possessed a superior physique and higher cultivation, and only minutes ago, he had overwhelmed Tian Yang with a little more than half his strength.
But now, he found himself barely keeping up with Tian Yang's movements, as though he were getting slower.
"What's wrong? You're sweating pretty heavily there." Tian Yang suddenly poked at him.
"This is normal!" Tian Yang smiled faintly.

"You're incredibly strong, Kulas—no one can deny that. But you don't know how to use that strength. At the moment, you fight like a wild beast. Your moves are simple and predictable. You depend too heavily on brute force."
"Are you seriously lecturing me?!" Kulas exclaimed, looking utterly speechless.
"This is why we're sparring, isn't it?" Tian Yang replied calmly. "To expose each other's flaws and improve.
After some time, Kulas collapsed onto the platform, a bewildered look frozen on his face.
"I... lost?" he murmured in a daze.
He had no serious injuries, and Tian Yang's attacks had barely hurt him, yet somehow, he had still been defeated.
"You lack experience, Kulas," Tian Yang said as he walked toward him.

"You've probably defeated most—if not all—of your opponents with sheer, overwhelming strength, so you never needed to rely on proper technique. But I fought the Immortal Clans. Did you really think I defeated them through brute force alone? Not to mention that I have hundreds of years of real experience while you're secluded in this place. When was the last time you were in a life-or-death situation?"
Kulas was left speechless, partly from shock and partly because he had no rebuttal.

Despite his overwhelming strength, he undeniably lacked experience. The last time he had truly fought was during his early days, when he returned to the Desolate Continent and had to fight to prove his strength.

In recent years, he had devoted the majority of his time to governing the continent from his throne room. The rare moments he could spare for battle were limited to sparring sessions with his children or his soldiers.
In contrast to Tian Yang, who fought nearly every day at the risk of his life, the disparity between them was as great as that between heaven and earth.
After a moment of silence, Kulas suddenly burst out laughing.
"Hahaha! You're truly amazing, Tian Yang!" he abruptly declared.
"As expected of my sworn brother! I'm truly glad to have someone like you as a sparring partner starting now!"
He sat up and continued, "Alright, as promised, I'll introduce the expert who created this world for me. Hell, I'll even help you make your own."
"Thanks," replied Tian Yang as he extended an arm to help Kulas up.

chapters.title: Chapter 2277 Heaven Defying Ascension Pill
paragraphs: After their spar, Kulas brought Tian Yang and Ren Xia to their new living quarters.
"I assumed the two of you wanted to live in the same room, so I only prepared this room. If you want separate rooms, let me know," said Kulas.
"How thoughtful." Ren Xia remarked. "But you're not wrong."

Tian Yang walked into the room and expressed slight surprise, "This room... is normal-sized. I thought every room in this palace was meant for giants, or did you specifically create this just for us?"

Kulas smiled and said, "You know, there are times when I feel like walking around in my original size, so there are rooms in here dedicated to humans. Not to mention, we receive human-sized guests all of the time."
"I see..."
"Well, I have to return to work now. If there is anything you need, don't hesitate to ask the servants. Of course, you can bother me whenever," Kulas said.
"Thanks for everything."

After Kulas left, Tian Yang and Ren Xia went to familiarize themselves with their new living space. Although it existed within the palace, the room was huge, with several other connecting rooms. "I'm going to take a shower," Tian Yang said, as he was still soaked in sweat from his sparring with Kulas.
"Sure."
Shortly after Tian Yang entered the bathroom, Ren Xia entered as well. Without warning, of course.
Tian Yang was resting in the bathtub when she walked in, and after quickly washing her body, she also entered the bathtub, resting her slender body on top of his.
"How long do you think we'll stay here?" she asked.
"Who knows? It's not like we have anywhere else to be."
"I guess so..."
After several minutes of silence, Ren Xia suddenly reached for the sword pressing against her back and said, "Once we're done here, I want to experience what Kulas had mentioned."
Knowing that he can't avoid this subject forever, Tian Yang let out a long, defeated sigh.
"...Fine."
He had known this moment would come when the subject was first brought up.

Some time later, they moved into the bedroom, where Tian Yang demonstrated the capabilities of the Great Mammoth Body Refinement technique. Rather than enlarging his entire physique, however, he focused the technique on a single area.
"Heavens..." Ren Xia stared at his enlarged sword, her eyes wide with excitement and a hint of nervousness.
"Will this even fit?" she mumbled in a mosquito-like voice.
Noticing the hesitation in her gaze, Tian Yang teased, "Don't tell me you're going to run away now? You're the one who suggested this."
"R-Run away? Don't insult me," Ren Xia said, pushing Tian Yang down with surprising force.
She embraced him fully, accepting his enlarged sword without hesitation.
A brief wince of pain crossed her face, but it was quickly replaced by a soft gasp as discomfort quickly shifted into overwhelming warmth.
"It feels like I am doing it for the first time again," she remarked with a playful smile, eyes gleaming with desire.
Thus, Tian Yang and Ren Xia began their life on the Giant's Continent with Kulas and his family.
Several days later, Xie Mey sought out Tian Yang, eager to learn about the world beyond the continent.
He told her of his journeys through the Divine Heavens, his words flowing like stories from a book of legends, as if he were reading fairy tales to a child.
"Thank you, Senior! I'll visit you again later!"
Some time later, Kulas approached Tian Yang with the expert who created his world.
"This is Lu An, a level 6 Array Master. He's the expert I told you about."

"It's a pleasure to meet you, Senior." Lu An gave a polite bow before continuing, "The creation of a world begins with Array Symbols, so unless you are an Array Master, it's impossible to create your own world."
Tian Yang nodded and said, "I see. Although I am no expert, I have studied Array Symbol over the years. That said, I'm likely nowhere close to the level required to create my own world."
"Worry not. Even if you are a complete beginner, I am here to teach you."
"Really? Aren't Array Masters typically busy? Especially one at your level?
Lu An smiled and said, "Typically, yes. However, I am the Giant Emperor's exclusive Array Master, and he instructed me to teach you, so you will be my priority until you can create your own world."
"In that case, I'll be in your care." Kulas then spoke, "By the way, remember the ingredients you showed me?"
"The ones I found in Han Zexian's cavern? What about them?"
"Have you forgotten already? I told you that I would find an Alchemist to concoct a treasure using those ingredients. He'll arrive in a month. If you don't want to, let me know."
"No, go ahead. It's not like I have any other use for them." Tian Yang took out the sealed ingredients from his spatial ring and handed them to Kulas without hesitation. "Let me know when it's done."
"Sure."
From that day forward, Tian Yang devoted himself to learning Array Symbols under the tutelage of Lu An, a Level 6 Array Master who was considered to be at the pinnacle of his craft at that time.

Aside from studying Array Symbols, Tian Yang sparred with Kulas once a week. He also sparred with Ren Xia from time to time, but their other kind of sparring—the one that took place in the bedroom—happened nearly every day.
Several months later, Kulas gave Tian Yang the completed treasure that was created using the ingredients he found in Han Zexian's cavern.
"This is the Heaven Defying Ascension Pill," Kulas introduced the pill as if it were nothing out of the ordinary.
"What does it do?" Tian Yang asked.
Kulas smiled and replied, "That's a secret. You'll find out once you consume it."
"You're telling me to consume a pill with unknown effects?" Tian Yang raised his eyebrows, forgetting that was precisely what he did in Han Zexian's cavern... several times, at that.
"What? Do you think I'll poison you or something?" Kulas glared at him.
"Of course not." Tian Yang accepted the pill and added, "Thanks. I'll take it later today."
At that moment, he had no idea just how precious and heaven-defying the pill truly was.

chapters.title: Chapter 2278 Effects of the Heaven Defying Ascension Pill
paragraphs: "Come see me after you consume that pill. Until then."
Kulas didn't linger and immediately left.
Tian Yang returned to his room shortly after to show Ren Xia the pill.
"Have you ever heard of the Heaven Defying Ascension Pill before?" he asked her.
"No, but it sounds very powerful. What kind of pill is it?"
"I don't know. Kulas didn't tell me. He said it's a surprise."
Ren Xia inspected the pill for a moment before speaking, "This pill contains ingredients other than the ones you gave him. A lot of them, actually."
"I guess I'll find out its effect soon."
"Are you going to consume it now?"
He quietly nodded.
Moments later, he tossed the pill into his mouth and closed his eyes to concentrate.
The pill dissolved almost instantly upon contact, flooding his mouth with a rich medicinal taste before flowing smoothly down his throat.
Ren Xia stood quietly at his side, her attention fixed on every subtle shift in his aura and physique.
Then, without warning, a tremendous burst of energy exploded from Tian Yang's body. The resulting shockwave tore through the room, destroying every piece of furniture in an instant.
"Heavens! What is this amount of energy?!"
Before Ren Xia could even fully grasp the situation, she noticed that Tian Yang's cultivation, which had only recently entered Golden Immortal, was soaring to the next realm.
In the span of several breaths, Tian Yang's cultivation reached the peak of Golden Immortal, and after another moment, surged into the next realm, becoming a True Immortal.
However, it didn't stop there, and Tian Yang's cultivation continued to grow.
It was only when his cultivation reached the pinnacle of the True Immortal realm that his aura began to subside.
Tian Yang opened his eyes almost immediately and turned to Ren Xia with a dumbfounded expression.
Ren Xia stared back at him with the exact same look on her face.
"How long was I cultivating just now?" he asked in a somewhat nervous voice.
"A minute... two minutes at most," she replied.
Then she asked, "Did time feel different for you?"
Tian Yang shook his head and explained, "Everything happened so quickly that I was only able to watch. I didn't even do anything after swallowing the pill."
"I've never seen anyone's cultivation rise that fast," Ren Xia murmured.

But soon, a worried look clouded her face. "It's incredible that your cultivation improved so quickly... but I'm afraid there might be side effects. Something this powerful can't be without at least one or two drawbacks."
Tian Yang inspected his body and said, "Besides the overflowing energy coursing through my body, I don't feel any different."
He then stood up and continued, "But I should speak with Kulas just in case."
Ren Xia nodded, and the two of them went to meet Kulas together.
"You've returned quicker than I thought." Kulas smiled the moment he saw them. "How was the pill?"
"It was amazing... a little too good, if I have to be honest. What did you even feed me? And do I have to worry about any drawbacks?"

"I told you what I gave you. The Heaven Defying Ascension Pill," Kulas calmly responded with a playful smile on his face. "And you don't need to worry about drawbacks because there are none. I also consumed one, after all."
Tian Yang raised an eyebrow and asked, "Is that how you achieved True Immortal?"
He nodded, "Yes, and I consumed it a hundred years ago."
"So, what exactly is this pill? It's the first time I'm hearing its name," Ren Xia spoke up.
"It's a pill that will instantly improve one's cultivation by half a realm, even if they're an Immortal.
"Wait... half a realm? Are you sure?" Tian Yang asked in a doubtful voice. "After all, my cultivation improved by nearly two realms."
"What?" Kulas raised his eyebrows, looking puzzled by his statement.

It was at this moment that Kulas realized Tian Yang's cultivation had already reached True Immortal. No, it was at the peak of True Immortal! "What the hell?" Kulas exclaimed as he stood up with a dumbfounded look on his face.

"You were only at the early stages of Golden Immortal, so you couldn't have reached True Immortal, much less the peak with the Heaven Defying Ascension Pill! I was already at the peak of Golden Immortal when I consumed the pill!" Tian Yang shook his head.
"I don't know what to tell you since it's your pill."
Kulas fell silent for a long moment to ponder the possibilities.

"Hello." A giant woman greeted them shortly after Kulas knocked on her door.
"You are... one of Kulas' wives?" Tian Yang recognized this woman.
Although this is only his second time seeing her, he remembered her from the family introduction a few months ago.
"And you are His Majesty's sworn brother. Senior Tian Yang, correct?" she responded with a calm smile.
"Chao Shuying, I need you to take a thorough examination of his body immediately," Kulas immediately cut to the chase.
The woman named Chao Shuying transformed in the next moment, shrinking her massive form until she stood at their height.

"No, he consumed the Heaven Defying Ascension Pill, and his cultivation improved more than what should be possible. I'm worried that something might be wrong with his body," Kulas explained.

He said it's a surprise."
Ren Xia inspected the pill for a moment before speaking, "This pill contains ingredients other than the ones you gave him.

"I guess I'll find out its effect soon."
"Are you going to consume it now?"

However, it didn't stop there, and Tian Yang's cultivation continued to grow.
It was only when his cultivation reached the pinnacle of the True Immortal realm that his aura began to subside.

chapters.title: Chapter 2279 A Special Physique
paragraphs: "I see... come inside." Chao Shuying gestured for them to enter her room.
Once inside and seated, Chao Shuying continued, "Now, can you elaborate on the situation for me? What was different from when you consumed it?"
Kulas proceeded to explain the situation—how Tian Yang's cultivation had increased by nearly two realms while his own cultivation had only improved by barely half a realm.
"My first thought was that the ingredients used in his pill were simply of higher quality than those I had," he said, voicing his conclusion.
"That is impossible," Chao Shuying responded immediately, her tone firm and assured.

"I was there when the pill was concocted. In fact, I even assisted, so I'm fully aware of the potency of its ingredients. They were certainly superior, and the pill was undeniably of higher quality than yours, but not to a degree that would create such a drastic difference."
"Then what do you think is going on?" Kulas asked.
Chao Shuying turned to look at Tian Yang and replied, "I'll have to check his body first."
"Go ahead." Tian Yang extended his arm toward her.
Chao Shuying immediately began examining his body with Divine Sense, then Divine Gaze.

After a long minute of silence, she released his arm and spoke in a puzzled voice, "His body... there's nothing wrong with it. If anything, it's in perfect condition. As for the pill he consumed, I can still feel its energy, even though it should've been long gone by now."
"What does that mean?" Kulas asked.

"In situations like these, it means he managed to absorb a higher-than-normal portion of the pill's effects," she explained. "Even if a pill is created at full efficiency, people usually absorb only ten to fifty percent of its effects while the rest are discarded. The exact amount varies greatly depending on their talent and whether they possess a unique physique."

"However, Senior Tian has somehow retained the portion of the pill he wasn't able to absorb, and it's continuing to strengthen his body even now. As for how much he absorbed from the pill... I'd say anywhere between eighty to ninety percent..."
"That... sounds like a good thing?" Ren Xia remarked.

"That's more than good! This is literally unprecedented! I have been an Alchemist for almost my entire life, and I have never encountered anyone who could refine more than half of a pill's full effect!
"Do you have some kind of heavenly physique?" Kulas asked while looking at Tian Yang with a surprised face.

Tian Yang shook his head and responded confidently, "Of course not. If I were born with such a divine physique, I wouldn't have struggled so much in the past. Even now, my talent is only above average."

"Above average? According to what criteria?" Kulas asked. "From my perspective, you're already a monster. No one who is merely above average could defeat me. If that were the case, then the rest of the world would be considered below average at best."
Chao Shuying stared at Kulas in bewilderment. She had never seen him praise anyone to such a degree—not even his own children.
"Have you ever even checked to see whether you have a unique physique?" Ren Xia asked, cutting into the conversation.
"I did, shortly after joining the Immortal Monastery. They examine all new disciples to ensure there's no hidden diamond," he said.
"The Immortal Monastery? Never heard of them." Kulas said.
"Ah. Wait. I have," he quickly corrected himself. "Weren't they attacked by the Immortal Clans while you were still at war with each other?"
"Yes... They tried to draw me out by using the Immortal Monastery as bait. I nearly died on that day."
"I've been curious about that ever since I heard what happened, but why did you take the bait?" Kulas asked.
"That's..."
A certain figure surfaced in Tian Yang's mind.
"I had no real attachment to that place, and I even lost a friend there. But something good did come out of it—Elder Sun."
"Elder Sun...?"
"Do you remember the woman I shouted at outside Han Zexian's Tomb?" Tian Yang asked.
"Oh, that pretty lady? Of course. I even remember her bewildered expression."

"That was Elder Sun, an elder of the Immortal Monastery. Though she is not my master, she has always looked after me and saved my life several times when I trained recklessly as a disciple. If I were to describe our relationship, it would resemble that of siblings, with her as the elder sister."
"I see... so you went back to save her. Well? Did you?" Kulas asked.
Tian Yang shook his head.

"No. She wasn't there when I returned. Many people had died long before I showed up, and I searched through every corpse... but she wasn't among them. After going through every corpse I could, I eventually gave up and left."
"So there's a good chance that she wasn't at the sect at that time and is still alive," Kulas remarked.
"I hope that's really true since I still owe her an apology for that day," Tian Yang sighed.
After a short pause, Kulas resumed,

"Now then, back to our main topic. Although your body was examined at the Immortal Monastery, it's possible they failed to do so thoroughly because their equipment wasn't sufficient. Not all sects have the proper tools, and only high-grade treasures can identify high-grade physiques, especially back then."
"Considering it's been hundreds of years since your last examination, I'd say there's a very high chance that's the case."
"So I should evaluate my body again?" Tian Yang asked. "Where can I go to do that?"
Kulas smiled and replied, "Fortunately for you, we have just what you need already available here."
"You really have everything here, don't you?" Tian Yang smiled.
"Of course. This is the only way we can survive such a secluded life."
"I can do the examination for you right now if you want," Chao Shuying said.
"Then I'll have to bother you a little longer." Tian Yang nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 2280 Tian Yang's Physique
paragraphs: Once Tian Yang agreed to have his physique examined, Chao Shuying led him to another room, where a single large device stood alone at its center.
The device was pitch black, its surface resembling polished obsidian. Shaped like a rectangular coffin, it was covered in golden Array Symbols that shimmered softly, giving it an otherworldly beauty.
"I was expecting something massive—something meant for giants," Tian Yang remarked when he saw how ordinary in size the device was.
Chao Shuying smiled. "Do you have any idea how many materials we'd need to build one on a giant scale? Even if we had the funds, this world doesn't have enough resources to make it."
"Is that so..."
Chao Shuying proceeded to hand him a white cloth and said, "Remove all of your clothes and cleanse your entire body in that bathroom over there. Once you're done, wear this and come back out."
Tian Yang didn't ask any questions and simply followed her instructions.
Several minutes later, he stepped out of the bathroom wearing nothing but a white cloth wrapped around his waist.
"You have a well-balanced physique. Are you also a body refiner?" Chao Shuying questioned him after seeing his refined physique, neither too muscular nor too lean.
"While I do temper my body occasionally, I wouldn't call myself a body refiner," he replied.

"Now then, all you need to do is lie inside this device and wait for me to finish. Once it begins, you'll be submerged in liquid for a few minutes, so don't be too surprised when it happens." "Alright."
Tian Yang entered the coffin-shaped device—just large enough to contain him—and watched as Chao Shuying lowered the lid, sealing him inside.
Inside, it was completely silent and utterly dark—so still that his senses began to dull within moments.
Then, without warning, he felt something warm rising around him, quickly submerging his body.
As a cultivator of the True Immortal realm, Tian Yang could hold his breath for days without difficulty. A few minutes posed no concern whatsoever.
Some time later, Tian Yang felt the liquid rapidly draining away, and moments after it disappeared, Chao Shuying opened the lid of the device.
"It's done," she said.
When Tian Yang regained his senses, he could instantly smell the strong medicinal scent on his body, presumably from the liquid.
"What are the results?" Kulas asked, sounding a little impatient.
"Uhh..." Chao Shuying looked at the device, which showed no reaction, and replied in a puzzled voice, "He doesn't have one...
"What?" Kulas frowned. "How is that possible?"
"I don't know, but the device isn't reacting at all. This only happens when the individual has no physique."
"So it wasn't his physique that caused the abnormal pill absorption rate?" Kulas turned to look at Tian Yang and asked, "Are you sure you don't have a special bloodline?"
"I don't know my real parents since I was abandoned before I could even crawl, but I also had my blood tested before. No results."
"We can also examine your blood here if you'd like," Chao Shuying suddenly said. "What do you think?"
"Since I am already here... might as well."
"Very well."
Without any delay, Chao Shuying retrieved a crimson needle from her spatial ring and said, "It won't take more than a minute. I just need to collect a few drops of your blood."
Tian Yang nodded and offered his arm to her.
Chao Shuying promptly pricked his index finger with the crimson needle, drawing several drops of blood.
The blood slid down the needle's surface and vanished, as though the needle had absorbed it.
Moments later, the needle began to tremble, and Chao Shuying felt a hot, almost searing sensation radiating from it.
"Heavens! What kind of reaction is this?!" Chao Shuying exclaimed, struggling to keep her grip on the needle as it grew unbearably hot.
Kulas and Ren Xia watched nervously while Tian Yang swallowed hard at the reaction from the needle.
Eventually, the needle stopped moving, and Chao Shuying released a deep sigh.
"I've never seen the needle react this intensely before," she said as she hurriedly switched it to her other hand.
When she did, an imprint of the needle was revealed on her palm. The needle had grown so hot that it had actually branded her skin.
"Are you okay?" Tian Yang asked.
"It'll go away with a recovery pill," she calmly replied.
"Anyway, judging by the needle's reaction, you definitely possess a unique bloodline. And not just that—it's likely a high-grade one."
"High-grade bloodline? That's impossible..." Tian Yang muttered with a dumbfounded look on his face.
"How high are we talking?" Kulas questioned with a serious expression.

Chao Shuying met Kulas's gaze and said, "When we examined your Mammoth Bloodline, it only barely qualified as Divine-grade. But Senior Tian's reaction was even stronger. His bloodline is definitely at least Divine-grade."
Kulas sucked in a cold breath at the results.
"Do you hear that, brother? You possess a Divine-grade bloodline! Ain't that something!" Kulas exclaimed, turning to Tian Yang with eager anticipation.
But when he saw Tian Yang's expression, there was no joy there, only confusion.
"Divine-grade? There must be a mistake," Tian Yang quickly said, rejecting the results.

Before Kulas or Chao Shuying could respond, Ren Xia interjected, "Wait a second—Kulas, when did you get a Divine-grade bloodline? Last I heard, you had an Imperial-grade one, same as me. We both came from the Immortal Clans, remember?"

Kulas calmly explained, "When I reached a certain mastery with Great Mammoth Body Refinement, it transformed my bloodline, increasing it to Divine-grade. However, my children are only between Royal-grade and Imperial-grade."
"So Senior Tian... whoever your parents are, they must be from a background that surpasses even the Immortal Clans..." Chao Shuying said.
"Surpass the Immortal Clans? Aren't they already the most renowned and powerful out there?" Tian Yang asked, confusion evident.

"Their name may be the most widely known in the Divine Heavens, but they are far from the most powerful," Ren Xia replied. "Even at their height, there were at least three families they would never have dared to offend."
Tian Yang stared at her with his mouth agape, clearly in disbelief.

chapters.title: Chapter 2281 Three Pillars of Heaven
paragraphs: "Don't look so surprised," Kulas chuckled at Tian Yang's reaction. "To ordinary people, the Immortal Clans are the pinnacle of power. Anything above that is simply beyond their understanding. However, for those of us in the Immortal Clans, we have to be aware of their existence even if we don't want to."

Ren Xia then spoke, "You know the saying 'a frog in a well'? In this case, you're the frog, and the Immortal Clans are the sky you see above. But there's still something beyond the sky—the Starry Sky."
"Who exactly are these people?" Tian Yang asked.

"They are known as the Three Pillars of Heaven," she explained. "They were the pioneers of cultivation. The first to discover the existence of spiritual energy and the fact that it could be absorbed through technique."
"How can there be three different families, though? Did they all discover cultivation at the same time or something?" Tian Yang inquired.
Ren Xia shook her head. "No. They were originally a single background. But they grew so powerful that they eventually had to divide their strength into three branches."
Kulas continued, "The Three Pillars of Heaven consist of the Ji Family, Tian Family, and the Sun Family." "Did you just say the Sun Family?" Tian Yang looked at Kulas with wide eyes.
Kulas looked puzzled by Tian Yang's reaction, but he quickly realized something.

"Don't tell me you think that Elder Sun of yours is related to the Sun Family? It's a very common surname in the Divine Heavens, and there's no way someone from the Sun Family would be working as a sect elder in a place such as the Immortal Monastery."
"That's..." Tian Yang had no response, as Kulas had hit it right on the nail.

After a moment of silence, he sighed. "Although she never told me her background, she would occasionally allude to coming from a prominent family. I think I even overheard her mentioning the Holy Continent in the past to another elder."
"Wait. The Holy Continent? That is where the primary families of the Three Pillars of Heaven are located." Ren Xia said.
"Also, if we're talking about surnames, you have one of theirs as well—the Tian Family's surname. What if your parents came from there?" she continued.

Tian Yang looked at her with a bitter smile, "It's just a coincidence. Even though I never met my real parents, there's no way they'd be from such a place. After all, why would they abandon me in that backwater village?" "So your adoptive parents named you Tian Yang?" Kulas suddenly asked.
"That's... I don't know. However, they definitely didn't have the same surname. In fact, they were surnamed Guan."
"And you never found that weird?"
"I never really even thought about it."
Chao Shuying then spoke, "Nobody in this world but your parents can tell you why they abandoned you, but I can tell you with certainty that you have a Divine-grade bloodline."
After a moment of silence, Ren Xia asked, "What are you going to do now?"
"What even is there for me to do?" Tian Yang shrugged. "Even if my real parents are truly from the Three Pillars of Heaven, my connection with them was cleanly severed the moment they abandoned me."
"With that being said, I still refuse to believe that my real parents are from such a place."

"In that case, let's wrap things up here," Chao Shuying said. "Although you don't have a unique physique, you possess a Divine-grade bloodline, something arguably even rarer, and that may very well be the reason behind your abnormal pill absorption rate."
"Wait a moment," Ren Xia suddenly said. "We've confirmed he has a powerful bloodline, but is there any way to identify which one? If we knew that, we could take advantage of it."

Chao Shuying shook her head. "Not with the tools we currently have. This crimson needle was created only two years ago. It can measure the grade of a bloodline, but that's all. However, if you can somehow bring me the blood of someone from the Tian Family, I can compare it with Senior Tian's and determine if there's a match."
"Blood from the Tian Family? That's easier said than done. At this point, I'd have better luck getting phoenix blood." Ren Xia sighed.

"Then we can only make use of what little information we have—that he is capable of absorbing pill effects far more efficiently than most. Does the Tian Family have this trait within their lineage?" Chao Shuying asked.
"Unfortunately, even the Immortal Clans have very little information on the Three Pillars of Heaven," Ren Xia replied.
"Does it even matter what bloodline I have? I already know what it's capable of, and that's more than enough for me." Tian Yang interjected.
"Although I'm confident that it's the work of your bloodline, we cannot be certain until we do some testing," Chao Shuying said.
"More tests, huh?" "It'll be quite simple. We just need to feed you some more pills and see what happens."
"Alright."

And so, Tian Yang began experimenting with his bloodline, taking all manner of pills—some that heightened strength, others that increased cultivation speed. Ren Xia and Kulas also took part in the tests to compare themselves with him.
Unsurprisingly, the results were exactly as expected. Every pill Tian Yang consumed produced a much stronger effect than when either of them took the same pill.
"You should know, I was raised in a privileged environment. Envy isn't something I'm prone to," Chao Shuying said. "Yet I can't help but be deeply envious of your talent right now."

"Is it really that big of a deal?" Tian Yang said. "It just makes pills work better, doesn't it? Without the money to buy them, it's useless. No wonder I never noticed it in all these hundreds of years."
Chao Shuying rubbed her eyes with a weary sigh.
"You honestly have no idea how terrifyingly powerful your bloodline is, do you? Others aside, even I would kill for such a talent."
Kulas laughed and said, "You may have learned about it late, but better late than never, right? Hahaha!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2282 A New Discovery
paragraphs: "Better late than never, huh?" Tian Yang sighed. "Unfortunately, there is such a thing as being too late, and I'm already at that stage."
"What makes you say that?" Kulas asked, his brows tightening.

"Look at me," Tian Yang replied. "I am already a True Immortal. At this stage, ordinary pills— even high-grade ones—are meaningless. Only something on the level of Heaven Defying Ascension Pills would benefit me to an acceptable degree. If only I had realized this talent when I was still a disciple at the Immortal Monastery..."

"That's nonsense," Kulas said while shaking his head. "You make it sound like True Immortal is the end of cultivation when, in reality, it's just the beginning. There is always a higher cultivation realm, and very recently, there has been a rumor regarding the discovery of a new kind of 'spiritual energy', surpassing even Immortal Qi." "Is that true?" Ren Xia asked, genuinely taken aback.

Kulas shrugged. "Why would I fabricate something like that? Though little is known right now, many believe it is the key that allows cultivators to surpass the Immortal Realm and step into an entirely different realm."
He turned to Tian Yang and continued, "Therefore, you shouldn't say something like being too late, Brother Tian. There's still so much to be discovered in this limitless world."
"I guess so." Tian Yang nodded, feeling much better after hearing Kulas' words.

Once the day came to an end, Tian Yang resumed his life on the Giant's Continent. He spent his days sparring with Kulas, studying Array Symbols under Lu An, and, of course, accompanying Ren Xia in bed. From time to time, Chao Shuying would summon him so she could further study his bloodline.

Although Tian Yang had little interest in his own bloodline, he found himself deeply intrigued by the Three Pillars of Heaven, particularly their origins, and whether Elder Sun might have come from such a background.

However, acquiring any information about the Three Pillars of Heaven was nearly impossible without traveling to the Holy Continent, which was located on the far opposite side of the world, and Tian Yang had no plans to travel so far at this moment.
In the blink of an eye, twenty years have passed since Tian Yang and Ren Xia started living with Kulas on the Giant's Continent.
"How is my brother's progress with his studies on Array Symbols?" Kulas suddenly asked Lu An one day.

Lu An gave a bittersweet smile as he replied, "I was just about to bring that up, Your Majesty. Senior Tian... his talent for comprehension is extraordinary. He absorbs everything I teach him like a dry sponge desperate for water."
"Tell me about it," Kulas said with an entertained smile.

Lu An gave a bittersweet smile as he replied, "I was just about to bring that up, Your Majesty. Senior Tian... his talent for comprehension is extraordinary. He absorbs everything I teach him like a dry sponge desperate for water."
"Tell me about it," Kulas said with an entertained smile.
"In just twenty short years, he'd managed to catch up to me, who has studied Array Symbols for nearly my entire 700 years of life."
"Are you saying that he's already a Level 6 Array Master like you?" Kulas asked, eyebrows raised in surprise.
Although he was already aware of Tian Yang's terrifying comprehension talents, it was still hard to comprehend.

"No," Lu An replied with a shake of his head. "His ability to comprehend and learn is extraordinary, but that doesn't mean he can apply it right away. Despite his terrifying comprehension, his practical experience remains quite normal."
"I understand... then will you continue to instruct him?" Kulas asked.
"Truthfully, I have nothing more to teach him," Lu An replied. "What he needs now is practice, not guidance. Of course, should he have any questions, I will gladly assist."

"In that case, I shall relieve you of your duties," Kulas said. "You may continue your own pursuits as you see fit. Thank you for accepting my request. I know it couldn't have been easy for an expert such as yourself to instruct a beginner."

"No, on the contrary, it was a learning experience for me as well. I've never seriously taught anyone before. In fact, I'm considering opening a school here on the continent so I can continue teaching others. What do you think, Your Majesty?"

"A school for Array Masters, huh?" Kulas mused. "It would advance our continent even further, and we'd have far more Array Masters in the future. Very well, I'll allow it. No, I'll even give you my full support.
"Thank you, Giant Emperor."
Even after being dismissed, Lu An continued to visit Tian Yang and informed him of the situation on his next trip.
"I understand. Thank you for all your efforts," Tian Yang said with a faint, bittersweet smile. "You might be the first true master I've ever had."
"Seriously? Didn't you belong to a sect before?" Lu An asked, surprised.
"Yes, but I trained alone most of the time. And whenever I did receive guidance, it was through public lectures with hundreds of disciples all listening at once."

"And unless you're exceptionally talented or have some kind of background or reputation, the elders won't approach you. Most disciples have to seek them out and hope to be accepted. Although I was close to an elder, I could never see her as my master, and she was more like an older sister to me."

"To think you have reached your current position without a proper Master your entire life... Honestly, I'm having a hard time believing it. You always talk about lacking talent, but from where I am sitting, you're extremely talented."
"Thanks..."
Time flowed on, seasons came and went, and in the blink of an eye, another hundred years had passed.

During this time, the Giant's Continent continued to develop, and Kulas' influence started to spread beyond the continent. Ren Xia finally broke through and stepped into the Golden Immortal realm. As for Tian Yang, he remained at the True Immortal realm like Kulas. Yet the two of them could instinctively sense that they had reached a bottleneck—one that could not be surpassed through ordinary means, much like when they once stood on the verge of entering the Immortal Realm.
However, while his cultivation made little to no progress, Tian Yang had made significant progress as an Array Master and now qualified as a level 4 Array Master with his current skills.

chapters.title: Chapter 2283 Enlightened One
paragraphs: "Senior Tian, you've been at our place for over a hundred years at this point, but it feels like I am the only one who knows you," Xie Mey remarked when she visited him one day to talk about her latest training session outside the palace.
"That's probably because you are the only one who approaches and talks to me," Tian Yang said.
After a slight pause, he continued, "Madam Chao, too, I guess."
"Do you have no interest in the others? Is that why you're not making efforts to know them?" Xie Mey then asked.

Tian Yang shrugged and said, "Although I see them in the halls from time to time, they have never even tried to speak with me. Hell, even their greetings are done in silence. But honestly, I don't feel bothered by it—probably because I don't really care."
"Is that so...? Well, that works in my favor," Xie Mey chuckled. "It means I get to keep you all to myself."
She suddenly scanned the room and then asked, "Where's Senior Ren? She's usually here whenever I visit."
"She recently started studying alchemy, so she spends most of her time with Madam Chao now."
"So she's finally bored with you, huh?" Xie Mey teased.
Before he could respond, she continued, "Say, have you ever thought about accepting another wife?"
"No, I can't say that I have. Where is this coming from?" Tian Yang looked at her with raised eyebrows.
Xie Mey let out a soft chuckle. "Because I've considered becoming your partner."
"Huh?" Tian Yang blinked, startled.
"Why are you so surprised?" she asked, amused by his reaction. "I'm a perfectly healthy young woman. It's only natural for thoughts like that to cross my mind."
"It isn't the thought itself that concerns me—it's who you're thinking about." Tian Yang sighed.
"Why me? I am your father's sworn brother, you know?"
"So what? You're not actually his brother. And you're the only man close to me who isn't part of my own family."
Not knowing how to handle her boldness, Tian Yang quickly changed the subject.
"Have you... spoken to your father about this? If not, you really should..."
Xie Mey smiled. "So you're saying that as long as he approves, you'll accept me?"
"What? How did you twist my words into that?" Tian Yang sighed.
Xie Mey chuckled, "It sure is fun messing with you, Senior Tian. Anyway, I was just joking with you."
Tian Yang was speechless.
"Now then, I'll take my leave and continue my training. See you next time, Senior Tian."
Xie Mey departed shortly after.
However, instead of returning to her training as she claimed, she headed straight to Kulas, intent on discussing a certain matter.
The years drifted by, and before they realized it, another three hundred years had passed.

Two hundred years ago, news of the Immortal Monastery's reopening reached Tian Yang through Kulas. Now, two hundred years later, they had not only fully recovered from the devastation wrought by the Immortal Clans but had even flourished, rising to become an elite sect.
A certain piece of information about a groundbreaking discovery also began spreading like wildfire, sending shockwaves throughout the cultivation world.

The rumor was said to have originated from the Holy Continent, claiming that someone had discovered an entirely new type of spiritual energy—one even stronger than Immortal Qi. It had first surfaced as nothing more than a whisper three hundred years ago, but now, it had grown into something far more substantial than a mere rumor.
"Have you heard? They've named this new spiritual energy 'Celestial Qi,' and rumors claim that cultivating it could elevate an Immortal cultivator to godhood."
Kulas shared the news during a private meeting with Tian Yang and Ren Xia.
"Celestial Qi, huh?" Tian Yang muttered with a pondering look on his face.

"How was it even discovered in the first place?" Ren Xia asked. "And has this person already gone past the True Immortal realm, which is said to be the limit right now? Most importantly, can we trust this information? There have been numerous frauds throughout the years, after all."
"I'm not sure how it was discovered, but the information is definitely trustworthy, as it came directly from the Three Pillars of Heaven."
"The pioneers of cultivation, huh? If so, this is indeed massive," Tian Yang remarked.

"Maybe for them, but I highly doubt it will benefit us anytime soon," Ren Xia shrugged. "The Three Pillars of Heaven will likely keep the method to cultivate Celestial Qi to themselves until they're far ahead of everyone else. It's exactly what happened when they discovered Immortal Qi, too."
"What? They discovered Immortal Qi as well? How...?" Tian Yang muttered, stunned. It almost felt as though the Three Pillars of Heaven were advancing the entire cultivation world on their own.
"They claim it came through enlightenment," Kulas said.

After a brief silence, he continued, "I only learned this because I once snuck into my father's room back when I was still in the Immortal Might Clan, but within the Three Pillars of Heaven, there is someone known as the 'Enlightened One'. This person possesses a unique talent—the ability to receive divinations directly from Heaven itself through enlightenment, and it is through these enlightenments that they learned about cultivation."
"Seriously? Divination from the Heavens? That sounds like complete nonsense," Ren Xia scoffed, shaking her head. "They're clearly hiding the truth behind some fancy story."
Kulas shrugged. "Honestly? As absurd as it sounds, I kind of believe it. How else would they have discovered so much?"
"What do you think?" Both of them turned to Tian Yang.
"It does sound like nonsense at first," he admitted. "However, I've witnessed things far more unbelievable, so it doesn't sound entirely impossible to me."
"Really? Like what?" Ren Xia asked with a weird face.
He shook his head, his tone apologetic. "It concerns the forbidden information within Han Zexian's tomb, so I cannot speak of it..."
"Oh? More unbelievable than the Enlightened One?" Kulas replied with a smile. "Now I'm really curious."
