chapters.title: Chapter 2294 After the Tournament
paragraphs: Two weeks had passed since the Tournament of Strength began. Despite the overwhelming number of participants, it proceeded smoothly, without incident.
Although the vast majority of participants were human—and more than half were eliminated—less than one percent of those disqualified were giants.
This showcased the Giant Race's prowess to the rest of the world, just as Kulas wanted. "The giant's performance... is much better than I anticipated," Kulas suddenly remarked.
"What? Aren't they your people? How can you not know their capabilities?" Ren Xia questioned.

"How many giants do you think exist within the continent now?" he replied. "It may have been possible back when I first started this, but nowadays, it's impossible to keep track of everyone. Hell, I am barely keeping track of my own children these days."
"Sounds like it's about time for you to stop making more, then," Ren Xia said.

"Hahaha! You think I am making more children because I enjoy it? This is all to expand the Giant Race's influence. Sooner or later, we'll start expanding our influence outside the continent, and having more children will make that much easier."
Kulas spoke of things that he wouldn't even tell his own children without any hesitation, almost as if he had no restrictions when it came to them.

Ren Xia frowned at his words and said, "So... you're going to use your children for your own political gain. As expected of someone from the Immortal Clans. Even if you claim to have left them behind, your nature remains the same."

Despite her harsh words, Kulas wasn't offended. He knew she had always despised her family because of their arranged marriage—how they had used her for their own benefit. Of course, Ren Xia had never told him the truth. He had merely sensed that her seemingly unreasonable hostility came from somewhere, and as he grew older and more experienced, he came to understand it better.

"Let's not make any assumptions," he said. "I am not saying that I intend to sell my children for connections. I am merely saying that without children, it won't be possible to expand my family outside the continent."
"...Sorry." Ren Xia offered a rare apology.
"Oh? Look who it is." Kulas suddenly said, his eyes fixed on one of the platforms.
Tian Yang and Ren Xia followed his gaze to see a familiar figure. It was none other than Xie Mey.
Sure enough, Kulas' children were also participating in the tournament. Of course, this wasn't an order from Kulas. They simply wanted to show off their skills and hopefully make their father proud.
Xie Mey's match ended almost in the blink of an eye. Using nothing but her innate prowess, she utterly defeated her opponent with a single punch.

Her opponent wasn't an ordinary cultivator, either. He was clearly an experienced body refiner with his muscular physique and bulging muscles. Yet, all it took was a single punch from Xie Mey to cripple his arm.

"Ah! I'm sorry, I didn't know you were so fragile." Xie Mey apologized to the body refiner after destroying his entire arm. Though her words were sincere, they only angered the body refiner even further.
However, the body refiner calmed down after Xie Mey gave him a pill that helped him restore his arm.
"Hahaha! That girl is always like this." Kulas laughed after witnessing the match.
"I rarely see her in her giant form," said Tian Yang. "Meanwhile, I've only ever seen your other children in their giant form."
"She's been like that for as long as I remember," said Kulas. "If you want to know her reason... You should ask her later. Even I don't know."
The tournament continued, and after another two weeks, the tournament reached its final stages.

Unsurprisingly, the last few participants remaining were all giants. As for Kulas' children, they all forfeited toward the end, as they intended only to display their strength and not claim the champion.
In the end, the final victory of the Tournament of Strength was a giant by the name of Grandis.
As the victor, Grandis was granted the title of Champion and the opportunity to fight Kulas.
"Not bad, young giant!"
Kulas leaped from the spectator's area to the platform.
"As the champion, I will grant you a chance to fight me. Do you accept, warrior?"
"This humble warrior accepts, Your Majesty!" Grandis was given a pill to recover his energy before they fought.
To nobody's surprise, the fight was one-sided, lasting barely five minutes.
After the fight—
"It was a good fight, Warrior Grandis," Kulas said afterward. "I have never accepted a disciple before, but you can be my first. What do you say?"
"I-It would be an honor!" Grandis accepted without hesitation, which was a no-brainer.
Thus, Kulas acquired his first true disciple despite his thousands of years of experience.
Although the tournament ended, many visitors lingered on the continent and continued touring the area.
A week later, Sun Rouxi and the Three Pillars of Heaven arrived at the palace to fulfill their appointment.
While the six people from the Three Pillars of Heaven went to speak privately with Kulas, Sun Rouxi and Elder Jing went to meet Tian Yang and Ren Xia.
"Do you remember me?" Elder Jing asked Tian Yang.
Much like Sun Rouxi, she'd barely changed since the last time he saw her. Her cultivation had also reached Silver Immortal.
"Of course, I do, Elder Jing. You were always beside Sister Sun."
"Hm? Sister Sun?" Elder Jing raised her eyebrows at the way he addressed Sun Rouxi.
"Well, I can't call her Elder Sun anymore, and she's like an elder sister to me," he explained.
"There's no need to call me Elder Jing, either, as I am no longer a sect elder. Jing Ruye is my name, but you can just call me Sister Jing."
"I understand, Senior Sister Jing."

As Tian Yang and Jing Ruye continued their conversation, reminiscing about their time in the Immortal Monastery for the next hour, the entire palace suddenly trembled, and an overwhelming pressure filled with killing intent swept through the halls, engulfing the place.
"Wh-What's going on?!" Jing Ruye exclaimed as she jumped from her seat, startled by the immense killing intent.
"This aura... it belongs to Kulas!" Tian Yang frowned.

chapters.title: Chapter 2295 Kulas' Mistake
paragraphs: After sensing Kulas' immense killing intent that engulfed the entire palace, Tian Yang rushed out of his room and ran toward the throne room, where Kulas was having his meeting with the Three Pillars of Heaven.
"Hey! What's going on?!" Sun Rouxi asked as she and the others followed behind.
"I would love to know, too!" Tian Yang said.
"Could it be one of his episodes?" Ren Xia guessed out loud.
"Episodes?" Jing Ruye questioned.
"Sorry, but it's a little personal, so I cannot explain without Kulas' permission," Tian Yang apologized.
"Is that so..."

They quickly arrived at the throne room, only to find that its doors were gone—not opened or shattered, but forcibly torn away. Two members of the Three Pillars of Heaven lay unconscious on the ground, their bodies strewn amid the wreckage.

Tian Yang didn't hesitate and rushed inside. The remaining members stood before Kulas, each of them grievously injured. One, however, lay motionless on the floor, his entire head crushed beyond recognition.
"What is the meaning of this, Giant Emperor?! Why did you suddenly attack us?!"
"Have you gone insane?! Not only did you attack us, but you even killed one of us! Are you trying to declare war against the Three Pillars of Heaven?!"
The remaining members of the Three Pillars of Heaven shouted at Kulas while clutching their life-saving treasures.
However, Kulas merely stood there, as if lost in a daze.
"Kulas!"
Tian Yang rushed forward, positioning himself directly between Kulas and the others.
"Kulas! What are you doing?!"
This time, Kulas reacted. The emptiness in his gaze faded as reason swiftly returned.
"Wh-What happened...?" he asked in a puzzled tone.
"That's what we should be asking, Giant Emperor!"
"You suddenly attacked us while we were talking!
"What!" Kulas' expression sank as he realized that he'd just lost his temper again.
"How dare you act surprised like you weren't aware?! Are you mocking us?!"
"Bastard, you killed one of our people unprovoked! I hope you're prepared for the consequences!"
"W-Wait! I can explain!" Kulas hastily said.
"There's nothing to explain!"
"We'll be taking our leave now!"

The members of the Three Pillars of Heaven were all between Bronze and Golden Immortal, so there was nothing they could do before Kulas, who was a True Immortal. Even if they wanted revenge, they would need to return to their family first.
However, just as they turned around and prepared to leave, Tian Yang stood in their way and stopped them.
"Who the hell are you?!"
Tian Yang then said, "Although it won't change what had happened, allow the Giant Emperor to explain himself first."
"Are you telling us to stay here and wait for him to attack us again?! How ridiculous!"
"I will personally ensure that he won't harm another hair on your bodies. I promise," he replied.
"We won't listen to the words of a nobody like you!" "You can trust him," Sun Rouxi suddenly stepped forward and said.
"Lady Sun...? What is your relationship with this man?"
"We're acquaintances."
"We'll listen to your excuse, but we will leave immediately afterward." One of them eventually said.
Now that he had a chance to clear up the confusion, Kulas explained his condition to them. However, it didn't lessen the victims' anger. If anything, it only made them angrier.
"So you decided to meet with us while knowing about your own instability?! That's reckless and irresponsible of you, Giant Emperor!"
"It hadn't happened in over fifty years, so I thought it was fine..." Kulas sighed. "I apologize for my mistake, and I am willing to compensate for your losses.
"How dare you even speak of compensation?! You killed one of our people! There's nothing you can do to compensate for that!"
Kulas had no response, so he remained silent, his expression full of guilt.
Soon, Kulas' family and guards arrived at the scene, as they also noticed the commotion.
No longer feeling safe, the members of the Three Pillars of Heaven dared not linger any longer and prepared to leave.
"Lady Sun, we're leaving! We must report this to the rest of the family as soon as possible!"
Sun Rouxi wanted to stay a little longer to talk to Tian Yang more about the situation, but given the circumstances, she had no choice but to return to the Holy Continent.
Once they all left, Kulas explained the situation to his family.
"I fucked up," he admitted with a heavy sigh. "I lost my temper during our conversation, and by the time I realized, I had attacked them, even killing one of them."
"This... what will happen now?" One of his wives asked.
"Will it lead to war?" Another asked.
"Given our current standing, it's unlikely that war will break out. However, it's not impossible," Kulas said after pondering for a moment.

Now that the Giant Continent had become a true powerhouse, a war with the Three Pillars of Heaven would undoubtedly affect the entire world and unleash unprecedented devastation. It was not something that could be taken lightly.

"There's nothing we can do but wait for their response. Until then, I am going to enter seclusion," Kulas suddenly declared. "I must deal with this instability of mine once and for all, no matter what it takes."
"Unless the Three Pillars of Heaven act, do not disturb me."

After giving instructions to his family, Kulas turned to look at Tian Yang and said, "I'm sorry. Because of my mistake, I have offended the Three Pillars of Heaven. You should leave the Giant Continent for the time being—at least until things cool down."
"Are you really going to push us away after what happened?" Tian Yang frowned.

"Yes, I am. Unless you know how to fix my condition, there's nothing you can do for me. I know you're angry and disappointed, but I would rather you feel that way for the rest of your life than endanger you."
As much as he hated to admit it, Kulas was right. There was nothing they could do, especially when they didn't even know what was causing his mood swings.

chapters.title: Chapter 2296 Three Pillars of Heaven's Demands
paragraphs: Tian Yang sighed and said, "Fine, I can leave the continent if you want. However, you must give me some of your blood. I'll look for a doctor and see if we can learn more about your situation outside."
"I'll leave it to you."

Without the slightest hesitation, Kulas handed Tian Yang a large vial of his freshly drawn blood, stunning his own family into silence. The amount he gave was greater than all the blood he had bestowed upon them collectively.

Although Tian Yang had stayed in the palace for a long time, most of Kulas's children had never realized how close the two truly were, for they rarely spoke to one another. Only after witnessing this did they begin to grasp the depth of their relationship.

A few of them felt the urge to voice their doubts, questioning whether Tian Yang would truly use such priceless blood to help their father—or sell it for his own gain. However, they also sensed that doing so might result in enraging their father, so they held their tongues.
After putting away Kulas' blood, Tian Yang said to him, "Promise me one thing. That you'll contact me if anything happens with the Three Pillars of Heaven, or your condition gets worse."
"I promise." Kulas nodded with a smile.
Tian Yang and Ren Xia didn't linger at the palace and left shortly after. Rather than waiting for a ship to return home, they decided to just fly back.
"I can't believe that idiot actually killed someone from the Three Pillars of Heaven," Ren Xia sighed out loud as they traveled.
"It's odd. He's been fine for fifty years, but the moment he meets with people from the Three Pillars of Heaven, his mood swings return. Is it really a coincidence?" Tian Yang questioned out loud.
"Are you suggesting that the Three Pillars of Heaven have something to do with his mood swings? That's impossible, given that it has been happening to him long before they even met."
"I guess... but I still cannot help but feel something off about the whole situation. Though I might just be overthinking it.
"Putting that aside, what is our plan now?" Ren Xia then asked.
"I'm going to look for the Heavenly Doctor and see if he could figure out anything about Kulas' condition through his blood," he said.
"The Heavenly Doctor, huh? I heard he loves to wander the Divine Heavens and never stays in the same place for longer than a month. Finding him will be a pain in the ass."
"Even if he moves around every day, he's our only hope right now."

Thus, Tian Yang and Ren Xia started their next journey. They wandered the Divine Heaven in search of the Heavenly Doctor, who was known to be able to cure any disease. Meanwhile, Sun Rouxi and the others returned to the Holy Continent, where they revealed the situation to the rest of the family.

Unsurprisingly, the Three Pillars of Heaven were enraged by the news, especially the Sun Family, as the only individual who died belonged to their family. The higher-ups from the three families gathered for a meeting to discuss how they should respond to Kulas' actions.
"Uncontrollable mood swings? What a convenient excuse. I don't believe it for one second," said one of the elders from the Ji Family.
"I also don't believe it," agreed an elder from the Tian Family.
"So, how should we deal with this situation? Do we go to war with them?" "Let's slow down a little. I don't think it would be wise to declare war so quickly," said the Patriarch of the Tian Family.

The Patriarch of the Ji Family then spoke, "I also don't recommend going to war with them. While their numbers are small, they make up for it with their overwhelming prowess. It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say that in the entire Divine Heaven, they're only below our Three Pillars of Heaven in terms of prowess."

"Are you saying that we should just act like the Giant Emperor didn't kill one of my people? The person he killed was one of our elders, no less!" The Patriarch of the Sun Family angrily shouted, even slamming the table with a clenched fist.
"We didn't say that. The Giant Emperor will definitely pay for attacking us unprovoked, but we must navigate this wisely," said the Patriarch of the Tian Family.

"And how the hell is sitting around a smart choice?! As you said, the Giant Race is already near our level! And it only took them a few thousand years to reach such a level! It will only be a matter of time before they catch up to us! Do you really want to wait until then to punish them?! What's to say they won't attack us?!"

The Patriarch of the Tian Family let out a heavy sigh, shaking his head. "Even if you say that, do you understand the consequences of going to war with the Giant Race? It would not only impact our families but also the entire world. If powers of our stature were to collide..."
He paused for a second.
"The devastation would be beyond imagining."

"We just need to overwhelm them before they can do anything! Don't tell me you're scared of them?! We're the Three Pillars of Heaven! The Heavens have chosen us to lead this world! How can we be scared of a few giants?!"
Over the next several months, the Three Pillars of Heaven would argue back and forth about how they should respond to the situation.
In the end, the Three Pillars of Heaven made several demands of Kulas. If he were to fulfill these demands, they would no longer pursue the issue.
However, if he were to refuse, then the Three Pillars of Heaven had no choice but to declare war against them.
When Kulas heard their demands, he immediately erupted with rage.
"What utter bullshit! You want me to execute ten of my own children and one of my wives because I killed one of yours?! As if I could accept these demands!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2297 War With the Three Pillars of Heaven
paragraphs: "You sons of bitches! While I admit that I was in the wrong for killing one of your people, how could you give such outrageous demands?! Are you even human?!" Kulas exploded with anger after receiving the Three Pillars of Heaven's demands through one of their messengers.

The messenger continued coldly, "You didn't kill some insignificant nobody. You killed one of the Sun Family's elders. We're already being generous with our demand—because not even the lives of a hundred of your children could compensate for the loss of one of our elders."
Kulas trembled with anger, exuding such immense killing intent that it forced the messenger to his knees.

"W-Was the elder not enough to satisfy you?! Are you going to kill me, too?!" The messenger exclaimed with a terrified yet provocative expression on his face, almost as if he was daring Kulas to kill him.
Kulas retracted his killing intent and fell silent.

After a moment of silence, he spoke in a calm voice, "If the Three Pillars of Heaven are so desperate for war, you need only say the word. There's no need to make unreasonable demands or deliberately provoke me."
"W-What?" The messenger's eyes widened in disbelief at Kulas's words.
'He's not actually going to go to war with the Three Pillars of Heaven over a measly few lives, right?' he wondered inwardly.

Despite the apparent severity of the demand, the messenger truly believed it was reasonable. In his mind, Kulas would rather sacrifice a few of his own children than provoke a war with the most powerful force in the world.
In his view, defying the Three Pillars of Heaven was sheer stupidity. Were he in Kulas's position, he would not hesitate to sacrifice his entire family to avoid offending them.
"You heard me," Kulas calmly said. "If the Three Pillars of Heaven desire war, I'll give it to them."

"W-Wait! You should reconsider this!" the messenger shouted. "I admit the Giant Race is formidable, but it's incomparably weaker than the Three Pillars of Heaven! You'll lose far more than just a few lives if this becomes a war! You have plenty of children anyway—what's the loss of a few?!"
"What's the loss of a few, you say...?" Kulas muttered.
Then he suddenly burst into laughter. "Hahaha! I never realized the Three Pillars of Heaven valued life so little! Did you bastards sell your souls to the devil or something?"
In truth, the Three Pillars of Heaven were fully aware of how unreasonable their demands were. However, they deliberately made such demands to put Kulas and the Giant Race in their place.
Simply put, they sought to assert their dominance over Kulas and the growing Giant Race, hoping to keep them firmly in check even as they continued to grow stronger.

After all, the Giant Race was spreading its influence and growing powerful at a terrifying pace—so much so that even the Three Pillars of Heaven, who considered themselves unrivaled, were beginning to feel the pressure.
Kulas then spoke in a cold voice, "I will not accept your demands. Go back and relay my message to the Three Pillars of Heaven."
"You... Are you sure you want to go this route?"
Kulas's eyes narrowed as he snarled, "If you don't get the fuck out of my face this instant, I'll have your corpse deliver my message instead!"
The messenger didn't dare to linger and immediately ran out of the room, tripping in the process.
After returning to the Holy Continent, the messenger relayed Kulas's response to the Patriarchs and Elders.
"That giant bastard was unbelievably rude and showed no respect for the name of the Three Pillars of Heaven!"
While he conveyed Kulas's message, the messenger did not hesitate to twist it, deliberately making it sound far worse than it truly was.

"To dare defy us so openly... These bastards have truly grown arrogant after gaining power too quickly," said the Patriarch of the Sun Family. "We must show them the consequences of their arrogance! Since they seem so eager to go to war, let's go to war!"
Since Kulas denied their demands, war was inevitable.
The Patriarch of the Tian Family sighed. "You make it sound as though this would be easy. Quite frankly, they hold a significant advantage due to their location."

The Giant Race was largely confined to the Giant Continent—an island surrounded by a vast ocean teeming with sea beasts—granting them an immense geographic advantage. Even if war were to be declared, it would primarily be the Three Pillars of Heaven pressing for battle. As long as the Giant Race remained on the defensive, they would be forced to launch the attack themselves, placing them at a clear disadvantage.

This meant that despite being weaker than the Three Pillars of Heaven, the Giant Race would not be dominated so easily. As long as they played their cards properly, they could easily prolong the war until they were ready to fight back.
The Three Pillars of Heaven were aware of this, hence why they didn't immediately declare war on the Giant Race.
Time passed. Although many years had gone by since Kulas rejected their demands, the Three Pillars of Heaven had yet to openly declare war. In truth, however, the war had already begun.

The Three Pillars of Heaven had quietly dispatched assassins and hired mercenaries to strike at the Giant Race, operating in ways that could not be traced back to them. As a result, aside from Kulas and the Giant Race themselves, no one else was aware that a shadow war had erupted between the two most powerful backgrounds in the world.

As a result of the war, all giants who had left the continent were recalled, and the Giant Race once again entered seclusion. However, unlike in the past, they did not seal off the continent, continuing instead to allow outsiders to enter their domain.
Meanwhile, after many years of searching, Tian Yang and Ren Xia finally found the Heavenly Doctor. Though they were unaware that war had already begun, they could sense that something had changed.

As long as they played their cards properly, they could easily prolong the war until they were ready to fight back.
The Three Pillars of Heaven were aware of this, hence why they didn't immediately declare war on the Giant Race.
Time passed.
Although many years had gone by since Kulas rejected their demands, the Three Pillars of Heaven had yet to openly declare war.
In truth, however, the war had already begun.
The Three Pillars of Heaven had quietly dispatched assassins and hired mercenaries to strike at the Giant Race, operating in ways that could not be traced back to them.
As a result, aside from Kulas and the Giant Race themselves, no one else was aware that a shadow war had erupted between the two most powerful backgrounds in the world.
As a result of the war, all giants who had left the continent were recalled, and the Giant Race once again entered seclusion.
However, unlike in the past, they did not seal off the continent, continuing instead to allow outsiders to enter their domain.
Meanwhile, after many years of searching, Tian Yang and Ren Xia finally found the Heavenly Doctor.
Though they were unaware that war had already begun, they could sense that something had changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 2298 War With the Three Pillars of Heaven(2)
paragraphs: "I heard rumors that all the giants who were outside the Giant Continent have returned, and that none of them have left in quite some time," Ren Xia said to Tian Yang as they waited for the Heavenly Doctor to finish his business.
"Maybe they're just being cautious," Tian Yang replied. "Kulas did kill someone from the Three Pillars of Heaven, after all. They might be worried about retaliation."
"Even if war breaks out, they should be fine as long as they remain within their territory. The Giant's Continent is akin to a fortress, one that is surrounded by water."
Some time later, the Heavenly Doctor returned.
"I have analyzed the blood you gave me," he said as he returned Kulas' leftover blood. "I was unable to find anything out of the ordinary. He's as healthy as one could be."
Tian Yang wasn't surprised to learn that Kulas wasn't ill, but it did nothing to explain his mood swings.

"My friend has been experiencing intense mood swings lately," Tian Yang said. "He claims they occur at random and that he doesn't realize what's happening until afterward. When it does happen, he gets angry and violent."

The Heavenly Doctor spoke, "When it comes to this kind of instability, a few causes come to mind. I can rule out poison and illness, as I have already confirmed they are not the source. That leaves three possibilities: a curse, unresolved heart demons, or something he was born with."

Tian Yang said, "Since it only started recently, it's unlikely he was born with it. He did suffer a severe and traumatic experience long ago, one that caused him to lose his mind for a period. Still, he's confident it isn't a heart demon. That leaves a curse—but do curses like that really exist?"
"Of course. There are many powerful curses out there, and one that causes one to lose their mind is not common, but also not as rare as you might think."
"How can I confirm that it's a curse? And if it is confirmed to be one, how do I get rid of it?"
"There are treasures out there that can detect curses. If it is a curse, there are plenty of methods of getting rid of it. Here are a few."
The Heavenly Doctor wrote down the names of several treasures and pills that would help him.
"The ones at the bottom are the most effective but also the most expensive. You might also have trouble finding them," he said afterward.
"Thank you."

After paying the Heavenly Doctor his service fee, Tian Yang and Ren Xia left to find the treasures he had listed for them. Naturally, they didn't even take a moment to consider the cheaper options and immediately went for the most expensive.
As Tian Yang and Ren Xia continued their journey, the Three Pillars of Heaven and the Giant Race continued their silent war in the background.

Although the Three Pillars of Heaven were the more active and aggressive side, the Giant Race did not remain passive targets. Able to shrink their bodies to human size, they infiltrated the Holy Continent and launched their own strikes against the Three Pillars of Heaven.

However, due to the immense distance between them, such attacks occurred only once every few decades. The Holy Continent lay on the opposite side of the world, and even with their vast wealth and near-limitless resources, preparing a single strike demanded tremendous time and effort.
Of course, the Giant Race faced the same issues. Yet, it did not deter the Three Pillars of Heaven from continuing the war. After all, they had all the time and resources in the world.
Ten years... fifty years... a hundred years later.
Tian Yang and Ren Xia finally acquired the treasure needed to detect curses and cure them after a hundred years of searching.
Neither of them had anticipated that it would take this long, even though the Heavenly Doctor warned them.
After gathering the treasures, Tian Yang and Ren Xia immediately returned to the Giant's Continent to meet with Kulas.
When they returned to the Giant's Continent, they immediately sensed a heavy atmosphere in every city—one that had not been present before. However, most visitors seemed completely unaware of it.
While the outsiders went about their days as usual, every giant seemed to be on alert, as though they were expecting an attack at any moment.
When they arrived at the palace, they were stopped by the guards there—newly appointed guards who weren't aware of their identity.
"Sorry, but the Giant Emperor is not accepting any visitors at this moment."
Just as Tian Yang was about to introduce himself, he noticed a familiar figure approaching them from the palace.
"Let them inside. They're my father's companions.
It was none other than Xie Mey, who had noticed their presence even before they arrived.
With Xie Mey vouching for them, the guards no longer had a reason to stop them.
Tian Yang and Ren Xia followed Xie Mey inside the palace.
"What's the situation like right now?" Tian Yang asked.
"Not good," Xie Mey sighed. "You'll understand once you see my father."
Xie Mey brought them directly to Kulas' room—his private quarters rather than the throne room.
She knocked on the door and said, "Father, Senior Tian, and Senior Ren have returned."
However, there was no response from Kulas.
Xie Mey turned to Tian Yang and said in a solemn tone, "Please try not to be too surprised when you see my father's condition."
After saying that, she pushed the door to Kulas' room open.
However, even before they stepped inside, Tian Yang knew something was wrong from the ominous presence within.
With a deep frown on his face, he stepped inside the room with Ren Xia and Xie Mey.
"What in heaven's name...?" Tian Yang's eyes widened in disbelief when he saw Kulas lying on the bed, looking gravely ill.
Kulas didn't merely look sick. He looked as though he were on his deathbed.

chapters.title: Chapter 2299 War With the Three Pillars of Heaven(3)
paragraphs: "W-What the hell is wrong with Kulas? What happened to him in the time we were gone?" Tian Yang questioned in a dumbfounded voice as he approached the bed, a look of disbelief on his face.
They'd been gone for only a little over a hundred years, yet Kulas looked like he'd aged millions of years. Tian Yang couldn't comprehend it.

"It started shortly after you left," Xie Mey explained in a defeated voice. "It was as sudden and random as his mood swings. At first, it started out as a cold. Then, it gradually worsened until he got a fever. Nowadays, he spends most of his time asleep, only waking up once a year for a few hours. Unfortunately, we don't know the cause even at this very moment."
"A fever? Cultivators cannot get fevers, much less a cold. And he's no ordinary cultivator but an Immortal..." Ren Xia remarked with a confused voice after hearing the details.
"This is outrageous," Tian Yang suddenly said with clenched fists. "How is it that every time we leave this place, something drastic happens? It's as if the heavens are purposefully messing with me."

He turned to look at Xie Mey and continued, "We spoke with the Heavenly Doctor, and he said that Kulas' mood swings might be caused by a curse. And for the last hundred years, we have looked for treasures that could get rid of curses."
"A curse, you say?"
Tian Yang nodded and retrieved several treasures from his spatial ring. "Although we can't say for certain that it's a curse, it's the best guess we have now. I am going to examine him now."
Without hesitation, Tian Yang immediately used the treasures he had acquired over the past hundred years on Kulas.

As weird as it may sound, Tian Yang found himself silently hoping that Kulas was cursed. At the very least, they would then know what was wrong with him. If it wasn't a curse, they would be back at square one.
However, even after using multiple treasures, none of them reacted, meaning they were unable to detect any curses affecting Kulas.
"How is this possible...?" Tian Yang muttered in a defeated voice.
"If it isn't poison, a curse, nor a heart demon, what could it possibly be? I doubt mental instability would put him in such a state, either." Ren Xia pondered out loud.

"Uhhh... I should've said this sooner, but despite his appearances, my father is actually very healthy." Xie Mey suddenly said. "We had many doctors look at him. And all of them said the same thing. His internal organs are healthy, and his Dantian and spiritual veins are all normal.
Tian Yang almost couldn't believe his ears. How could Kulas be considered healthy while looking like a dried up corpse? "This situation is getting weirder by the moment," Ren Xia shook her head.
"Hm?"
Suddenly, she noticed some movements from the bed.
The next moment, a hoarse voice resounded, "Brother... Is that you...?"
"Kulas?!" Tian Yang immediately responded.
"What the...?" Xie Mey mumbled with a dumbfounded look on her face.
Kulas had already woken up a week prior to their return, so she was surprised to see him wake up again in such a short time.
"Ah... I really didn't... want you to... see me in such a... state..." Kulas spoke in a weak voice.
"Rather than wasting your breath on such nonsensical words, tell me if you have any idea what happened to you," said Tian Yang.
Despite asking such a question, Tian Yang already knew how Kulas would respond to it.
"I... don't know..." Kulas said. "But it started... after we went to war... with the... Three Pillars of Heaven..."
"War with the Three Pillars of Heaven?" Tian Yang frowned.
"You guys are at war with them? Since when?"

"Shortly after you left, the Three Pillars of Heaven sent their demands to compensate for the incident. However, their demands were outrageous." Xie Mey spoke in her father's stead, and she proceeded to explain the whole situation to them.

"What a ridiculous demand." Ren Xia shook her head after listening to the details. "They just want an excuse to go to war. I guess they've been bored out of their mind after being at the top and unmatched for too long."
Tian Yang remained silent for a long moment before speaking, "What are the chances of the Three Pillars of Heaven being behind Kulas' phenomenon?
"Quite frankly, it's not high," Ren Xia replied. "However, it's not low, either."
"But how would they have done it?" Xie Mey asked.

"Unfortunately, there's no way we will know unless they reveal it to us. Kulas has met with many people over the years. They could've pulled something at any time. This would explain why Kulas, who seemed perfectly healthy, suddenly started to have mood swings," said Tian Yang.

"Perhaps they have always wanted to get rid of the Giant Race for whatever reason," Ren Xia shrugged. "If the Three Pillars of Heaven are the pioneers of cultivation, then Kulas would be the creator of the Giant Race. If I had to guess, they don't want any competition."
She continued, "They have revealed themselves to be ruthless and unreasonable with their demand, after all."

Tian Yang clenched his teeth, anger burning within him. He could never understand why those wielding immense power so often used it to trample the weak. First the Immortal Clans, and now the Three Pillars of Heaven.
"So, what now?" Ren Xia asked.
"If the Three Pillars of Heaven are truly involved, I am going to try to figure out what they did to Kulas and find a way to cure it," he spoke with a resolute expression.
"How are you going to do that?" Xie Mey asked with a puzzled face.
"By going to the Holy Continent. I know someone from there, and she said that I could visit with her permission."
"No... it's too... dangerous..." Kulas rejected the idea.
Tian Yang sighed, "There's no other way."

chapters.title: Chapter 2300 An Absurd Theory
paragraphs: "I know you are... doing this for me... but... it's too dangerous." Kulas reiterated.

"Dear, I have to agree with Kulas," Ren Xia said with a worried frown on her pretty face. "Visiting the Holy Continent because you're curious about them and going there to investigate them are entirely different matters. What if you're caught? Even you won't be able to escape them."
"Then what should I do? Are you telling me to do nothing but watch my sworn brother and friend slowly die, even though there's a chance I could prevent that?"
Ren Xia sighed, "I won't stop you if you really want to go to the Holy Continent. Knowing you, you'll go regardless of what I say, anyway. However, at least think it over some more."
"Even though my father's life is at stake, I also agree with Senior Ren. You should wait a little longer before you rush into the Holy Continent," Xie Mey said.
"How long am I supposed to wait before I act? Looking at his state, he might not even have a few years." Tian Yang rubbed his eyes in a stressful manner.
"You are... underestimating me... too much..." Kulas said.
Tian Yang looked at him and responded, "I think I am already being generous with my estimate. Look at you. You can't even speak a full sentence without taking deep breaths."

"But the doctors said that besides his appearance, everything else is healthy... Even Mother Chao said so." Xie Mei said. "If it had only been one doctor who said so, I wouldn't have believed it. However, many of them said the same thing. Moreover, my father has survived in this state for over a hundred years now."
Tian Yang fell silent, as he was unable to refute her words.
Eventually, he sighed out loud, "Fine, I will wait a little before I head to the Holy Continent."
"Thank you..." Kulas said.
Tian Yang and the others left Kulas alone to rest shortly after.
"I guess we'll be staying here again for some time," he said to Xie Mey.
She smiled and said, "We haven't touched your room, and you can stay here whenever and for as long as you want."
Over the next several days would wander around the palace to look for any clues, hoping the Three Pillars of Heaven had left behind some evidence of foul play. Unfortunately, he found nothing.
However, a few months later, just as Tian Yang started planning his journey to the Holy Continent, something unbelievable happened.
Kulas, who had been bedridden for a hundred years, made a sudden and full recovery.
"I don't know what happened, but it seems I have recovered now, so you no longer have any reason to visit the Holy Continent," Kulas said as he stood before Tian Yang, looking as healthy as before.
"What the...?" Tian Yang couldn't believe it. "You... You aren't pretending to have recovered just to prevent me from heading to the Holy Continent, right?"
Kulas raised his arm into the air and swore with a serious face, "I swear on my soul that I am not pretending."

"How? This doesn't make any sense!" "This may sound crazy, but I have been feeling better ever since you returned to the palace. Not only that, but previously, I started having mood swings after you left, but the moment you returned, it stopped for fifty years."
Tian Yang frowned and said, "Are you implying that I am the cure to your issues somehow?"
"It sounds ridiculous, I know. However, it can't be a mere coincidence. How about this? Let's test out my theory."
Tian Yang rubbed his eyes and sighed, "So what? Are you telling me to leave the palace to see if your sickness will return?"
Kulas nodded with a serious expression.
"You crazy son of a bitch..." Tian Yang was speechless.
Yet, he didn't refuse.
After a moment of silence, he asked, "How long do you want me to be away?"
"Until my condition worsens," Kulas quickly replied.
"Fine. I'll play along with your absurd theory."
Some time later, Tian Yang explained the situation to Ren Xia.
"That is the most absurd thing I have ever heard!"
To nobody's surprise, she was shocked by it.
"How in heaven's name did he even come up with this?"
Despite finding the idea dumb, Ren Xia didn't reject the idea.
"Let's return to our secret home then," she said, as she had been wanting to return for some time now, and this was the perfect opportunity.
Before they left, Kulas handed them a treasure.
"What's this?
"It's a communication device. It will allow us to speak with each other even through vast distances."
"Alright. Then contact me the moment you start feeling sick again."
"I will."
Tian Yang and Ren Xia left the palace the same day.
However, not even a few days later, they were contacted by Xie Mey.
"Please return! My father has fallen sick again!"
"Seriously? We aren't even halfway to our home." Ren Xia complained as they turned around and started making their way back to the palace.
Upon returning to the palace, Tian Yang stayed in the palace to see if Kulas would recover again.
Sure enough, a month later, Kulas recovered from his mysterious illness.

Tian Yang was shocked by the results, but he still wasn't entirely convinced. "Let's do it again. This time, stay outside for at least a decade, and don't come back even if I am sick." Kulas suddenly suggested.
"Again? If this is real, you're playing with your life." Tian Yang sighed.
"What else can we do?" He shrugged.
Thus, Tian Yang and Ren Xia left again. This time, they made it back home and stayed there for ten years before returning to the palace.
"Father has fallen sick again," Xie Mey revealed to them.
"Since when?" Tian Yang asked.
Unlike the first time, they didn't contact him when Kulas fell sick.
After a moment of silence, Xie Mey responded in an odd voice.
"The day after you left..."

Kulas raised his arm into the air and swore with a serious face, "I swear on my soul that I am not pretending."
"How?
This doesn't make any sense!" "This may sound crazy, but I have been feeling better ever since you returned to the palace.
Not only that, but previously, I started having mood swings after you left, but the moment you returned, it stopped for fifty years."
Tian Yang frowned and said, "Are you implying that I am the cure to your issues somehow?"
"It sounds ridiculous, I know.
However, it can't be a mere coincidence.
How about this?
Let's test out my theory."
Tian Yang rubbed his eyes and sighed, "So what?
Are you telling me to leave the palace to see if your sickness will return?"
Kulas nodded with a serious expression.
"You crazy son of a bitch..." Tian Yang was speechless.
Yet, he didn't refuse.
After a moment of silence, he asked, "How long do you want me to be away?"
"Until my condition worsens," Kulas quickly replied.
"Fine.
I'll play along with your absurd theory."
Some time later, Tian Yang explained the situation to Ren Xia.
"That is the most absurd thing I have ever heard!"
To nobody's surprise, she was shocked by it.
"How in heaven's name did he even come up with this?"
Despite finding the idea dumb, Ren Xia didn't reject the idea.
"Let's return to our secret home then," she said, as she had been wanting to return for some time now, and this was the perfect opportunity.
Before they left, Kulas handed them a treasure.
"What's this?
"It's a communication device.
It will allow us to speak with each other even through vast distances."
"Alright.
Then contact me the moment you start feeling sick again."
"I will."
Tian Yang and Ren Xia left the palace the same day.
However, not even a few days later, they were contacted by Xie Mey.
"Please return!
My father has fallen sick again!"
"Seriously?
We aren't even halfway to our home." Ren Xia complained as they turned around and started making their way back to the palace.
Upon returning to the palace, Tian Yang stayed in the palace to see if Kulas would recover again.
Sure enough, a month later, Kulas recovered from his mysterious illness.
Tian Yang was shocked by the results, but he still wasn't entirely convinced.
"Let's do it again.
This time, stay outside for at least a decade, and don't come back even if I am sick." Kulas suddenly suggested.
"Again?
If this is real, you're playing with your life." Tian Yang sighed.
"What else can we do?" He shrugged.
Thus, Tian Yang and Ren Xia left again.
This time, they made it back home and stayed there for ten years before returning to the palace.
"Father has fallen sick again," Xie Mey revealed to them.
"Since when?" Tian Yang asked.
Unlike the first time, they didn't contact him when Kulas fell sick.
After a moment of silence, Xie Mey responded in an odd voice.
"The day after you left..."
